title: Lead Solutions Architect - Generative AI (EMEA Emerging DNB)
description: <p><strong>REQ ID:</strong> FEQ227R147</p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> United Kingdom (Remote/Hybrid — London or UK-based)</p> <p><strong>Recruiter:</strong> Dina Hussain</p> <h2><strong>About the Role</strong></h2> <p>We are looking for a Lead Solution Architect focused on Generative AI to support our <strong>EMEA Emerging Digital Natives and Startups </strong>business unit — one of the fastest-moving, most technically ambitious patches in EMEA. Our customers are digital-native and cloud-native companies who build on the frontier: they adopt GenAI early, scale fast, and expect their technical partners to be as sharp as their own engineers.</p> <p>You will be the go-to expert our Account Teams and customers turn to when a GenAI or LLM use case needs to move from an ambitious idea to a production-grade reality across our high-growth accounts.</p> <p>This is a highly technical, customer-facing individual contributor role for someone who lives at the frontier of applied GenAI. You will shape architectures, prove out the hard problems, challenge and influence customer roadmaps, and raise the GenAI capability of the entire EMEA Emerging DNB field organisation.</p> <h2><strong>What You'll Do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Serve as the deep technical authority on Generative AI, LLMs, and applied machine learning for the EMEA Emerging DNB business unit, supporting the most strategic and complex customer engagements across our digital-native and born-in-the-cloud accounts.</li> <li>Partner with our EMEA Emerging DNB Solutions Architects, Solutions Engineers, and Account teams to scope, design, and de-risk GenAI use cases — from retrieval-augmented generation and agentic systems to fine-tuning and evaluation.</li> <li>Build hands-on proofs of concept and reference implementations that operationalise large-scale LLM and deep learning workloads on Databricks (Mosaic AI, MLflow, Model Serving, Vector Search, Unity Catalog governance), tuned to the fast iteration cycles Emerging DNB customers expect.</li> <li>Lead fine-tuning and model-customisation engagements on open LLMs (e.g., Llama-family models), including judge-based and label-efficient evaluation approaches for domains where quality and safety are paramount.</li> <li>Act as a bridge to Product and Engineering — channel field and customer feedback into the roadmap and represent the roadmap back to the field.</li> <li>Enable and mentor the broader EMEA Emerging DNB Field Engineering team through workshops, reference architectures, and internal enablement, multiplying GenAI expertise across our ~70-person SA/SE organisation.</li> <li>Represent Databricks externally as a technical thought leader — conference talks (e.g., Data + AI Summit), blogs, and customer executive briefings.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What We're Looking For</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Strong understanding of the LLM landscape, including leading proprietary and open-source models and providers, with the ability to differentiate their capabilities, trade-offs, and suitability for different use cases, and to articulate a clear, informed point of view (POV) to customers.</li> <li>Deep expertise in the modern GenAI stack: LLM application patterns (RAG, agents, tool use), fine-tuning and model customization, prompt and evaluation engineering, and LLM guardrails/safety.</li> <li>Strong foundations in machine learning and deep learning, including distributed training, GPU workloads, and the full MLOps lifecycle (tracking, registry, serving, monitoring).</li> <li>Proficiency in Python and the ML ecosystem (PyTorch/Transformers, MLflow, Spark), and comfort building production-quality reference implementations.</li> <li>Experience with the Databricks platform — or the ability to ramp on it quickly — including Mosaic AI, Model Serving, Vector Search, and Unity Catalog. Cloud experience across AWS, Azure, or GCP.</li> <li>Excellent communication and consultative skills: able to earn the trust of both hands-on engineers and senior technical executives, and to explain complex GenAI trade-offs clearly.</li> <li>A track record of technical leadership and mentorship — someone who elevates the people around them.</li> <li>Comfort operating at the pace of digital-native and high-growth customers, where speed, iteration, and technical credibility win the deal.</li> <li>Based in the United Kingdom and able to work across EMEA time zones, with willingness to travel to customer sites within the region as needed.</li> <li>Background helping digital-native customers build data and ML solutions (e.g., prior experience at a data/ML platform or consulting vendor) is a strong plus.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Nice to Have</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Public technical presence: conference speaking, published talks, blogs, or open-source contributions in the ML/GenAI space.</li> <li>Domain depth in a regulated or high-stakes industry (healthcare/life sciences, financial services) where model quality, evaluation, and safety are critical.</li> <li>Experience partnering with Product and Engineering teams to influence roadmap.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Why This Role</strong></h2> <p>You will work on the hardest and most exciting GenAI problems our EMEA Emerging DNB customers have — companies building the future in real time — with the platform and the people to actually solve them, not just advise. You'll shape how one of EMEA's highest-growth business units adopts Generative AI, influence the direction of the product, and build a public profile as a recognised expert in the field. This is the role for a builder and a teacher, who wants their expertise to have outsized impact.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>About Databricks</strong></p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, sans-serif;">Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/databricks">LinkedIn</a>, <a href="https://x.com/databricks">X</a>, <a href="https://www.youtube.com/@Databricks">YouTube</a>, and <a href="https://www.instagram.com/databricksinc/?hl=en">Instagram</a>.<br><br><strong>Benefits<br><br></strong></span>At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click <a href="https://docs.google.com/document/d/154un3e8Xav4BceOSlcYFZRGEuQI54xMxVydRwQn54eQ/edit?usp=sharing">here</a>.<br><br></p> <p><strong>Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion</strong></p> <p>At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.</p> <p><strong>Compliance</strong></p> <p><strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">If access to export-controlled technology or source code is required for performance of job duties, it is within Employer's discretion whether to apply for a U.S. government license for such positions, and Employer may decline to proceed with an applicant on this basis alone.</span></strong></p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Recruitment Fraud Alert</strong></p> <p>We’ve learned that scammers are impersonating Commvault team members—including HR and leadership—via email or text. These bad actors may conduct fake interviews and ask for personal information, such as your social security number.  </p> <p><strong>What to know:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Commvault does <em>not</em> conduct interviews by email or text.</li> <li>We will never ask you to submit sensitive documents (including banking information, SSN, etc) before your first day.</li> <li>Commvault recruiters may contact prospective candidates through LinkedIn and other professional networking platforms regarding career opportunities. If you are unsure whether a recruiting communication is legitimate, review the profile to ensure they have a badge verifying them as a Commvault employee.</li> </ul> <p>If you suspect a recruiting scam, please contact us at <u><a ---------- <p> </p> <p><strong>About Commvault</strong> </p> <p>Commvault (NASDAQ: CVLT) is the gold standard in cyber resilience. The company empowers customers to uncover, take action, and rapidly recover from cyberattacks – keeping data safe and businesses resilient. The company’s unique AI-powered platform combines best-in-class data protection, exceptional data security, advanced data intelligence, and lightning-fast recovery across any workload or cloud at the lowest TCO. For over 25 years, more than 100,000 organizations and a vast partner ecosystem have relied on Commvault to reduce risks, improve governance, and do more with data. </p></div><p>Account Executive is responsible for achieving quota by selling solutions into a defined account list that may include current Commvault customers and high value prospects.  The position is a field sales role where the AE will engage in face-to-face sales with customers and prospects either directly or through partners. The Account Executive plans, organizes, leads and controls balanced sales growth, account penetration and customer satisfaction on a long-term multi-quarter basis. This individual may lead a cross-functional sales team and is responsible for creating sales campaigns to penetrate/expand his/her target accounts. The AE must have the ability to articulate an in-depth understanding of the customers’ environment, current challenges/goals and have the ability to align Commvault solutions to those challenges/goals including a financial and strategic value proposition.  The candidate must have a history of success in selling complex software platforms (vs. IT component or narrow focused tools) and should have some level of prior engagement with the target account set.</p> <p><strong>How you will make an impact:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Achieve quarterly and annual quotas by selling to new and established - large, complex prospects and customer.</li> <li>Develop and implement Strategic account plans for target account expansion and new account acquisition including performance objectives, financial targets, and critical milestones for a one and three-year period.</li> <li>Create sale campaigns into target accounts and closely coordinate company executive involvement with customer/prospect leadership.</li> <li>Coordinate the involvement of company personnel, including support, service, and management resources, in order to meet account performance objectives and customers’ expectations.</li> <li>Manage a matrixed sales team; liaison with clients, Deal Desk, inside sales, partners, channels, sales engineers, professional services, finance and legal to drive a prospect to close</li> <li>Establish and maintain a productive, professional relationship with key personnel in assigned customer/prospect accounts.</li> <li>Construct and deliver tangible business cases at the CXO level including financial (ROI & TCO), technical and strategic value propositions</li> <li>Prepare and present sales proposals and presentations to new and existing clients</li> <li>Identify and build strategic relationships with partners and alliances that have existing relationships with the assigned target accounts</li> <li>Negotiate and close deals following the company’s practices and processes</li> <li>Ensure orders meet all legal and financial requirements</li> <li>Maintain a high level of relevant industry, Commvault and competitive knowledge</li> <li>Plan, attend and coordinate executive briefings</li> <li>Leverage internal sales tools and processes to drive opportunities to a successful close.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Position Requirements include:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience in identifying, building relationships and selling directly or with partners</li> <li>Excellent communication skills, persuasive, listening skills</li> <li>Background in IT infrastructure, security and SAAS</li> <li>Experience of MEDDICC sales methodology or similar would be an advantage</li> <li>Fluent German language skills</li> <li>Experience selling software solutions</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p>#LI-EL1</p> <p>#LI-remote</p><div class="content-conclusion"><div class="jd-info au-target" data-ph-at-id="jobdescription-text" data-ph-id="ph-page-element-page5-4e8TMw"> <p>Commvault is an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. title: HR & EOR Operations Manager
description: Part-Time | Switzerland (Remote) | Global EOR & HR Platform | Employed via Swiss Entity ABOUT THE CLIENT Our client is a fast-growing global HR, payroll, and compliance platform operating across 180+ regions. The company combines technology with owned entities, in-house legal and payroll expertise, transparent pricing, and dedicated human support - helping businesses of all sizes hire talent anywhere in the world. The company is driven by a constant pursuit of innovation, expanding its product suite to create integrated HR solutions for businesses from fledgling startups to global enterprises. ABOUT THE ROLE We are looking for an HR & EOR Operations Manager to join our Swiss entity on a part-time basis. This is a hands-on operational role - not a purely administrative or advisory position. As part of the role, you will serve as the named Responsible Person for the Swiss entity under SECO/Zürich personnel leasing law, fulfilling a standing legal obligation tied to our EOR licence. This means you must be genuinely employed, operationally involved, and present in Switzerland - not an external adviser lending a name to a form. Day-to-day workload is manageable within a 50% FTE, and you will be fully supported by the company's global HR, payroll and compliance teams. Other concurrent work or mandates are welcome, provided they do not interfere with your availability and supervision of the entity's activities. This role is a strong fit for HR or EOR professionals already freelancing, holding consulting mandates, or looking to add a substantive part-time role to their portfolio. WHAT YOU'LL DO Act as the named Responsible Person for the Swiss entity under Swiss personnel leasing (SECO) law. Ensure compliance with Swiss labour-leasing legislation, Swiss employment law, and the staffing industry GAV (minimum wages and equal treatment). Maintain documentation required for SECO and cantonal audits and inspections. Serve as the primary Swiss contact for SECO and cantonal authorities. Oversee HR and employment operations for the Swiss entity - including onboarding, contract controls, and employment matters. Support payroll oversight in collaboration with the global payroll team. Handle employee and client escalations related to HR and compliance matters. Supervise the entity's EOR/personnel leasing activities and ensure they are conducted properly. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR Right to Work in Switzerland - one of the following is required: Swiss citizen. EU/EFTA national with a current Swiss B or C permit. Non-EU/EFTA national with a Swiss C permit (a non-EU/EFTA B permit alone does not qualify). EU/EFTA national with a genuine 5-year cross-border G permit. Education: Any completed qualification - EFZ apprenticeship, Matura/Abitur, or university degree in any field. Experience - either route qualifies: Standard route: 3+ years in one of the following: recruitment or placement, personnel leasing or staffing (including EOR), substantive HR (not admin-only), personnel consulting, or organisational/business consulting. Employment certificates confirming dates, workload percentage and substantive duties are required alongside a CV. Alternative route: 3+ years of general professional experience plus a completed, recognised HR qualification with a passed exam (e.g. HRSE or VSH HR Assistant). Course attendance without a final certificate does not count. Character: Clean criminal record, debt-enforcement register and tax history. Other: Comfortable being named on the Commercial Register with signing authority. Willing to disclose other jobs, board mandates or licensed-business responsibilities. Genuinely hands-on - purely advisory profiles (external lawyers or accountants with no operational involvement) are not suitable. WHAT MAKES THIS ROLE DIFFERENT This is a rare opportunity for an experienced HR or EOR professional in Switzerland to take on a meaningful operational role at a global scale without committing to a full-time position. You will hold a real and recognised legal position within the Swiss entity, with direct contact with SECO and cantonal authorities, while being backed by an experienced international HR, payroll and compliance team. The 50% structure makes this accessible to consultants, freelancers and professionals looking to add a substantive part-time engagement alongside existing work. International EOR or HR experience is fully valid - experience does not need to be Swiss-based, though familiarity with Swiss employment law and social insurance is an advantage. The company values a builder mentality - people who want to improve processes, not just maintain them. WORKING ENVIRONMENT Fully remote within Switzerland. Part-time 50% FTE with flexible hours. Direct collaboration with the global HR, payroll and compliance teams. Meaningful presence in Switzerland required (~50% benchmark) - remote-only offshore oversight does not meet regulatory requirements. WHAT WE OFFER Health insurance contributions. Share incentives. Learning and mentorship opportunities. Team offsites and social events. 4 weeks of work-from-anywhere per year. Other concurrent work or mandates are welcome. title: Sales Manager - Berlin
description: Company Description We’re Checkout.com . You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day. We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers. Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale. If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact. With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started. Job Description Checkout.com is actively looking for an enthusiastic and talented Payments Senior Sales Manager to join our Commercial Payments Team to drive rapid growth across various industries for our revolutionary online payment solution. If you are a driven and focused salesperson with a proven track record of success selling direct payment solutions to enterprise companies, in a high-growth and competitive environment, this is the role for you. In return, on top of a tremendous working environment, we offer you an unrivaled uncapped recurring commissions plan, hybrid work model and competitive benefits package. The Senior Sales Manager will play a key role in growing Checkout.com ’s payments footprint. They will be responsible for selling Checkout.com ’s full payments technology stack to middle market and large enterprise organizations. Along the way, you'll collaborate closely with various in-house talents across Technology and Business to position our capabilities, products, services and solutions effectively with prospects. Desire an independent, high-achieving individual that stands out in an entrepreneurial environment and has the grit and desire to outperform sales targets. How you’ll make impact: ● Acting as a consultative Payments strategist able to advise companies on an optimal payments structure that pulls from a myriad of solutions Checkout.com provides ● Identify, qualify and close the most promising prospects and partners that will help Checkout.com grow a healthy pipeline across various verticals. ● Build prospect engagement strategies and partner with marketing, business development, product and other departments to build qualified that pipeline in cold and warm channels ● Pitch our next-generation payment solutions and value-added services ● Prepare high-quality presentations and proposals for C-suite stakeholders at prospective merchants, and implement winning negotiation strategies ● Become the expert on Checkout.com ’s technology stack, help new merchants understand the value of Checkout.com to solve their pain points, and handle detailed questions about our product capabilities. ● Orchestrate the entire Sales process, drive urgency and work to mutual action plans, and act as the main point of contact for merchants and internal stakeholders. ● Maintain a solid, well-organized portfolio and nurture key accounts by having a deep understanding of their industry, pain points, and needs. ● Partner with other Payment Sales Managers to share best practices, key business insights and industry trends. ● Provide feedback on local trends including competitor insights, customer needs, sales, product and marketing information. Qualifications: ● 3+ years Enterprise Sales experience directly in the Payments industry ● Track record of high performance, and self sourcing leads ● Highly motivated and committed to growth and development with excellent communication skills ● Solid network of potential prospects and partners within the payments landscape ● Tech-savvy, with a passion for Fintech and Payments ● Strong commercial acumen, ability to effectively negotiate complex structures ● Fluent in English + German Additional Information Bring all of you to work We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one. Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands. We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here. It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable. Life at Checkout.com We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection. Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us. title: Robotics Manufacturing Engineer
description: The Robotics Manufacturing Engineer drives industrialization and manufacturing engineering for the Dexter surgical robot and its accessories by owning mechanical and mechatronic sustaining engineering, manufacturing testing, root-cause analysis of manufacturing issues, and design transfer. title: Technical Program Manager (AI/ML)
description: About CuspAI CuspAI is the frontier AI company on a mission to solve the breakthrough materials needed to power human progress. While nature took billions of years to perfect molecules, we are harnessing AI to unlock trillion-dollar materials breakthroughs in months, not millennia. Our founding team is the most cited in the world, comprised of world-class researchers in AI, chemistry and engineering. We are working on some of the hardest and most important challenges including energy, clean water, the future of compute, and carbon capture, and this is just the start of what our 'search engine' for next-generation materials will unlock. We invite you to be part of a diverse, innovative team at the intersection of AI and materials science, working to create impactful partnerships that drive innovation, scalability, and industry collaboration. This work matters. Your work matters. We’re on the cusp of the on-demand materials era. Join us. The Role Due to rapid growth, we are seeking a Technical Program Manager with an AI/ML background to join our team in Berlin. You will be a key driver of technical cohesion, bridging the gap between our research and the physical implementation of next-generation materials. Your Impact In this role you will be building and executing the program management framework that accelerates AI/ML frontier research and platform capability development, which is critical for translating scientific objectives into real-world, scalable materials breakthroughs. As a member of our growing team of TPMs, you will work closely with our technical teams on internal initiatives and also manage high-stakes customer projects. Your main focus initially will be coordinating complex technical campaigns in frontier AI/ML research focused on developing novel materials, and over time you will likely get involved in establishing more sophisticated, scalable processes for model development lifecycles. What You Will Do Program Leadership & Research Integration Lead internal technical programs across AI/ML model development, frontier research, data workflows, and machine learning infrastructure, acting as the connective tissue between AI researchers and materials scientists. Translate scientific and business objectives into executable plans, aligning commercial, research and engineering teams. Close the loop between experimental results and the AI research cycle, translating lab findings back into the model development process to continuously improve accuracy and accelerate discovery. Own planning and delivery of projects; calculating compute, managing resources & dependencies, mapping out timelines, and managing risks to ensure successful outcomes. Partner & Customer Collaboration Lead technical programs with industry partners and research institutions, serving as a primary program contact for our external partners during the execution and delivery of projects. Facilitate technical discussions between internal teams and external stakeholders. Drive project scoping and proposal writing in collaboration with the Partnerships and technical teams. Manage joint development initiatives and coordinate customer pilot programs from conception through to deployment. Process & Operations Work closely with the rest of the global TPM team to refine scalable processes. Implement metrics for tracking technical milestones and program outcomes. Coordinate compliance and regulatory considerations across programs. Support intellectual property (IP) and scientific publication processes. Foster interdisciplinary team culture and own change management to successfully scale the organisation. Use data to drive continuous improvements to internal and customer-facing processes. Must Have Skills and Qualifications: You possess a strong background in AI/ML and/or a related Natural Science field. Proven experience as a Technical Program Manager specifically within the AI/ML domain, including a deep understanding of model architecture, cloud computing best practices and the software development lifecycle. Strong leadership and facilitation capabilities for managing cross-functional teams. The ability to navigate high levels of ambiguity and maintain cohesion across multi-disciplinary teams (AI, Chemistry, and Engineering). Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence both highly technical researchers and non-technical partners at varying levels of seniority. Strategic thinking and problem-solving skills with comfort navigating ambiguity and changing priorities. Bonus Points (But Not Critical): Experience with molecular simulation software, quantum chemistry packages, or cheminformatics tools. Practical experience or an academic background in Materials Science, Experimental Chemistry, or Physics. Hands-on experience with high-performance computing (HPC) infrastructure or scientific data management. Additional Considerations This role will be based in our Berlin office, with the expectation of being in the office three days per week. Additionally, there may be regular travel required to other locations (particularly London or Amsterdam) for collaboration and project work. What We Offer A competitive salary: We value and reward impact and growth Equity in CuspAI: You have a stake in the success of the company Time off to stay fresh: 28 days holiday (DE, NL, UK) or 21 days holiday (JP, SG, US), in addition to local public holidays ‘Gold Standard’ parental leave: 26 weeks (primary caregiver) and 12 weeks (secondary caregiver) at full pay - we look after you and your family while we work on the most important materials discovery problems together Professional development budget: We invest in your career development so you can stay up to date with the latest industry knowledge or add to your skills to increase impact and growth Solve meaningful problems: See how your work has a direct impact on advancing materials science and solving sustainability and climate-related problems through the creation and application of bleeding-edge SOTA technology and revolutionary techniques True interdisciplinary teamwork: Be part of a deeply collaborative environment bridging AI research, computational chemistry, and experimental science - work with world-class researchers and engineers who enjoy sharing knowledge and supporting each other Join us in shaping the future of materials with AI. Together, we can create groundbreaking solutions for a more sustainable world. CuspAI is an equal opportunities employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace . We do not discriminate on the basis of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), veteran status, or any other basis protected by applicable law. We actively encourage applications from all backgrounds and value the unique perspectives and contributions that diversity brings to our team. Please let us know if you require any specific adjustments during or after the interview process. We will do everything we can within reason to accommodate. title: Legal Counsel (f/m/d)
description: We see the potential inside everything and everyone. Starting with you. Orbem uses AI to industrialize MRI, delivering non-invasive insight into everything from fruits to eggs to the human body. We are transforming what is becoming the world's largest biological dataset into actionable intelligence to reduce waste, increase quality, and accelerate the shift toward a more sustainable and healthier future. Headquartered and founded in Munich, Germany, with an office now in Houston, Texas, our world-class team is scaling inside-out technology to transform how humanity sees and understands biological matter. Help us see what's possible. Join us. Your Role You will build Orbem's legal and compliance function largely from the ground up, at a pivotal moment. As we scale across Europe, into the US, and toward new geographies and verticals, legal and compliance touch nearly every part of the business — commercial contracts, corporate matters, employment, data protection, and product & AI regulation. Much of this exists today only in pieces. You will inherit that reality and the mandate to shape it into a coherent function. This is a role for a hands-on legal counsel who wants to build a function, not just run one — someone comfortable with ambiguity, who makes pragmatic, risk-balanced calls with incomplete information, and does the substantive legal work themselves while orchestrating a lean stack of external counsel. A central part of the role is building Orbem's compliance function: a cross-functional, integrated approach to knowing and managing our risks — across intellectual property, product compliance, information security, data protection, and regulatory readiness. We treat compliance as an enabler of speed, not a brake on it — applying the right level of rigour for our stage and moment, so Orbem stays compliant and moves fast. Your Day-to-Day Legal & Commercial (≈ 40%) Draft and negotiate our commercial contracts — the integrated hardware sale/lease, software/AI licensing, and service/maintenance agreements at the core of our B2B business, plus supplier and partner agreements. Build and own our contract toolkit — templates, playbooks, and a clean review-to-signing workflow that lets the business move quickly without losing rigour. Own corporate and governance matters , including corporate housekeeping, board and shareholder support, and our employee equity program. Advise on employment matters and manage disputes and litigation in partnership with external counsel. Building the Compliance Function (≈ 40%) Stand up Orbem's cross-functional compliance function — an integrated approach to identifying, aligning on, and managing risk across the business, rather than in silos. Partner across IP, InfoSec, Product Compliance, and Data Protection to translate obligations into practical, proportionate standards people can actually work with. Drive regulatory readiness for the frameworks that matter to us — EU AI Act, Cyber Resilience Act, export control, data protection — sequencing what we do to our stage. Own the foundational building blocks — Code of Conduct and core policies as enablers of trust and speed. Orchestrating External Counsel & Lateral Leadership (≈ 20%) Manage a lean stack of external firms (e.g. corporate, US, employment counsel), optimizing for cost, consistency, and a coherent global strategy. Be the central hub for legal and compliance across Orbem — looped in early on decisions, not as a final gatekeeper. Embed legal as a proactive enabler in fast-moving business workflows, and leverage AI and legal tooling aggressively to keep the function lean and scalable. How You Fit In This is an individual contributor role at Principal level, reporting to the COO. Your influence is lateral, not hierarchical — you work across the whole company rather than through a team of your own. You partner closely with Information Security, Intellectual Property, and Product Compliance on the integrated compliance approach, and work day to day with Finance, People & Culture, Supply Chain, Business Development, Field Operations, and our Product teams. You advise the full executive team on legal- and compliance-relevant decisions. Your Experience and Skills Qualified German lawyer — Volljurist or Wirtschaftsjurist (or equivalent) — with strong in-house experience in a fast-paced environment. Solid foundation in German corporate and commercial contract law , with a focus on B2B operations. Hands-on builder. You have personally set up legal and/or compliance processes, templates, and frameworks — not only specified or overseen them. You are comfortable drafting, running workshops, and sitting in working meetings to ship the work. Comfort without a large team. You are motivated by being the person in the room, not the person who built the room. Business-minded and pragmatic. You make risk-balanced decisions, understand the need for speed in a scale-up, and offer solutions rather than just flagging problems. Cross-border comfort. You are comfortable coordinating multi-jurisdictional matters, especially across the EU and US, in partnership with external counsel. Communication. You translate complex legal issues into practical, commercially sound advice for non-legal stakeholders. Fluent in German and English. What Makes You Stand Out In-house experience at a hardware-focused technology company or a deep-tech scale-up. Track record building compliance frameworks from scratch — ideally an integrated, company-wide approach rather than a single domain — across areas such as data protection, product and trade compliance, anti-corruption, or AI governance. Experience with product liability and product safety in a commercial context. Comfort with AI-first working — using AI to compress the work and owning the output, not just the prompt. Fit to Our Values We Own Every Challenge: we enjoy complexity and thrive under uncertainty. We Strive for Better: we seize any opportunity for growth and challenge the status quo. We are constantly learning and improving. We Imagine New Frontiers: we think beyond “doable” and “reasonable”. We design a sustainable and healthy future together. What We Offer International Environment: Join a team with 40+ nationalities across 5 continents, all driven by a shared purpose: shedding light on the world’s toughest challenges. Comprehensive Benefits: Stock Options: Share in Orbem’s success. Relocation Support: Seamless support for your move to Germany. Learning & Development: €1,750 annual budget for personal growth. Fitness Membership: Access to Urban Sports Club or Wellpass. Childcare Reimbursement: Support for Kita/Kindergarten fees. Deutschland Ticket: Full coverage of public transportation. Work-Life Integration: Flexible Hours & Home Office: Work when and where it suits you. WFH Perks: Get €185 to upgrade your home office + an external monitor on us! 30 Days Paid Leave: Plenty of time to recharge. Personal Leave: Flexibility for life’s important moments. Work From Anywhere: Experience new cultures and environments for up to 60 days per year. Make a Difference: Join an ambitious, fast-growing team working on breakthrough technology. In our scale-up environment, you'll have the freedom to lead your projects and make an impact. We provide a platform for you to explore, innovate, and define your vision for the future. At Orbem, we're committed to helping you discover your strengths, and while we aim to teach you, we also want to learn from you. Your Team: You'll become part of our diverse and international team. Learn more about the team members, their work, and challenges here: https://orbem.ai/company/ At Orbem, we're committed to building a smart, diverse team, and we recognize that self-doubt can prevent talented individuals from applying. If you feel you don't meet every requirement, we'd love to hear from you anyway! title: Sales Representative (m/w/d) - Basel
description: Du hast erste Vertriebserfahrung und willst jetzt richtig loslegen? Bei uns bekommst du ein strukturiertes Onboarding, dein eigenes Gebiet, kurze Sales-Cycles und ein Team, das dich weiterentwickelt. title: InnoMaster Big Data Engineering - part-time Master's Program
description: Part-time Master's Program starting April 2027 Do you have a passion for Big Data? Do you want to make your Master studies exciting and practical? Do you wish to continue studying after your Bachelor's degree while simultaneously stepping into the professional world? And all this with a fixed monthly salary and complete coverage of tuition fees? Then, our InnoMaster Program is just right for you! As part of the InnoMaster Big Data Engineering Program , you'll typically study alongside your job at a university offering an accredited part-time Master's program in IT/Data Engineering located in Hamburg or its surroundings (e.g. FH Wedel) , and we'll cover the costs for you! Concurrently, you'll gain valuable practical work experience working within various Big Data environments such as Google Cloud and on-site Hadoop, allowing you to apply your theoretical knowledge directly into practice! Support our Data Engineers and Data Scientists in processing, managing, and analyzing our data. In addition to responsible tasks and appropriate compensation, we offer participation in training sessions (related to the field, programming languages, or soft skills) and support in further career development. The InnoMaster Big Data Engineering program is designed for approximately three years, with a weekly workload of 25-40 hours depending on your university schedule. We are happy to assist if you have further questions regarding the program. Your skill set Bachelor degree. You have completed your IT-related bachelor's or diploma studies with good grades (GPA of 2.5 or better). Admission requirements. You meet the admission requirements of your preferred IT or data-related program at a university in the Hamburg area. Data engineering. Your personal software projects reflect your affinity for software development and data engineering. Big Data. You have an interest in Big Data ecosystems, some experience with Java and Python is a plus. Soft skills. You enjoy working independently with a strong team-oriented mentality; demonstrate a high level of self-initiative and quick comprehension. English as our company language. You look forward to using your excellent English skills in both spoken and written form daily. Your power-ups Team of specialists. Be part of a stable, growing, and award-winning global company. Meet your future colleagues in Development & IT in this video. Perfect learning environment. We offer you an extremely interesting technical environment and state-of-the-art working conditions. Career development. We support your professional and personal development with optimal guidance from a contact person in the department and from People & Culture. Monthly salary plus education costs. We finance your full tuition fees, including books, plus a monthly salary of € 2.531 ,- gross per month. Outstanding equipment. You work with a fully equipped MacBook Pro, and we provide you with a smartphone or tablet of your choice. Agile work. You can expect flexible working hours and agile, cross-functional teams with short decision-making paths. Team events. Participate in regular team events (e.g., wine tasting, cooking, paintball), barbecue together on our rooftop terrace, and enjoy regular company-get-togethers. Comfy and modern office. We offer you various possibilities to combine work and well-being: fresh fruit and complimentary drinks, in-house fitness studio, gaming area, rooftop terrace with BBQ, relaxing rooms, and much more. InnoGames is one of the leading German developers and publishers of mobile and browser games and a certified Great Place to Work®. The Hamburg-based company was founded in 2007 and is now part of Modern Times Group (MTG). Together with about 350 employees from 40 nations, the company founders develop unique games that provide many years of fun for millions of players around the world. InnoGames is best known for Forge of Empires, Elvenar and Tribal Wars, but the company is continually expanding its now 10-game portfolio across platforms and genres. Most recently, InnoGames launched Heroes of History, a novel mix of city builder and hero collection RPG and Cozy Coast, a feel-good beach adventure with elaborate merge-2-gameplay and a captivating story Excited to start your journey with InnoGames and join our team? We look forward to receiving your application (cover letter, resume, certificates, and code samples) exclusively as an online application via innogames.com/career . Your contact person is Saara Harris . Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: CX AI & Automation Lead
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About Remote</strong></h2> <div><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Remote is solving modern organizations’ biggest challenge – navigating global employment compliantly with ease. We make it possible for businesses of all sizes to recruit, pay, and manage international teams. With our core values at heart and future focused work culture, our team works tirelessly on ambitious problems, asynchronously, around the world. You can find Remoters working from 6 different continents (Antarctica left to go!) and all of our positions are fully remote.<br><br><span class="discussion-id-2f7cb4da-dab4-8068-a80f-001c50b2d808 suggestion-update notion-enable-hover" data-token-index="0">With Innovation as one of the core values, we have built Automation and AI capabilities into the requirements for every role.</span><br><br>We encourage every member of the Remote team to bring their talents, experiences and culture to the table to help us build the best-in-class HR platform.</span></div> <div> </div> <div><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">If you are energetic, curious, motivated and ambitious, be part of our world. Apply now and define the future of work!</span></div></div><h2><strong>What this job can offer you</strong></h2> <ul> <li> <p>This role is a core technical and programme lead position within CX Operations, working alongside CX leadership and cross-functional partners to build the automation and AI capabilities that shape how the team operates at scale.</p> <p>You will own delivery end to end. You will work closely with CX leadership as priorities are shaped, bringing technical and operational input to inform decisions, bring technical judgment and operational context to those conversations, and then lead the work from scoping through to production and iteration. You will bring technical judgment and operational context to scoping discussions, and work with significant autonomy within agreed priorities to see initiatives through from design to production, while working as part of a broader team, not in isolation.</p> <p>The combination this role asks for is not common: someone technically confident to build and ship, with the programme management skills to run complex cross-functional work, and the communication skills to make both sides legible to each other. If that combination describes you, this is a role where you will have real ownership, real impact, and real variety.</p> </li> </ul> <h3><strong>How this role contributes to the department's and company's goals</strong></h3> <p>As Remote grows and the complexity of its customer base increases, CX has to maintain quality and responsiveness without being overwhelmed by volume or operational fragmentation. Automation and AI are central to how we do that, not by replacing good judgment, but by removing friction, surfacing the right information at the right moment, and giving specialists the tools to focus on work that actually requires a human.</p> <p>Beyond efficiency, this role is about empowering the CX team. The tooling and automation built here determine how well our specialists can do their jobs, how quickly customers get real resolution, and how effectively CX can absorb new products, new partners, and growing complexity. That impact is direct and measurable.</p> <h2><strong>What you bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>A <a href="https://signalvnoise.com/posts/1430-hire-managers-of-one">manager of one</a>: you identify what needs doing, set your own direction, and deliver without needing to be chased. You default to action and close your own loops.</li> <li>Strong programme management alongside your technical ability. You can scope a complex initiative, manage stakeholders across functions, communicate clearly to non-technical audiences, and see it through from start to done, not just the build, the whole thing.</li> <li>Hands-on experience building automation and integration systems in a CX, support, or operations context. You understand what a support workflow looks like from the inside: what slows agents down, what good resolution actually means, and what tooling helps versus what just looks good in a demo.</li> <li>Technical confidence: you can build, read, and debug code; design and work with APIs, webhooks, and integration standards including MCP; and move fast using AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor as part of your standard workflow. You take ownership of complex technical systems end to end, from design through to production.</li> <li>Solid experience with low-code and no-code workflow platforms such as n8n, Make, Zapier, Retool, Gumloop, or similar, to design and run cross-system automations.</li> <li>You know when automation is the right answer and when it is not. You evaluate the problem before reaching for a tool, and you are as comfortable making the case against automating something as you are building it.</li> <li>Experience deploying AI agents or AI-assisted workflows in a production environment, including designing for failure, building in human oversight, and maintaining auditability.</li> <li>The ability to translate between operational needs and technical constraints in both directions, clearly, without jargon, and with the right level of detail for whoever is in the room.</li> <li>You document what you build. Not as an afterthought, as part of how you work.</li> <li>Writes and speaks fluent English.</li> <li>Experience working in a remote-first environment is a plus but not required.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Key Responsibilities </strong></h2> <h4>Automation & AI Development</h4> <ul> <li>Contribute to and lead delivery of CX automation and AI initiatives, from scoping and design through to production and ongoing iteration.</li> <li>Build and maintain AI agents and automated workflows that improve specialist effectiveness, reduce manual handling, and increase consistency across CX operations.</li> <li>Deploy AI capabilities responsibly: design for failure, ensure appropriate human oversight is built in, and maintain the logs and auditability expected in a customer-facing support environment.</li> <li>Stay across developments in AI and automation tooling, surface well-reasoned recommendations for your manager and the CX leadership team to evaluate.</li> </ul> <h4>CX Tooling & Systems</h4> <ul> <li>Own the technical delivery of CX tooling: the integrations, applications, and automated workflows that connect the platforms CX teams depend on every day.</li> <li>Build and maintain integrations across the CX technology stack, including Zendesk and its application framework, Remote's internal platform, REST APIs, webhooks, and emerging integration standards such as MCP, ensuring data flows correctly, triggers fire reliably, and tooling holds up under operational load.</li> <li>As Remote's customer and partner base grows, support the CX tooling requirements that come with it: new channels, new integrations, increasing complexity.</li> </ul> <h4>Programme Delivery & Documentation</h4> <ul> <li>Manage complex, multi-phase delivery: own dependencies, communicate proactively, and bring initiatives across the line without needing to be chased.</li> <li>Document everything you own. Accurate, accessible documentation is part of the definition of done, not something that happens later.</li> <li>Identify technical debt, undocumented processes, and fragile points in the CX automation stack and address them systematically.</li> </ul> <h4>Data & Continuous Improvement</h4> <ul> <li>Use operational data and CX performance metrics to inform priorities and validate what is working. Build visibility into the impact of automation for CX leadership.</li> <li>Define success metrics for each initiative, track them, and use them to make decisions about what to iterate on and what to stop.</li> </ul> <h4>Cross-functional Partnership</h4> <ul> <li>Work closely with CX operations and front-line teams to understand workflow pain points, validate solutions before they ship, and support adoption after they do.</li> <li>Partner with engineering, product, and data teams across Remote to align on architecture and escalate when a problem needs more than automation to solve.</li> <li>Communicate clearly and regularly with stakeholders at all levels: operational teams, CX leadership, and cross-functional partners.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h2><strong>Practicals</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>You'll report to:</strong> Senior Manager, CX Business Operations</li> <li><strong>Team:</strong> Customer Experience </li> <li><strong>Location</strong>: For this position we welcome everyone to apply, but we will prioritize applications from the following locations as we encourage our teams to diversify; EMEA or AMER</li> <li><strong>Start date:</strong> As soon as possible</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Application process</strong></h2> <ol> <li>Interview with recruiter</li> <li>Interview with future manager</li> <li>Interview with team members (no managers present)</li> <li>Interview with Executive</li> <li>Bar Raiser Interview</li> <li><a href="https://www.notion.so/Veremark-Remote-96e108c037b8423cbd4c3f07a1f9b38b">Prior employment verification check</a> </li> </ol><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>Remote's <a href="https://www.notion.so/remotecom/people-Total-Rewards-1945bce8d3924ece9421ba8630f57b0c">Total Rewards philosophy</a> is to ensure fair, unbiased compensation and fair <span class="link-annotation-unknown-block-id-1691622878">equity</span><span class="discussion-level-1 discussion-id-f2a82bc4-09e4-4a71-ad93-755b1d26a690 notion-enable-hover" data-token-index="3"> pay </span>along with competitive benefits in all locations in which we operate. We do not agree to or encourage cheap-labor practices and therefore we ensure to pay above in-location rates. We hope to inspire other companies to support global talent-hiring and bring local wealth to developing countries.</p> <p>At first glance our salary bands seem quite wide - here is some context. At Remote we have international operations and a globally distributed workforce.  We use geo ranges to consider geographic pay differentials as part of our global compensation strategy to remain competitive in various markets while we hiring globally.<br><br>Our salary ranges are determined by role, level and location, and our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay for the successful candidate in this role is dependent upon many factors such as location, transferable or job-related skills, work experience, relevant training, business needs, and market demands. The base salary range may be subject to change.<br><br><em data-stringify-ty

title: Staff Data Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>The climate crisis is the defining challenge of our time—but it’s also the greatest opportunity for innovation, and a challenge we’re proud to take on. At Overstory, we’re harnessing cutting-edge technology to enable a resilient electrical grid that keeps communities thriving as our world changes.</p> <p>The grid is the backbone of life as we know it. It powers hospitals, keeps food fresh, and ensures communities stay connected. But extreme weather, aging infrastructure, and growing wildfire risks are putting this critical system under pressure. All of this combined makes the electric utility industry the greatest opportunity for tackling climate change. </p> <p>One of the leading causes of catastrophic wildfires and power outages? Trees and brush coming into contact with power lines. </p> <p>That’s where we help. At Overstory, we use AI and advanced satellite imagery to pinpoint and prioritize vegetation risks before they materialize. By giving utilities critical analysis on those risks, we’re helping prevent outages, reduce wildfire risks, and accelerate the transition to a safer, more resilient grid.</p> <p>Our team spans the Americas and Europe, and we work with utility partners across the Americas and beyond. We’re outdoor enthusiasts, musicians, artists, athletes, parents, and adventurers. What unites us is a passion for solving complex problems, a commitment to climate action, and the belief that technology should be a force for good.</p> <p>Join us to help us build a more resilient world together. </p></div><h2>Role & Team</h2> <p>As a <strong>Staff Data Engineer</strong> at Overstory, you will lead the design and scaling of the data platform that enables Overstory’s AI-powered vegetation analysis. Our analysis depends on moving enormous volumes of satellite imagery, model inferences, and utility network data through orchestrated pipelines reliably, repeatably, and on time to support customer decision-making. You'll own the architecture of that platform and set the direction for how it evolves.</p> <p>You'll work closely with data, ML, and product engineers, as well as product teams, to make sure the data flowing into our models and out to our customers balances pragmatic delivery with durability, traceability, and scalability. As a senior technical leader, you'll mentor other engineers, drive architectural decisions, and set standards for pipeline design, service boundaries, and data quality across Overstory.</p> <p><strong>Time zone requirement: </strong>Europe (GMT/WET, CET, EET) and Eastern North America (NST, AST, EST)</p> <h2><strong>What You'll Do</strong></h2> <p>In collaboration with data, ML, and product colleagues, you will:</p> <ul> <li>Architect and evolve our orchestration layer — asset graphs, quality checks, partitioning strategies, and the patterns that keep it scaling reliably.</li> <li>Design and maintain production data pipelines for large-scale geospatial and temporal data, from ingestion through transformation to delivery.</li> <li>Lead system design work across the data platform, including service boundaries, data contracts, and designing around the failure modes that come with each.</li> <li>Drive the shift toward a service-oriented architecture, decoupling tightly bound components into services that teams can own and deploy independently.</li> <li>Build event-driven workflows, replacing brittle coupling and manual coordination with durable messaging patterns.</li> <li>Establish observability, testing, and data quality frameworks so problems surface before customers see them, allowing any result to be traced back and explained.</li> <li>Mentor engineers and define the standards for how we build, test, and operate data systems.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Skills & Experience</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience thriving at the intersection of data engineering, distributed systems, and large-scale scientific data; deeply motivated by the opportunity to reduce wildfire risk and improve grid resilience through better data patterns and infrastructure</li> <li>10+ years of experience designing and building production-grade data pipelines and systems</li> <li>Deep hands-on experience with <strong>Dagster</strong> — asset-based orchestration, partitions, sensors, and the operational side of running it in production (comparable experience with Airflow, Prefect, or similar is a reasonable substitute if you're ready to go deep on Dagster)</li> <li>Proven track record building and operating <strong>data pipelines</strong> at scale, with a real feel for idempotency, backfills, and partitioning</li> <li>Experience in preparing systems to handle periods of high demand with a focus on testability and scalability best practices</li> <li>Strong <strong>system design</strong> skills — you can reason about boundaries, contracts, coupling, and failure modes, and explain the tradeoffs to people who'll use and build on them</li> <li>Practical experience designing <strong>service-oriented architecture</strong>, including versioning and keeping things operational through migrations</li> <li>Strong <strong>Python</strong> skills and experience with <strong>Google Cloud</strong></li> <li>Experience with <strong>Pub/Sub</strong> and event-driven patterns</li> <li>Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate across engineering, ML, and product</li> <li>Comfortable leading architectural discussions and mentoring other engineers</li> <li>Experience in remote-first and globally distributed team</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Nice To Have</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Comfort working with geospatial data and the ways that it’s stored</li> <li>Experience building data pipelines that power ML training and inference</li> <li>Experience with analytics engineering tooling and warehouse modeling in BigQuery</li> <li>Infrastructure-as-code experience and comfort owning your systems in production</li> <li>Background in remote sensing, forestry, or the utility sector</li> </ul> <p><em><strong>Note:</strong> We believe that all people are capable of great things. We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet all of the requirements that are listed within this job description.</em></p> <h2><strong>What We Offer</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Competitive, location-specific compensation and benefits </li> <li>Flexible, autonomous and collaborative working environment rooted in trust - we build our work days around our lives, not the other way around</li> <li>Home office stipend, coworking and ongoing education budgets </li> <li>A company culture that genuinely embodies each of our core values</li> <li>To be part of truly mission-driven work that reduces wildfires, protects earth’s natural resources and helps solve our climate crisis</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><strong>About Our Team</strong></h2> <p data-pm-slice="1 1 []">We are a fast-growing team of about 100 people from all over the world. Fifteen nationalities are represented and at last count we speak fourteen languages: English, Dutch, French, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Luxembourgish, Lithuanian, Bulgarian, Finnish, Estonian, and Afrikaans.</p> <p>We work remotely from eleven countries and are looking for candidates that are living and working in one of them: United States, the Netherlands, United Kingdom, Ireland, Estonia, Portugal, France, Sweden, Switzerland, Denmark and Canada. We gather once a year in-person for our unforgettable team gathering event. We also offer the option to occasionally meet up for in-person collaboration. </p> <h2><strong>Diversity & Inclusion</strong></h2> <p>The climate crisis is a human crisis that requires diverse perspectives to solve. </p> <p>We place enormous value on diversity and believe that the best ideas emerge when people with different backgrounds and experience work together. We remain committed to scaling a team that reflects the communities we serve, and strive to uphold equitable and inclusive practices across every aspect of our business. We are responsible for creating and maintaining a culture where everyone - regardless of background - has a voice in building a sustainable future.</p> <h2><strong>Our Values</strong></h2> <h4><strong>Tackling the climate crisis is our greatest mission.</strong></h4> <p>We act with urgency.</p> <h4><strong>Our curiosity fuels our growth.</strong></h4> <p>We recognize that change is constant, and we find joy and power in exploration.</p> <h4><strong>We’re rooted in diversity.</strong></h4> <p>Just as ecosystems need biodiversity to thrive, our resiliency comes from our differences.</p> <h4><strong>We care for each other.</strong></h4> <p>We love the power of machines but we nurture each other as humans.</p> <h4><strong>Trust is fundamental.</strong></h4> <p>We assume the best in everyone, and we share ideas openly so that we have a positive impact.</p> <p>_________________________________</p> <p data-start="90" data-end="127"><strong data-start="90" data-end="125">Use of AI in Our Hiring Process</strong></p> <p><em>We sometimes use AI tools to support parts of our hiring process, such as helping us manage applications more efficiently or ensuring job descriptions are clear and inclusive. We have already achieved regulatory approval for three therapies and continue to advance promising science from academia into meaningful treatments for patients worldwide. </p> <h4><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Who We Are </span></h4> <p>BridgeBio is a global biotechnology company with our Global Headquarters located in San Francisco, USA, and our International HQ located in Zug, Switzerland. Since establishing our European presence in 2021, we’ve been building empowered, high-performing teams across countries — with experienced colleagues who move quickly, take ownership, and are fueling the company’s international growth. </p> <p>At BridgeBio, you’ll find an energetic and collaborative culture where pragmatism meets bold decision-making. In this role you ensure alignment of HEOR priorities with clinical value, launch timelines, and market access strategy.</p> <p>You will also be a core member of the International Market Access team, contributing HEOR and evidence-generation expertise to global decision-making and ensuring alignment across regions while representing diverse market perspectives.</p> <p>This role requires strong collaboration with cross-functional colleagues and external stakeholders across multiple countries to ensure high-quality execution and impact. 9+ years of experience with an MSc/MPH, or 7+ years with a PhD, in HEOR or related fields</li> <li>Extensive experience leading HTA submissions and pricing negotiations across multiple international markets, ideally including Europe, particularly in rare diseases and orphan conditions</li> <li>Direct experience engaging with HTA organizations such as NICE, CADTH, PBAC, HAS, IQWiG/G-BA, and ICER</li> <li>Demonstrated in-depth understanding of health economic modeling, patient-reported outcomes, statistics, and real-world evidence studies, including registries and observational study design, implementation, analysis, and interpretation</li> <li>Capable of independently managing complex, multicultural, cross-functional teams and non-interventional study projects on an international basis</li> <li>Strong project management abilities, including contracting, budgeting, and vendor management, with the ability to manage competing deadlines and rapidly shifting priorities</li> <li>Comfortably influencing senior stakeholders across medical, clinical, and commercial teams, and operating effectively within a matrix organization</li> <li>International mobility and willingness to travel internationally, approximately 10% of time</li> </ul> <h4><u>Rewarding Those Who Make the Mission Possible</u></h4> <p>We have high expectations for our team members. As an Applied ML Engineer, you’ll work at the intersection of machine learning research, experimentation, and production engineering. You’ll turn ideas from research papers into rigorous experiments, measurable evidence, and reliable products. The role spans model evaluation, model internals, inference infrastructure, backend systems, and user-facing product experiences. You’ll work hands-on with modern ML models, designing evaluations that reveal what methods can—and cannot—demonstrate. You’ll also build production-grade tooling that makes complex experiments repeatable, observable, and accessible to users. The environment values technical judgment, ownership, scientific rigor, and the ability to move comfortably across the technology stack. It’s an opportunity to help transform emerging ML techniques into practical systems that people can trust. Accountabilities Reproduce and evaluate machine learning research methods using open-weight and API-accessible models. Design evaluation datasets, probes, scoring approaches, baselines, calibration tests, and experiment harnesses. Work directly with model weights, logits, hidden states, activations, model APIs, and inference infrastructure when required. Build and extend evaluation infrastructure covering experiment runners, judges, persistence, orchestration, reporting, and reproducibility. Turn research workflows into intuitive product experiences, including experiment configuration, execution, traces, comparisons, reports, and review workflows. Investigate how verification methods behave when models are modified through fine-tuning, merging, quantization, distillation, safety removal, or deliberate evasion. Design controlled experiments that distinguish meaningful signals from artifacts, confounders, and misleading correlations. Produce clear technical reports that separate measured evidence from interpretation and hypotheses. Deliver production-quality systems with APIs, asynchronous jobs, databases, observability, testing, deployment, and documentation. Contribute across research, experimentation, engineering, and product as priorities evolve. During the first six months, reproduce and document at least one published model-provenance or verification method, including its capabilities, assumptions, and limitations. Build a repeatable model-verification runner with versioned inputs, artifacts, metrics, and reports, and make at least one verification workflow accessible through the product interface. Run controlled experiments across base, fine-tuned, merged, quantized, and known distilled models, improving understanding of when verification methods succeed, fail, and why. Requirements: Strong Python engineering skills, with hands-on experience using PyTorch and Hugging Face Transformers. Solid understanding of machine learning evaluation, including dataset design, baselines, metrics, calibration, false positives and negatives, statistical uncertainty, and reproducibility. Ability to read ML research papers critically and implement methods from first principles rather than relying entirely on existing packages. Professional software engineering experience beyond notebooks, including APIs, asynchronous jobs, databases, logging, testing, deployment, and documentation. Familiarity with open-weight models and a practical understanding of how modern LLM inference systems operate. Ability to work across backend and frontend boundaries, with sufficient React/TypeScript knowledge to help make complex experiments and results understandable to users. Strong experimental and analytical judgment, particularly around distinguishing what evidence demonstrates from what it merely suggests. High ownership and initiative, with the ability to identify problems, propose solutions, and drive projects forward independently. Comfort working in a fast-moving startup environment where priorities can change quickly and engineers may operate across multiple functions. A strong commitment to producing production-quality code, tests, tooling, and documentation that other engineers can confidently operate and extend. We are looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer to join our collaborative and impact-driven Data & Analytics team. You will act as a senior strategic partner to the business, bridging the gap between deep technical modeling and business strategy to power how Dashlane makes decisions.</p> <p>You will be a key driver in transforming our team from a reactive support function into a proactive, strategic powerhouse. Your work will directly shape how Dashlane measures success, from building out robust, AI-ready data foundations to delivering actionable insights that directly impact our bottom line. You will tackle complex data architecture problems, empower the organisation through self-service, and act as a force multiplier by mentoring peers and upskilling stakeholders.</p> <p>If you are passionate about treating data as a product, succeed in autonomy, and want to have a massive, visible impact on a thriving B2B/B2C SaaS business, this role is for you.<br><br></p> <p><strong>Location-Specific Information:</strong> </p> <p>You will be based in Paris, with English as your working language. At Dashlane, we embrace a hybrid culture that combines the best of both worlds: the creativity and energy of in-person collaboration with the flexibility of remote work. Our model is designed to strengthen team connections while supporting individual productivity and work-life balance. To maximize collaboration, we come together in the office on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays, while Wednesdays and Fridays offer more flexibility for focused work. <br><br></p> <p><strong>At Dashlane, you will:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build & own complex data models: Design, build, test, and own end-to-end data models within our dbt-powered “Unified Data Model”. Move beyond reactive "support desk" requests to uncover underlying business problems and deliver proactive, data-driven insights that drive measurable outcomes (shifting the conversation from "what happened" to "what's next").<br><br></li> <li>Champion self-service & upskill stakeholders: Be a primary driver of our self-service analytics culture. You will guide stakeholders toward scalable, self-serve solutions in Omni, gently pushing back on ad-hoc dashboard requests to upskill the organisation and scale autonomy.<br><br></li> <li>Pioneer AI data agents & automation: Implement AI data agents and the necessary underlying foundations to automate reporting and alerting for key business metrics, bringing an AI-first mindset to maximise the team's efficiency.<br><br></li> <li>Elevate data governance & the team: Implement and maintain data quality tests and governance best practices to ensure trust in our data. As a senior technical contributor, you will mentor more junior engineers, proactively improve team processes, and help raise the technical bar.<br><br></li> </ul> <p><strong>Requirements:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have 5+ years of experience in an Analytics Engineering position or equivalent role.<br><br></li> <li>You are an expert in SQL and dbt, with deep, hands-on experience designing, deploying, and maintaining complex data models in a production environment.<br><br></li> <li>You have strong strategic business acumen and a deep understanding of the B2B SaaS engine. You speak the language of ARR, NRR, churn, and product-led growth.<br><br></li> <li>You possess highly consultative stakeholder management skills. You don't just take tickets; you uncover the true business need, drive alignment, and take proactive ownership of initiatives from end to end.<br><br></li> <li>You are an "AI Champion." Every donation will be matched by Dashlane</li> <li>Team buildings & seasonal social events</li> <li>Weekly lunch in the office and monthly happy hour</li> <li>and many more!</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging at Dashlane:</strong></p> <p>As a truly international company—founded in France and <span style="color: #172b4d;">distributed across</span> France, US and Portugal—Dashlane thrives off diverse perspectives.
