title: Associate Director, Supply Chain
description: <p><strong>Associate Director, Supply Chain</strong></p> <p><strong>Company:</strong>  Cycle Pharmaceuticals Ltd</p> <p><strong>Position Summary: </strong>This is a full-time position leading our Supply Chain department, working in our Cambridge office on a hybrid basis (minimum 3 days in the office).  </p> <p> </p> <p><strong>The Opportunity</strong></p> <p>We have an exciting opportunity for an Associate Director of Supply Chain to lead our supply chain function within the business. You’ll combine your strategic ownership with hands-on execution shaping our global supply chain strategy ensuring, reliable, compliant and cost-effective product supply to patients through an outsourced partner network.</p> <p>This includes managing relationships with contract manufacturers, packaging and logistics providers, distributors, serialisation partners and other critical external suppliers to ensure a resilient, compliant and responsive supply chain.</p> <p>Reporting to the Chief Operations and Regulatory Officer, you will work closely with Executive Leadership and colleagues across Regulatory Affairs, Quality Assurance, Commercial and Finance, as well as a diverse network of external partners. You will also lead and develop the Supply Chain function, creating the capability, relationships and ways of working needed to support continued growth.</p> <p>This is a role for a commercially minded and collaborative supply chain leader who enjoys operating in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment. You will have the autonomy to shape strategy, solve complex supply challenges and drive continuous improvement, while helping build a supply chain capable of supporting the next stage of the company's growth.</p> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>Our Company </strong></p> <p>At Cycle Pharmaceuticals, we believe that <strong>Every Single Patient Matters</strong>. This is at the heart of why we work. As we look to grow, we’re now looking for people to join our team who share our vision. We know that life-changing treatments need life-improving product support to match, because when you put the two together, great things can happen.</p> <p>Our core focus areas include rare metabolic, oncology, immunological, and neurological genetic conditions, where we improve existing drugs, repurpose them for new uses, and bring generics back to market. Using cutting-edge drug delivery technologies, we enhance the efficiency of treatments, offering patients greater freedom and choice.</p> <p>If you want to know more about what we do then, why not check out our website below and look at some of our patient stories: <a href="https://cyclepharma.com/patient-advocacy/patient-stories/">Patient Stories - Cycle Pharma</a></p> <p> </p> <p><strong>What you’ll be doing in this role:</strong></p> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>Supply Chain Strategy, Planning and Operations</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop and execute supply chain strategies aligned to commercial priorities, product launches, lifecycle management and the organisation’s broader growth ambitions.</li> <li>Provide clear, evidence-based, risk-adjusted recommendations on supply priorities, inventory trade-offs, supplier performance and escalation requirements, enabling timely, transparent and commercially informed decision-making.</li> <li>Provide strategic oversight of the end-to-end supply chain, including demand and supply planning, inventory management, manufacturing scheduling, distribution and product availability, ensuring a reliable and responsive supply network.</li> <li>Lead the Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) process, bringing together commercial forecasts, customer demand, inventory strategy and manufacturing capacity to create a clear, aligned view of supply and demand. Proactively identify, communicate and mitigate emerging risks.</li> <li>Establish and optimise inventory policies and supply strategies that balance product availability, supply resilience, risk and working capital requirements.</li> <li>Define and maintain meaningful supply chain KPIs and performance measures, using data and insight to identify opportunities, strengthen accountability and drive continuous improvement across the supply network.</li> <li>Support business development initiatives, new product introductions and other growth initiatives, assessing supply chain requirements and developing scalable, compliant and fit-for-purpose supply solutions.</li> <li>Own the annual Supply Chain budget, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, optimise costs and deliver value while maintaining regulatory compliance, supply resilience and product availability.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Supply Chain Governance and Operational Excellence</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead strategic relationships with contract manufacturers, packaging providers, logistics partners, distributors, serialization providers and other critical supply chain partners, ensuring clear accountability and delivery against agreed service, quality and business requirements.</li> <li>Establish and maintain effective supplier governance, including structured performance reviews, service-level management, quality oversight, issue resolution and improvement plans, ensuring external partners consistently meet expectations.</li> <li>Work closely with Quality Assurance and relevant functions to ensure the external supply network operates in accordance with applicable GxP, GDP, DSCSA and other regulatory requirements.</li> <li>Lead the resolution and escalation of complex supply, quality, compliance and operational issues, coordinating internal teams and external partners to minimise business impact and protect product availability.</li> <li>Drive the development of scalable supply chain processes, improving visibility, data quality, operational efficiency and ways of working as the organisation and product portfolio grow.</li> <li>Provide governance and oversight of critical supply chain systems and data, including ERP, serialization, GS1 and inventory management platforms, ensuring robust master data, system integrity and reliable reporting.</li> <li>Establish a culture of accountability and continuous improvement across the external supply network, using supplier performance insights, operational data and emerging risks to identify and deliver sustainable improvements.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>People Leadership</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead and develop the Supply Chain function, setting clear priorities, expectations and ways of working while creating a culture of ownership, collaboration, continuous improvement and high performance.</li> <li>Build team capability and succession strength through coaching, mentoring and targeted development, ensuring the function has the skills, expertise and capacity to support the organisation’s future growth.</li> <li>Develop strong, collaborative relationships with senior stakeholders, providing clear supply chain insight and challenge to support informed business decisions and representing Supply Chain effectively across cross-functional leadership and governance forums.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>The following skills and experience will be important in helping you to succeed </strong><strong>in this role:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Degree (or equivalent experience) in Supply Chain Management, Business Operations, or Life Sciences.</li> <li>Significant pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or healthcare supply chain experience, including leadership responsibility for outsourced manufacturing and distribution networks.</li> <li>Collaborative mindset with the ability to work across cross-functional teams and build strong internal and external relationships. </li> <li>Strong understanding of demand planning, inventory management, contract manufacturing, logistics, supplier management, and supply chain compliance.</li> <li>Knowledge of GDP, DSCSA, serialisation, and global pharmaceutical supply chain regulations.</li> <li>Experience leading cross-functional projects, product launches, and business-critical supply chain initiatives.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and manage complex external partnerships.</li> <li>Excellent analytical, leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>What can we offer to you:</strong></p> <p>In addition to being part of a great team and doing things that will make a real difference to patients’ lives, you will enjoy all the benefits that brings:</p> <ul> <li>A collaborative high performing work environment</li> <li>Performance based bonus</li> <li>Opportunity to join a fast growing and ambitious business</li> <li>Company pension scheme</li> <li>100% employer paid membership for Private Health Insurance</li> <li>Life and Critical Illness Insurance</li> <li>Corporate Gym membership</li> <li>Regular team building events and an agile working environment</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Diversity and Inclusion statement:</strong></p> <p><em>At Cycle Pharmaceuticals, we are committed to creating an inclusive, respectful, positive and diverse workplace. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, colour, religion, gender, age, </em><em>disability, or any other protected characteristic. We actively support and embrace diversity, and we are working to build a team that reflects a wide range of backgrounds and perspectives.</em></p> <p><em>We value your unique contributions and encourage you to join us in shaping a more inclusive future. If you require any reasonable adjustments - whether during the application process or in the workplace - we will be happy to support your needs. At Cycle, equality, inclusion, and respect are at the core of everything we do. We fully comply with all applicable employment laws, including those related to non-discrimination, work authorization, and employment eligibility verification.</em></p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Software Engineer – Front-End
description: <p>At Speechmatics, we’re expanding our user platform offering. We're looking for a Senior Front-End Software Engineer with a strong product mindset to help drive that growth. This is an opportunity to own end-to-end feature development at a leading-edge AI company, from shaping the user experience through to shipping and iterating based on real user feedback and analytics data.</p> <p><strong><u>What you'll do</u></strong></p> <ul> <li>Own product features from ideation through to delivery, contributing to UX thinking, frontend execution, and post-launch iteration</li> <li>Build polished, accessible user interfaces using React, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS</li> <li>Make UX and UI decisions independently, collaborating closely with designers and PMs rather than waiting on detailed handoffs</li> <li>Design and run A/B tests to validate product decisions and surface insights that improve the user experience</li> <li>Use analytics tooling such as Mixpanel to understand how people interact with the product and feed that learning back into what gets built</li> <li>Partner with backend engineers, product managers, and designers to ship features that genuinely move the needle for users and the business</li> <li>Write and maintain robust UI tests, taking ownership of quality in production and at scale</li> <li>Run user interviews and meet customers to understand how people use the product and what drives adoption</li> </ul> <p><strong><u>What you'll need</u></strong></p> <ul> <li>Proficiency in React, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS with a track record of shipping production-quality frontend code</li> <li>A product-minded engineering approach</li> <li>Comfort owning UX and UI decisions independently</li> <li>Hands-on experience with iterative development practices, including A/B testing and feature experimentation</li> <li>Familiarity with user analytics tools such as Mixpanel or a comparable platform</li> <li>Experience with UI testing frameworks and a solid grounding in frontend engineering best practices</li> <li>Confidence collaborating cross-functionally with designers, PMs, and backend engineers</li> <li>A track record of using user feedback and data to improve features</li> </ul> <p><strong><u>Nice to have</u></strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience using coding agents (eg Claude, Codex, OpenCode) to improve productivity and code quality</li> <li>Exposure to backend development, including RESTful APIs and cloud deployments</li> <li>Experience conducting or participating in user interviews as part of a product discovery process</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em><span class="ui-provider a b c d e f g h i j k l m n o p q r s t u v w x y z ab ac ae af ag ah ai aj ak">We encourage you to apply even if you do not feel If you are interested in the role, the team, and our mission, we would love to consider your application. We are always open to conversations and look forward to hearing from you.</span></em></p> <p><strong>Who we are:</strong></p> <p class="p1">Speechmatics is the leading expert in Speech Intelligence, and uses AI and Machine Learning to unlock business value in human speech worldwide. We work with an amazing mix of global companies, and our technology can integrate into our customers stack irrespective of their industry or use case – making it the go-to solution to harness useful information from speech.</p> <p class="p1">Joining us means working with some of the smartest minds around the world, focused on cutting-edge projects and deploying the latest techniques to disrupt the market. We believe in putting people first; we’ll do all we can to help you develop your skills and give you the tools you need to thrive. Our Focus Fridays give you an undisturbed day of focus, offset with Together Tuesdays when we have our team meetings, so you've always got the right balance.</p> <p class="p1">We have structured a hybrid approach that includes 2-3 designated office days each week. This arrangement ensures that while we embrace the advantages of remote work, we also maintain the vital connection and synergy that only in-person interactions can foster.</p> <p class="p1">This is only the beginning; we’re looking for amazing people like you to continue our journey…</p> <p class="p1"><strong>What we can offer you:<br></strong></p> <p class="p1">No matter what stage of your career you’re at - from paid internships and first-job opportunities through to management and senior positions - we’ll support you with the training and development needed to reach your career aspirations with us. There really is no shortage of opportunities here for you to get involved and collaborate with those around you to deliver your best work.</p> <p class="p1">We offer incredibly flexible working, regular company lunches, and birthday celebrations. From Private Medical, and Dental for you and your family, through to global working opportunities, a generous holiday allowance and pension/401K matching, we want to make sure our employees and their families are looked after. Every employee will receive a working from home allowance for tech or home office equipment (on top of your choice of laptop and accessories of course). Our approach to parental leave is designed to support employees globally. title: ML Data & Platform Engineer
description: <p>We're looking for an ML Data & Platform Engineer to own the infrastructure that powers our speech AI models: the pipelines that source and prepare training data, and the platform that trains, evaluates, and serves them in production. production faster.</p> <p>This is a broad, cross-functional role suited to someone who enjoys working across the full stack: data infrastructure, distributed systems, and production ML, and who takes ownership of problems end to end rather than waiting to be told what to fix.</p> <p><strong>What you'll do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Designing, building, and maintaining scalable data pipelines for ingesting, transforming, validating, and storing large datasets used to train our models</li> <li>Developing and maintaining web scraping and data acquisition solutions to keep training datasets fresh, high-quality, and available at scale</li> <li>Building and operating the infrastructure that lets the ML team deploy and evaluate new models quickly, and that serves models efficiently and reliably in production</li> <li>Optimising infrastructure for both iteration speed and production reliability, including GPU utilisation, job scheduling, and training efficiency</li> <li>Implementing observability (monitoring, logging, alerting) across data pipelines and ML systems to catch issues early and keep things running smoothly</li> <li>Troubleshooting complex issues across distributed Als Werkstudent Grafikdesign (m/w/d) arbeitest du an echten Projekten mit, deren Ergebnisse gedruckt, verschickt und in ganz Deutschland getragen werden. Aufgaben Deine Verantwortlichkeiten Print: Du gestaltest Layouts, Vorlagen und Elemente für Abschlusszeitungen, die an über zwei Drittel aller Schulen in Deutschland gehen. Textil: Wir bauen unser Textilgeschäft gerade neu auf. Du entwirfst Motive und Prints für Hoodies und Shirts mit. Produkt: Du arbeitest mit unserem Product-Team an den Layouts und Design-Elementen in der nuggit App. Social Media: Du unterstützt unser Social-Media-Team mit Grafiken, Templates und visuellen Formaten für Instagram und TikTok. Marke: Du hilfst dabei, unser Design-System und unseren Markenauftritt weiterzuentwickeln. Qualifikation Was du mitbringst Du bist an einer Hochschule oder Universität in Deutschland eingeschrieben, idealerweise in Kommunikationsdesign, Grafikdesign oder einem ähnlichen Fach, und hast noch mindestens ein Jahr Studium vor dir. Du nutzt AI, um schneller und besser zu arbeiten. AI ersetzt dich nicht, aber du holst mit ihr mehr aus deiner Arbeit heraus. Viel Raum, um dich auszuprobieren, in Print, Textil, Produkt und Social Media. Direkter Austausch mit dem Gründer, kurze Wege, schnelle Entscheidungen. title: Technicien d'entretien - Parlant français
description: La philosophie PureGym Membre du groupe international PureGym , nous sommes le deuxième plus grand opérateur européen de salles de sport . Avec plus de 700 salles à travers le monde , nous sommes actuellement présents au Royaume-Uni, aux États-Unis, en Arabie saoudite, en Suisse et au Danemark. Nous formons une équipe dynamique et internationale animée par notre mission : améliorer la santé et le bien-être de la population. Notre objectif est d’offrir à tous, partout dans le monde, une expérience de remise en forme de grande qualité et abordable. Nous proposons : · Un abonnement gratuit à la salle de sport pour vous + 1 personne · Des avantages exclusifs grâce à notre programme d’avantages sociaux, comprenant des réductions substantielles sur une large gamme de produits et de services, tant au sein de nos salles de sport qu’auprès d’autres prestataires externes · Nos bureaux sont situés dans l’agglomération de Zurich et disposent d’un accès direct à la salle de sport · Nos horaires de travail sont flexibles · Nous offrons 25 jours de congés + 1 jour de congé personnel Le poste Lieu : Romandie / Berne / Seeland bernois - Base de terrain Type : Temps plein Type de contrat : Permanent Une opportunité passionnante de rejoindre PureGym en tant que technicien d'installations ! Notre équipe de gestion des installations veille chaque jour à ce que les clubs PureGym de toute la Suisse soient sûrs, opérationnels et prêts à accueillir les adhérents. En étroite collaboration avec la direction des clubs, nos collègues internes et nos prestataires externes, nous coordonnons la maintenance, les réparations, les activités de mise en conformité et les améliorations continues au sein d’un portefeuille national de clubs en pleine expansion. En tant que technicien de gestion des installations, vous serez un membre clé de l’équipe sur le terrain, principalement basé en Romandie et effectuant régulièrement des missions en Suisse romande. Ce poste implique des déplacements quotidiens entre les différents clubs. En tant que technicien de maintenance, vous apporterez un soutien technique sur le terrain aux clubs PureGym, principalement en Suisse romande et en partie en Suisse alémanique, en veillant à ce que les installations soient sûres, fonctionnelles et bien entretenues grâce à des réparations, de la maintenance préventive, des inspections et le dépannage technique. Vos principales responsabilités : Effectuer des réparations mineures sur les équipements de fitness, les portes, les installations sanitaires, le mobilier, les vestiaires, les douches et les espaces communs des clubs Effectuer la maintenance préventive, le dépannage technique et les inspections régulières des clubs Traiter et mettre à jour les ordres de travail dans le système de gestion numérique des tickets (ServiceChannel) Identifier les défauts et signaler les problèmes récurrents ou critiques pour la sécurité Inspecter et consigner l’état des appareils électriques portables après avoir suivi une formation adéquate et obtenu l’autorisation nécessaire Participer aux contrôles relatifs à l’hygiène de l’eau, à l’éclairage de secours, à la sécurité incendie, aux issues de secours et à la sécurité opérationnelle Coordonner les visites des petits prestataires et vérifier les travaux réalisés sur place Apporter son soutien lors des nouvelles ouvertures, des rénovations, des remises en service techniques et des projets de moindre envergure Transporter les outils, les pièces de rechange et le petit matériel d’un club à l’autre Entretenir de manière responsable le véhicule de fonction, les outils, les appareils de test et les stocks Ce à quoi vous pouvez vous attendre : Un poste varié, sur le terrain, offrant une grande autonomie Un véhicule de fonction entièrement équipé, des outils et du matériel de contrôle Des formations techniques et des opportunités de développement professionnel Un impact direct sur le fonctionnement du club et l'expérience des membres Pas d’astreinte Le salaire et les avantages sociaux seront discutés avec les candidats intéressés lors d’un premier entretien téléphonique avec les RH Profil recherché Formation professionnelle achevée dans un métier technique ou artisanal, tel que concierge, plombier, peintre, mécanicien ou équivalent Expérience pratique dans le domaine des réparations, de l’entretien ou de la gestion des bâtiments Bonnes compétences pratiques et connaissances de base des installations techniques et des systèmes techniques du bâtiment Volonté de suivre une formation pour l'inspection des appareils électriques portables Maîtrise des smartphones, des tablettes et des systèmes de billetterie numérique Style de travail autonome, structuré et axé sur les solutions Fiabilité, sens du service et rigueur dans la documentation des travaux Des déplacements quotidiens sont à prévoir dans toute la Suisse ; le fait de résider en Suisse romande ou dans les cantons de Berne ou de Fribourg constitue un atout Langues La maîtrise parfaite du français, à l’écrit comme à l’oral, est obligatoire Une bonne maîtrise de l'anglais ou de l'allemand est requise Permis de conduire Un permis de conduire de catégorie B en cours de validité est obligatoire Disponibilité à utiliser un véhicule de fonction pour des missions dans toute la Suisse Merci de postuler en joignant un CV en anglais ! Rejoignez-nous dans notre mission : offrir à tous, partout, un accès à une activité physique de haute qualité et abordable. PureGym est fier d’être un employeur garantissant l’égalité des chances. title: Automation Engineer, 80-100%

Angefangen mit Geschwindigkeits- und Drehzahlmessern für Personenwagen über Motorrad- und Fahrradtachos, Sensoren, Steuermodule und weitere spannende Produkte ist die Veratron AG heute das Kompetenzzentrum für Elektronik-Systeme mit Schwerpunkt auf den Märkten Sonderfahrzeuge und Freizeitschifffahrt. In einem kleinen, engagierten Team arbeitest du hands-on an der Entwicklung moderner Softwarelösungen, die direkt in unseren Produktions- und Prüfanlagen eingesetzt werden. Deine Arbeit hat unmittelbaren Einfluss auf unsere Fertigungsprozesse – von der ersten Idee über die Konzeption bis hin zur Inbetriebnahme und kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung der Lösungen. Wir bieten dir Gestaltungsspielraum für deine fachliche und kreative Entfaltung, kurze Entscheidungswege sowie ein hohes Mass an Eigenverantwortung. Dabei übernimmst du Verantwortung für deine Themen und gestaltest aktiv mit, wie softwaregestützte Produktionslösungen bei uns entstehen und wachsen. YOUR PLAYGROUND Du entwickelst Softwarelösungen für unsere Produktions- und Prüfanlagen im Bereich Production Engineering In deiner Rolle planst und realisierst du Projekte im Betriebsmittelbau, von der Konzeption über die Umsetzung (inkl. Bestellungen) und Inbetriebnahme Bestehende Prozesse und Softwarelösungen betreust, wartest und entwickelst du kontinuierlich weiter – in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Produktion und Engineering Du stellst den Betrieb sowie die Wartung produktionsnaher Datennetzwerke und Server sicher Die fachliche Unterstützung und das Coaching von Informatik-Lernenden gehören ebenfalls zu deinem Aufgabenbereich YOUR PROFILE kreativ innovativ mutig / offen für Neues / lösungsorientiert / bodenständig / selbstständig / eigenverantwortung Eine technische Grundausbildung, ergänzt durch eine weiterführende Aus- oder Weiterbildung auf Stufe HF oder FH (abhängig von Ausbildung und Berufserfahrung), bildet deine Basis Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung im industriellen Umfeld bringst du für diese Position mit Fundierte Kenntnisse in der C‑Programmierung (National Instruments CVI C) werden vorausgesetzt; Erfahrung mit SPS‑Systemen, idealerweise Siemens S7, ist ein Pluspunkt Das Zusammenspiel von Software, Elektronik und Mechanik begeistert dich und motiviert dich in deiner täglichen Arbeit Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift runden dein Profil ab YOUR BENEFITS Flexible Arbeitszeiten Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten Vergünstigte Kantine Vorteils-Abonnement im Fitnesscenter inhouse Schnelle Kommunikationswege und flache Hierarchien Klingt spannend? From lithium for electric vehicle batteries, to copper for wind turbines, and rare earth elements for electronics, these minerals are the building blocks of our energy transition. Lithosquare radically speeds up mineral exploration by combining foundational AI, geological expertise, and real-world data to reduce uncertainty, prioritize the right targets, reduce costs and accelerate discovery. Based in Paris, Lithosquare gathered an exceptional team of geologists, scientists, AI engineers, and data specialists to work as one, from field sampling to model optimization and push the boundaries of what's possible. About the job As a Geologist at Lithosquare, you will play a key hybrid role at the intersection of field operation (around 20%) and office work (80%). You will support field campaign execution while actively contributing to data compilation, targeting, and QA/QC across our exploration portfolio. This is a dynamic, cross-functional role: you will divide your time between field work (reconnaissance, sampling, drilling support) and office work in Paris, working closely with senior geologists, data scientists, and AI engineers. We are looking for someone rigorous, curious about technological innovation, and eager to learn while helping build the next generation of AI-assisted exploration tools. What you'll do Reporting to the Senior Geologists and the VP Asset Development, your main responsibilities will include: Field Execution & Support: Support and participate in all phases of field exploration programs, including regional reconnaissance, surface sampling, geophysical surveys, and drilling campaigns. Assist with field logistics while ensuring compliance with international health, safety, and environmental (HSE) standards. Data Compilation & QA/QC: Lead geological data entry, compilation, and QA/QC processes to ensure the accuracy, consistency, and integrity of exploration datasets across all projects. Office Work: Assist senior geologists with geological data interpretation to support exploration targeting, field campaign planning, technical reporting, GIS mapping, data management, and project evaluation. Contribute to the preparation of maps, presentations, and technical documentation. Bridge Geology & AI Tech: Work closely with the tech and AI teams to test, refine, and improve Lithosquare’s AI platform, ensuring our digital tools reflect field realities and technical needs. Reporting & Collaboration: Prepare clear technical summaries, data visualizations, and maps for internal reviews and partner updates. What we are looking for Minimum 3 years of experience in mineral exploration geology Degree in Geology or Earth Sciences , with solid foundations in metallogeny, structural geology, or geochemistry First significant field exposure (mapping, sampling, or core logging) with a willingness to spend significant time in the field as required by projects Data-driven & Rigorous: A structured approach to data management, QA/QC, and documentation; familiarity with GIS software (QGIS, ArcGIS) and/or geological modeling software is a plus Tech-curious & Innovative mindset: Genuine interest in how AI and technology can transform traditional exploration methods Strong Communication: Ability to collaborate effectively in a multi-disciplinary team (geologists, data scientists, AI engineers), interact professionally with partners and produce clear, synthetic & high-quality deliverables Mission-driven: Passionate about the energy transition and solving complex physical-world challenges through innovation Fluency in English is required with previous exposure to international exchanges Valid Driver's License (Permis B) is a bonus Perks & Benefits 🏢 Offices located in the heart of Paris 🌱 Strong culture of ownership & entrepreneurship 🌍 Opportunity to significantly contribute to energy transition 👥 Collaborative work environment with world-class experts in geology, AI, and data science 🔄 Flexible work arrangements enabling work-life balance 🚴 Sustainable mobility allowance ( Forfait Mobilité Durable ) 🏋️ Gym pass 🎉 Frequent team drinks, events & regular off-sites 💰 Competitive salary package 🍽️ Meal vouchers and health insurance coverage (Alan) Join Lithosquare and become part of a passionate team driving innovation at the intersection of AI and Earth exploration. Contracts You review, redline and negotiate the agreements that close our deals: MSAs, service agreements, order forms, SOWs, NDAs and DPAs, with clubs, leagues, federations, broadcasters and brands, often across several countries. In the coming agentic web, Google’s ad‑driven model has no natural home. Search for AI must be rebuilt from the ground up . We are reconstructing the web as a rigorously structured knowledge layer, mapping every concept, entity, and claim into a coherent semantic graph. Humans search Google; AI searches Linkup. Our Mission Reality never stands still, and neither should intelligence. Wir ermöglichen die Verbindung von Chips mit Hochdurchsatz-Computernetzwerken bei minimaler Latenz. Dadurch können unzählige Chips miteinander interagieren, als wären sie ein einziges System. Unsere Graphen-Photonik-Innovation hebt Rechenleistung und Effizienz auf ein neues Niveau. Kurz gesagt: Wir vernetzen Chips zu leistungsstarken, energieeffizienten Systemen und überwinden mit unserer Graphen-Technologie die bisherigen Grenzen der Konnektivität in der Halbleiterindustrie. title: Flight Control Automation Engineer (m/f/d)
description: As a Flight Control Automation Engineer, you will play a key role in our mission aircraft team and ensure seamless operation and interaction of complex aircraft functions. As part of Quantum Systems’ aircraft division, you’ll contribute to one of the most exciting German aviation projects of the years to come. Working closely with the team around our aircraft activities, your role can span across multiple disciplines — from hands‑on technical work to system‑level responsibility. Our focus is on getting large airborne platforms into the air and ready for real operational use. What is your Day-to-Day Mission: Design, implement, and validate functions for automatic waypoint navigation and path planning Automate complex vehicle operations like pre-flight checks or test and maintenance procedures Derive operator interfaces for simplified vehicle operations Interact with various external avionics and payload components Develop software for safety-critical applications according to processes from requirements to test artifacts What you bring to the team: You have a Master’s degree in the field of aerospace engineering (or similar course of studies). You already have at least 1 year of professional experience in aerospace engineering with hands-on experience using MATLAB, Simulink, and Stateflow. Further programming languages are beneficial. You are knowledgeable about aircraft and flight operations. You are interested in automation and safety-critical software development. Your open, communicative, very friendly and competent manner makes it easy for you to be seen as an internal expert. You are highly self-motivated and drive your area of responsibility forward independently. Communication in English is a matter of course for you. Why Quantum-Systems: We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus. We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary. We push limits, think outside-the-box and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data. We promise to be your runway for individual and professional growth. Our benefits: Company pension scheme: We support you so that you can already make provisions for later. Flexible working hours: With trust-based working hours, you are not only responsible for your working hours, but also for your work-life balance. Mobile Work: If things get a little busy in the office, you have the option to work remotely one flexible day per week to create the right balance. Stay active: With EGYM Wellpass, you get access to thousands of fitness and sports facilities — and of course, we subsidize the membership. Bike-Leasing: We support you in staying environmentally mobile and healthy. Corporate Benefits: Your opportunity for attractive offers and discounts from well-known suppliers and brands, e.g. Adidas, Apple, Expedia. Employee events: We not only want to grow together, but also celebrate our successes together. Lunch-Card: Be powerful with delicious energy, daily lunch budget is sponsored. Company Shuttle: Enjoy our convenient shuttle service that picks you up from Pasing in Munich and brings you to our location, with return trips at the end of the workday. About us: Quantum Systems specialises in the development, design, and production of small Unmanned Aerial Systems (sUAS). The company’s range of electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) sUAS are built to maximize range and versatility and to provide operators with a seamless user experience. By integrating cutting-edge software capabilities, like edge computing and real-time AI-powered data processing, Quantum Systems is building next-generation UAS for clients in defence, security, public sectors. AI is not a side tool here, it's core to how you work: you'll use Claude and similar AI tools daily to plan, build, debug, and document, including managing context and memory across projects, integrating AI directly into your version control workflow, and running parallel agent workflows on separate tasks, cutting repetitive tasks so you can focus where it actually moves the needle. We believe a small team of engineers working closely with AI can outperform a much larger traditional data team, and we're building this role around that belief, not around AI as an occasional convenience. If you're excited by complex systems, high traffic, and data-driven decisions, and impact matters more to you than process, we want to hear from you. We use AI for everything in order to improve speed and quality. What You’ll Own: Data Pipelines & Integration: You design, develop, and maintain scalable ETL pipelines on Databricks to integrate data from various sources, including app and web products and marketing partner data, ensuring reliable and efficient data flow across the business. Data Lakehouse Ownership: You build and manage the Data Lakehouse on Databricks, including migrating legacy data products, and implement data transformations and processing logic using Databricks and PySpark. Monitoring & Optimization: You monitor and maintain the data stack for nightly and near-real-time processing of in-house tracking solutions, continuously optimizing and troubleshooting pipelines to ensure data quality and integrity. Analysis & Insight: You also turn open business questions into decision-ready analysis when that's where the highest-value work is, not just build the pipelines that feed it. AI-Native Workflow: You use Claude and similar AI tools daily, not occasionally, to plan, build, debug, and document your pipelines, treating AI as a core part of the job rather than an add-on. Version Control & Worktrees: You integrate AI directly into your version control workflow, using Git worktrees (or an equivalent) to run several AI-assisted branches of work side by side, rather than treating AI and your codebase as separate. Context & Memory Management: You maintain structured project context for your AI tools, for example a CLAUDE.md-style instructions file, so they stay accurate and useful as pipelines and codebases grow, rather than relying on ad hoc prompts each time. Parallel Agentic Work: You run multiple AI coding agents on separate tickets at the same time where it makes sense, reviewing and integrating their output rather than writing every line serially yourself. AI-Assisted Communication: You're comfortable using AI to help manage day-to-day coordination, including in Slack, when it's the faster and more reliable way to keep things moving. Cross-Functional Collaboration: You move fluidly across data engineering, machine learning, data science, and analytics work, depending on where the team needs you most, rather than staying fixed in one discipline. Staying Ahead: You stay updated with industry best practices and emerging technologies in data engineering and applied AI, bringing new ideas and approaches to the team. What You Bring Technical Foundation: You have a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Data Science, or a related field, or bootcamp experience, with a minimum of 4 years of professional experience across data engineering, machine learning, data science, or analytics. Cross-Disciplinary Range: You have real experience in at least two of data engineering, machine learning, data science, or analytics, and you're comfortable picking up the others as the role demands. Current, Deep Databricks Experience: You are proficient in designing, implementing, and optimizing ETL processes on Databricks, with at least a year of current, hands-on depth, not brief or dated exposure. Tools & Technologies: You have hands-on experience with Databricks and AWS services such as S3, Kinesis, and Lambda or similar technologies. Experience with GitLab CI/CD pipelines and familiarity with PostgreSQL are a plus. Genuine AI Fluency: You use AI tools like Claude hands-on, daily, across planning, building, debugging, and documentation, not just for occasional testing. This is a core, non-negotiable part of the role, not a nice-to-have. Context Engineering: You know how to set up and maintain project context and memory for AI coding tools, structured instructions and reusable prompts, so they stay effective as a codebase grows rather than relying on default settings. Agentic & Worktree Fluency: You're comfortable running several tickets in parallel with AI assistance, using Git worktrees or a similar approach to keep parallel AI-assisted branches isolated and reviewable, and you can explain your actual workflow in detail rather than describing it as something that just happens automatically. Programming Skills: You are highly proficient in Python, SQL, and PySpark for data manipulation and processing, and you write clean, maintainable, production-ready code. Mindset & Communication: You have excellent problem-solving skills, strong attention to detail, and the ability to work independently and collaboratively. You are fluent in English, both verbally and in writing, comfortable letting AI take on a meaningful share of day-to-day coordination, and genuinely open to a way of working where AI reshapes how data teams operate, not just tolerant of it. How We Win Speed is the feature. Speed beats rocket science. We move fast, test fast, and multiply our pace with AI, because action creates information and small wins compound. A fast failure is a lesson we learn from, a slow one is a problem we can't afford. Focus on the essential. Done is better than perfect. title: Product Manager, Courier Delivery Experience
description: About Wolt At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe. Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life. We seek a Product Manager to join our Courier and Delivery Experience (CDX) team. This role will focus on ensuring world-class courier and consumer delivery experiences while continually evolving the delivery process with a future-oriented mindset. The Courier and Delivery Experience team owns the experiences that elevate every Wolt delivery, from the moment a courier opens the app to every order they accept, all the way to dropping an order off at the customer's doorstep. The team sits at the intersection of a multi-sided marketplace product, real-world operations, and safety, and the work directly moves how reliable Wolt feels to consumers and how satisfied our couriers are when delivering. You will play a crucial role in shaping the courier experience, ensuring that our couriers feel valued and supported while enhancing the efficiency of deliveries. By blending operational expertise with a deep understanding of courier needs, you will improve the user journey from onboarding couriers to completing deliveries. From designing new features that boost courier satisfaction to refining delivery processes, your work will contribute to key metrics across courier engagement, performance, and satisfaction. You will also be influential in shaping the evolution of the live delivery experience for our courier partners, the merchant courier interaction at pickup and the consumer courier interaction at the doorstep via the Courier app surfaces. The ideal candidate will have an exceptional track record in product management, with proven success in working with cross-functional teams across engineering, design, product, and operations. You will define the vision and roadmap for courier and delivery experiences across multiple projects. Working in partnership with business stakeholders, you will also collaborate on cross-team initiatives, contributing to the broader business strategy while ensuring a deep understanding of the courier experience. Join us in shaping the future of delivery, where every delivery is an opportunity for delight and loyalty. Our humble expectations You could come to this role from various backgrounds, but ideally, you bring: Several years of experience in product management, specializing in consumer-facing products Expertise in developing user-centric products, with the ability to address complex user experience-related challenges. Demonstrated expertise in supporting cross-functional teams and fostering operational excellence in fast-paced, high-demand industries. Proven track record in building products influencing cross-functional teams, including engineering, data, design, and operations. High ownership and collaborative capabilities, making thoughtful decisions, and focusing on product details to ensure execution aligns with the vision. Strong ability to define, execute, and measure meaningful OKRs, ensuring alignment with company-wide goals and fostering bottom-up alignment from your team. Ability to focus on the bigger picture, creating solutions that benefit couriers, operations, and customer experiences across the organization. Excellent stakeholder management skills, able to work effectively with diverse internal teams and external partners, while confidently engaging with leadership in a high-visibility role The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us! The compensation will be a negotiable combination of monthly pay and DoorDash RSUs. The latter makes it exceptionally easy to be excited about our company growing and doing well, as you'll own a piece of the pie. Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel. Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash . title: Customer Success Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><span data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">A career that’s the whole package!</span></strong></p> <p>At Conga, we’ve built a community where our colleagues can thrive. Here you’ll find opportunities to innovate and support growth through individual and team development, all within an environment where every voice is heard.</p> <p><span data-teams="true"><strong>Conga</strong> lines up commercial operations so companies run as connected, smarter businesses. By unifying the people and processes that drive commerce, Conga aligns pricing, quoting, contracting, rebates, and communications so teams stay in sync and buyers keep moving forward. The result is trusted decisions, consistent buyer experiences, and profitable growth. More than 10,000 customers worldwide, including over 50% of the Fortune 100®, trust Conga when commercial complexity is high and global impact is on the line.</span></p></div><p><strong>Job Title:</strong> Customer Success Manager </p> <p><strong>Reports to:</strong> Director, Customer Success </p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> United Kingdom; France (remote)</p> <p><strong>Travel</strong>: 20% in EMEA</p> <p><strong>Languages:</strong> German and English at native/C2 level</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>A quick snapshot…</strong> </p> <p>The Customer Success Manager’s primary responsibilities are to manage a book of global, complex customers who have invested in Conga to power their revenue operations. You will perform detailed adoption analysis and engage customer in joint planning to increase adoption, lead value realization activities like customer stakeholder alignment and roadmap reviews to ensure the Conga solution is continuing to be iterated on and improved in the customer’s environment. You’ll also drive customer advocacy by ensuring technical issues are being resolved quickly and efficiently by your internal Conga partners. You are a facilitator, a coach, a consultant and never stop asking questions to get to KNOW your customers. </p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Why it’s a big deal…</strong> </p> <p>Conga’s Customer Success team has a culture unlike any other. We are fun, collaborative, celebratory, passionate, and driven. We invest in our team and when you work every day to ensure your customers' success, you ensure the success of yourself and Conga. At Conga, our customers are global, fortune 200 customers that invest millions into their Conga solutions each year. Our CSMs are the customer's voice, the facilitator of conversations and the driver of outcomes for the Customer and Conga. We drive adoption of Conga products, identify expansion, own mitigation of risk using our cross functional teams and improve health and sentiment of Conga’s Customers, ensuring successful and growing renewal. </p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Here’s what we’re looking for....</strong></p> <p><strong>Customer Success Expertise: </strong>You have a proven track record of managing and growing customer relationships in large enterprise or strategic accounts across EMEA, including Germany; with 3-5 years of experience in a customer success role.  Demonstrated ability to drive customer satisfaction, retention, and expansion through effective relationship management and product knowledge.</p> <p><strong>Strong Project Management or Consultant Experience</strong>: You will drive customers forward, track their goals, navigate challenges, and strategize about their future state. Present these needs to day-to-day contacts, executives, and everyone in between.</p> <p><strong>Change Agent</strong>: Solve problems, create plans, drive customer change, and navigate evolving needs, goals, and challenges. Be inquisitive and challenge customers to understand impacts. Curiosity is crucial to your success.</p> <p><strong>Strong Technical Background and Acumen</strong>: In-depth knowledge and experience with revenue management and/or contract management software solutions, commercial functions, and processes. Ability to demo and provide best practices for optimized software use.</p> <p><strong>Analytical Skills</strong>: Proficient in analyzing complex data sets, identifying patterns, and deriving actionable insights. Leverage data-driven approaches to develop customer success strategies, identify opportunities for improvement, and measure success metrics.</p> <p><strong>Communication and Interpersonal Skills</strong>: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex concepts and technical information to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Strong interpersonal skills to build rapport, establish trust, and manage relationships with diverse customers and internal teams.</p> <p><strong>Leadership and Teamwork</strong>: Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams to achieve common goals. Open to mentoring and guiding junior customer success managers, and working collaboratively with sales, marketing, product, and support teams to deliver exceptional customer experiences.</p> <p><strong>Problem-Solving and Proactive Mindset</strong>: Strong problem-solving skills to identify and address customer challenges, provide innovative solutions, and proactively anticipate customer needs. Thrive in a fast-paced and dynamic environment, adapting quickly to changing circumstances.</p> <p><strong>Business Acumen</strong>: Understanding of business strategy and the ability to align customer success initiatives with overall business objectives. Knowledge of revenue models, key performance indicators (KPIs), and financial metrics relevant to the specific industry.</p> <p><strong>Customer Advocacy</strong>: Passion for advocating on behalf of customers, representing their interests, and influencing internal stakeholders to deliver customer-centric solutions. Dedication to ensuring customer satisfaction, loyalty, and long-term partnerships.</p> <p><strong>Continuous Learning and Adaptability</strong>: Commitment to staying updated with product enhancements, industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in customer success. Willingness to adapt and learn new skills as your customer’s industry and revenue lifecycle processes evolve.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Here’s what will give you an edge....</strong></p> <p><strong>Industry-Specific Experience</strong>: Prior experience in CLM (Contract Lifecycle Management), CPQ (Configure Price Quote), or Pricing software (<span data-teams="true">Smart Price Management, Smart Price Optimiszation) is </span>highly desirable. Experience in Healthcare, Financial Services, Technology, or a closely related field is advantageous.</p> <p><strong>Revenue Lifecycle-Specific Training</strong>: Participation in workshops, seminars, or training programs focused on revenue processes and solutions can demonstrate a commitment to professional development and a deeper understanding of industry-specific challenges.</p> <p><strong>Hands-On SaaS Product Experience</strong>: Prior experience or intention to continuously learn a suite of products and how they are leveraged by end users to drive value toward business goals. Demonstration of product certifications and proactive planning on leveraging best practices for improved product adoption is preferred.</p> <p> </p> <p> </p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Did we pique your interest? </strong> </p> <p>If this sounds like the kind of job you would love in the kind of environment where you would thrive, please click apply. <span data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">We'd love to hear from you! </span></p> <p><strong>Preferred Resume Format</strong> </p> <p>We accept resumes in any format, we suggest using PDF or plain text. These formats help ensure that your resume’s formatting remains intact, making it easier for our recruiters to review your application promptly. </p> <p><strong>Don’t meet every requirement for the role?</strong><strong> </strong><strong> </strong> </p> <p>Studies have shown that women and members of ethnic minorities are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Conga we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You just might be the right candidate for this or other roles.  </p> <div> <section id="st-additionalInformation" class="job-section"> <div> <h2 class="title">Additional Information</h2> </div> <div class="wysiwyg"> <p>Conga is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, parental or pregnancy status, marriage and civil partnership, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Conga is not open to third party solicitation or resumes for our posted FTE positions. Resumes received from third party agencies that are unsolicited will be considered complimentary.</p> </div> </section> </div> <section class="job-apply print-hidden"></section> <p><strong>Conga's Applicant Privacy Statement </strong></p> <p>The information you provide during the application process will be used in accordance with Conga’s Applicant Privacy Statement (<a href="https://conga.com/applicant-privacy-statement">https://conga.com/applicant-privacy-statement</a>). Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone. 🐙 Kraken Customer What we do: build an AI-driven, innovative, forward-thinking platform for energy management. From optimising resources to delivering cost-effective, exceptional customer experiences through advanced Customer Information Systems (CIS), billing, meter data management, CRM, and AI-driven communications, Kraken is powering the next wave of innovation in the energy industry. Why we do it: future energy will not look like energy as we know it today. We need to not just think about our future, but build for it. Client Delivery sits at the heart of Kraken’s transformation journeys, at the intersection of our clients and the product and engineering teams building Kraken 🚀 We lead conversations around our clients’ most important needs, help them unlock the value of Kraken and turn complex challenges into opportunities to evolve the platform, keeping Kraken innovative, relevant and ahead of where the energy market is going. It’s a high-impact, hands-on team where you’ll influence both our clients transformation and what Kraken becomes next 💡 As a Global Practice Lead, you’ll shape and lead your practice globally, working closely with Regional Practice Leads in your team across EMEA, the US and APAC to set the global direction for the practice, drive consistency and excellence across regions, and bring together insights from our people, clients and markets to influence how we deliver and how Kraken evolves. 🚀 What you'll own As a Global Practice Lead at Kraken , you will set the global direction for your practice and be accountable for its performance, capability and evolution across regions. You will lead and develop Regional Practice Leads and their teams, ensuring that Kraken delivers consistently high standards for clients globally while adapting to different markets and client needs. Global Capacity & Workforce Strategy: Own the long-term capability and capacity strategy for the practice, partnering with regional leaders and Talent to anticipate demand, identify skills gaps and ensure the right expertise is available in the right markets. Executive Client Engagement: Build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders globally and step into the most strategic or complex engagements where senior leadership, alignment or intervention is required. Strategic Escalation & Decision-Making: Act as a senior escalation point for complex, cross-regional challenges, bringing together the right stakeholders and removing organizational, product or delivery blockers. Practice Expertise & Standards: Define what excellence looks like within your practice, establishing global methodologies, standards and best practices while allowing appropriate flexibility for regional and client-specific needs. Organizational Influence: Partner with senior leaders across Delivery, Product, Engineering and other functions to shape decisions that affect clients, delivery strategy and the future development of the practice. Cross-Regional Learning & Scale: Ensure knowledge, successful delivery patterns and lessons learned move effectively across regions, turning individual client experiences into improvements that benefit Kraken globally. Future Capability: Anticipate how the practice needs to evolve as Kraken, our product and the energy industry develop, building new capabilities and expertise ahead of emerging client needs. 🧠 What you'll bring to the party People-first leadership: A leadership style grounded in influence, trust and leading by example rather than authority, with a genuine commitment to caring for and developing people. The ability to create psychological safety and combine empathy with clear expectations and accountability, enabling teams to feel trusted, supported and empowered to do their best work. Senior global leadership experience: Significant experience leading complex client delivery, transformation or professional-services organizations across multiple regions, clients and markets. Leadership of leaders: experience leading and developing other leaders, with the ability to create clarity and accountability while empowering regional leadership teams to make effective decisions. Strategic influence: A demonstrated ability to operate at senior leadership level and influence strategy across organizational boundaries, particularly across Delivery, Product and Engineering. Executive client leadership: Credibility with C-level and senior client stakeholders, including experience navigating complex transformations, competing priorities and high-stakes client situations. Subject-matter expertise: Deep expertise in your practice area, combined with a strong understanding of the global energy landscape and the ability to recognize where regional differences require different approaches. Systems thinking: The ability to look across regions and client engagements, identify patterns and root causes, and turn those insights into scalable improvements to products, processes and ways of working. Strategic & operational balance: The ability to set long-term direction while remaining close enough to delivery to understand what is happening on the ground and intervene effectively when required. People leadership & emotional intelligence: Sound judgment and empathy, with experience developing senior talent, navigating difficult conversations and creating environments where leaders and teams can perform at their best. Communication & executive presence: Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex topics, create compelling narratives and align senior internal and external stakeholders around a common direction. Resilience & adaptability: The resilience, pragmatism and hands-on mindset to navigate ambiguity and significant transformation, while keeping teams aligned and moving forward. ⭐️ Bonus points Languages: Full professional proficiency in English is required; additional languages are a plus. description: Rejoins Fastned pour accélérer la transition énergétique ! En tant qu’Expansion Manager, tu contribueras à notre croissance en France sur des sites clés et tu nous aideras à atteindre notre objectif de 1 000 stations. Aux côtés de +450 collègues avec +50 nationalités, répartis dans 10 pays, nous impulsons le changement dans la transition énergétique. Ce qui nous distingue : notre engagement envers la fiabilité, la durabilité et l'énergie propre. Nous avons récemment été reconnus « Meilleur réseau de recharge » au Royaume-Uni, en France, en Suisse et aux Pays-Bas. C'est l’opportunité de créer un impact durable ! Le rôle Fastned France est en pleine expansion, et en tant qu'Expansion Manager, tu seras un.e acteur.rice clé de cette croissance. Tes futures missions : Identifier de nouveaux terrains pour y implanter nos stations de recharge rapide. Analyser les nouveaux sites et monter les dossiers, d’un point de vue économique et juridique. Nouer des relations commerciales avec divers types de propriétaires fonciers. Négocier et conclure des contrats de bail. Suivre et coordonner le développement des projets, de la signature des accords jusqu'à l’ouverture des stations. Coordonner avec les services internes le bon déroulement des projets. Cultiver et développer ton réseau, représenter Fastned lors d’évènements extérieurs. Tu intégreras l’équipe chargée de l’expansion en France, tout en collaborant avec des expertes et experts en architecture, construction, branding et data. Grâce à ton réseau dans l'immobilier, tu renforceras notre maillage territorial en créant de nouvelles opportunités avec des propriétaires fonciers, des promoteurs et développeurs immobiliers. Tu mèneras des négociations stratégiques, en incarnant les valeurs de Fastned, et veilleras à ce que chaque projet se développe de manière fluide. La mobilité électrique est un domaine nouveau pour toi ? Pas de problème ! Dans le cadre de ton intégration, tu participeras à une série d’onboardings passionnants où tu apprendras tout ce qu’il faut savoir sur le monde de l’e-mobilité et de la recharge. Ce que nous recherchons Tu aimes prendre des initiatives, tu n’as pas peur de faire des erreurs et tu as soif d’apprendre ? Si tu coches également les cases suivantes, alors postule ! Nos avantages Chez Fastned, on travaille avec ambition pour avoir un impact réel, et on prend le temps de reconnaître et célébrer nos réussites, qu’elles soient grandes ou petites. On valorise l’équilibre vie pro / vie perso, on t’offre une vraie flexibilité de travail et nous mettons en place des initiatives family-friendly. Nos avantages : Un budget formation et développement de 3 000€ brut par an par collaborateur, car le développement et la formation sont importants pour nous et notre secteur offre des opportunités infinies. Voiture de fonction électrique avec frais de recharge couverts. Carte Ticket Restaurant, 12,20€ par jour. 25 jours de congés + RTT + 2 jours de Mission Days que tu peux utiliser pour contribuer aux missions de Fastned et soutenir une cause associative qui te tient à cœur. Un abonnement Gymlib avec accès à un large réseau de salles de sport et studios. Plan de stock options -> nous croyons à la création de valeur partagée. Bien-être mental avec nilo health : accès à une plateforme de santé mentale confidentielle offrant des séances de coaching individuel avec des psychologues, des sessions de groupe et une variété d’outils. Des événements festifs: Ski trip, Fastned Days, team buildings - des temps forts pour se retrouver, échanger et célébrer nos réussites. Envie d'en savoir plus ? On serait ravis d'avoir une conversation avec toi ! Envoie-nous ton CV et dis-nous en plus, pourquoi Fastned, et pourquoi toi. Le processus de recrutement se déroule en 4 étapes : Entretien vidéo avec notre recruteuse ; Entretien vidéo avec la Lead Expansion France et un Expansion Manager Case study vidéo avec la Lead Expansion France, et deux membres de l’équipe ; Team coffee chats dans nos locaux parisiens pour rencontrer les collègues de l’équipe France. title: Senior Innovation Consultant - EU Projects
description: Job summary (Short promotional text) We are looking for a Senior Consultant to strengthen our European Grants team in France. You will advise innovative companies and organisations on European funding strategies and lead the development of complex grant applications for major R&D, industrial and innovation projects. The role combines strategic consulting, project analysis, proposal writing and client management. We are looking for someone who can independently transform complex projects into compelling funding strategies and high quality European proposals. Your mission (What are you going to do in text) summarised down below Help ambitious organisations secure European funding for high impact innovation projects by combining strategic advice, technical understanding and excellent proposal development. Your tasks 1st part (in max 4 bullets) Lead the development of complex European funding applications under programmes such as Horizon Europe, Innovation Fund, LIFE and CEF. Assess R&D and innovation projects, identify the most appropriate funding opportunities and advise clients on funding strategy. Structure compelling project narratives covering excellence, innovation, impact, implementation and European added value. Interview senior client stakeholders, scientists, engineers and technical experts to extract and challenge the information required for successful proposals. Your tasks 2nd part (In max 4 bullets) Coordinate the complete proposal development process, including work plans, consortium inputs, budgets, deadlines and quality reviews. Manage client relationships independently and act as a trusted advisor throughout the funding process. Review and improve proposals prepared by other consultants and contribute to internal quality standards and methodologies. Support the development of junior consultants and contribute to business development and the growth of PNO Innovation’s European Grants activities in France. Your profile 1st part (in max 4 bullets) Master’s degree or PhD in a scientific, engineering, technical, economic or innovation related discipline. Several years of relevant experience in European funding, innovation consulting, R&D project development or a closely related environment. Proven experience with European funding programmes, ideally including Horizon Europe and/or other major programmes such as Innovation Fund, LIFE or CEF. Demonstrated experience writing or leading high quality grant proposals. Excellent written and spoken French and English. Your Profile 2nd part (In max 4 bullets) Strong ability to understand complex scientific, technological and business concepts and turn them into persuasive narratives. Strong client management, communication and project management skills. Autonomous, rigorous and comfortable managing complex assignments under demanding deadlines. Ability to mentor less experienced consultants and contribute to the development of the team. Why us? (What do we offer) 1st part (in max 4 bullets) Lead major European funding projects with innovative companies and organisations. Work across technologies, sectors and European programmes rather than being limited to a single funding instrument. Join one of Europe’s largest specialist innovation and funding consultancies. Work with an international network of more than 600 colleagues and European funding specialists. Why us? (What do we offer) 2nd part (in max 4 bullets) Take ownership of client relationships and complex strategic assignments. Contribute to developing junior consultants and strengthening our European Grants practice in France. Benefit from clear opportunities for professional development and increasing responsibility. Competitive salary and benefits package according to experience and seniority. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

globally.</li> <li>Represent Europe in global strategy: Ensure European market realities — currency, competitive landscape, regulatory nuance, regional manufacturing capacity — shape Xometry's global pricing and AI product direction, rather than being retrofitted after the fact.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You'll Bring to Xometry:</strong></p> <ul> <li>8+ years of product management experience, title: Senior Product Developer – Candy & Confectionery (All Genders)
description: YOU & AHEAD At ahead, we are on a mission to clean up the world’s candy drawers. We make the snacks everyone actually craves: chocolate bars, protein bars, wafers, cookies, gummies and more. Our products contain up to 90% less sugar with zero compromise on taste. We are a 130-person team based in Hamburg, with our own lab, a portfolio of more than 170 SKUs and ambitious growth plans across D2C, retail, Amazon and Europe. We are looking for a Senior Product Developer for Candy & Confectionery to own the technical development of our portfolio from the first brief through formulation, sensory validation, scale-up and launch. As our Senior Product Developer, you will bring technical depth to one of our most important categories and make sure every decision works in the real world: in the recipe, in the factory and in the customer’s hands. Are you a food developer who knows how to turn a great idea into a product people genuinely love? Someone who can balance taste, texture, stability, cost, compliance and timing while getting the product over the line? If you like taking ownership and enjoy solving real product problems, we would love to hear from you! YOUR TASKS End-to-End Product Development: You own candy and confectionery projects from brief to launch. You translate requirements into clear technical targets, develop and optimise formulations, oversee trials, sensory validation and technical decisions. Sugar Reduction & Product Performance: You develop reduced-sugar and no-added-sugar products without compromising on taste. You understand how ingredients affect texture, processing, stability and shelf life, and make clear trade-offs between quality, cost, compliance and speed. Sensory, Shelf Life & Scale-Up: You plan and coordinate sensory, shelf-life and stability testing. You prepare for pilot and industrial trials, work closely with co-manufacturers, troubleshoot issues and follow solutions through to production. Specifications, Suppliers & Compliance: You manage formulations, specifications, technical documentation, ingredients and samples. Together with our Quality team, you ensure that food law, labelling, allergen, nutritional and claims requirements are considered from the start. Cross-Functional Ownership: You work closely with Product, Quality, Operations, Procurement, Brand, Retail and Marketing. You communicate clearly, flag risks early, challenge assumptions and keep projects moving. Building Better NPD Processes: You document decisions and learnings, create clear handovers and help make product development more structured and predictable as ahead grows. YOUR PROFILE You bring 5+ years of experience in food product development, R&D, or NPD, with a track record from brief through formulation, sensory validation, scale-up, and launch. Hands-on experience in gummies, candy, chocolate, confectionery, or a related sweet-goods category is mandatory. You understand how taste, texture, processing, stability, shelf life, ingredients and production realities come together in a successful product. You have experience with sugar-reduction or no-added-sugar systems and know how to balance product performance with consumer expectations. You have worked with ingredient suppliers and co-manufacturers and have been involved in pilot or industrial-scale production. You are comfortable with specifications, technical documentation, and food-law requirements. You take ownership and follow through. You are structured without being bureaucratic, comfortable with ambiguity and willing to challenge a brief, assumption or timeline when needed. You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and enjoy working as a senior individual contributor without direct reports initially. You hold a degree or equivalent training in food science, food technology, chemistry, nutrition science, ecotrophology, or a comparable field. You communicate confidently in German and English. WHAT MAKES YOUR PROFILE COMPLETE Experience launching 10+ food products, ideally across multiple markets. Experience working with gummies, candy, chocolate bars, cookies, filled confectionery or similar products. Strong knowledge of sugar reduction, sweetener systems, fibres and texture management. Experience planning, conducting or interpreting sensory tests, shelf-life studies and stability testing. Background in better-for-you food, functional food, private-label NPD, or a fast-growing consumer brand. Experience delivering products into D2C and retail channels across DACH or Europe. AND WHY AHEAD? Working at ahead is more than just a job - it’s your opportunity to develop as a professional and as a person, while shaping the future of snacking. Our mission is to make low sugar the new standard, and we pour that ambition into every product we create. You’ll become part of a team where international talent, startup drive, real impact, and true ownership come together. Hypergrowth Environment: If you're looking for greenfield, creative freedom, and real impact, you're in the right place. We're a team that is scaling fast - with purpose Great Workspace: A central office in the heart of Hamburg near the Alster, top equipment (MacBook), snacks, drinks, plenty of ahead products - and yes, a ping-pong table.
