title: Full Stack Product Developer (m/w/d)
description: Aufgaben Du willst Technologie gestalten, die direkt etwas bewegt? Bei Table.Briefings entwickeln wir digitale Produkte für ein wachsendes Medienunternehmen. Unsere Software hilft dabei, Prozesse effizienter zu machen, neue Geschäftsmodelle zu ermöglichen und unseren Redaktionen den Rücken freizuhalten – damit sie sich auf das konzentrieren können, was sie am besten können: hochwertigen Journalismus! Als dritter interner Entwickler bzw. dritte interne Entwicklerin übernimmst du eine zentrale Rolle in unserem Tech-Team. Du arbeitest an der gesamten Entwicklungskette: von der ersten Idee über Konzeption und Umsetzung bis zu Deployment, Betrieb und Weiterentwicklung. Dabei geht es nicht nur darum, Features zu programmieren. Du hilfst uns, die richtigen Probleme zu erkennen, Anforderungen zu schärfen und Lösungen zu entwickeln, die für unser Business, unsere Nutzerinnen und Nutzer und unsere Redaktionen wirklich einen Unterschied machen. Deine Aufgaben Du konzipierst, entwickelst und betreust unsere Webanwendungen, APIs und Apps. Du arbeitest an unseren Statamic -basierten Plattformen und entwickelst unser CMS weiter. Du entwickelst neue Funktionen mit unserem bestehenden Tech-Stack und verbesserst bestehende Lösungen kontinuierlich. Du beschäftigst dich mit dem Einsatz und der Optimierung von Large Language Models und Coding Agents – zur Automatisierung interner Prozesse und für neue Produktfeatures. Du entwickelst und integrierst RESTful APIs, zum Beispiel zur Anbindung von Systemen wie ActiveCampaign . Du wirkst bei der Konfiguration, Wartung und Absicherung unserer Linux-Server und Deployment -Prozesse mit. Du übersetzt Anforderungen aus unterschiedlichen Bereichen in klare technische Lösungen. Du bringst Struktur in komplexe oder noch nicht vollständig definierte Aufgaben und sorgst dafür, dass aus Ideen umsetzbare Produkte werden. Du arbeitest eng mit Stakeholdern, Produktverantwortlichen, Redaktion und Geschäftsführung zusammen. Unser Tech-Stack - Wir arbeiten unter anderem mit: PHP und Laravel Statamic PostgreSQL Livewire HTML, CSS und JavaScript RESTful APIs Linux-Servern und modernen Deployment -Prozessen Large Language Models und Coding Agents Du musst unseren Tech-Stack nicht bereits vollständig beherrschen – wichtiger sind uns dein technisches Verständnis, deine Kommunikationsstärke und deine Fähigkeit, komplexe Anforderungen schnell in gute Lösungen zu übersetzen. Du solltest aber Lust haben, mit unseren Technologien zu arbeiten und dich schnell in neue Systeme und Themen einzuarbeiten. Wir suchen keine Person, die jedes Tool schon einmal eingesetzt hat, sondern jemanden, der gute technische Entscheidungen trifft, Zusammenhänge versteht und Verantwortung übernimmt. Qualifikation Du hast fundierte Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung und beherrschst mindestens eine relevante Programmiersprache sicher. Du hast idealerweise Erfahrung mit Webanwendungen, APIs und Datenbanken. Du interessierst dich für unseren Tech-Stack und hast Lust, dich in Laravel , Statamic , PostgreSQL und Livewire einzuarbeiten oder darin weiterzuentwickeln. Du verstehst, wie man LLMs und Coding Agents sinnvoll und verantwortungsvoll in der Softwareentwicklung einsetzt – oder möchtest es lernen. Du kennst dich mit Linux-Servern, Deployment und grundlegenden Fragen der IT-Sicherheit aus oder bist bereit, dich in diese Themen einzuarbeiten. Du kannst komplexe Probleme schnell erfassen, priorisieren und in konkrete nächste Schritte übersetzen. Du kommunizierst klar und gerne – auch mit Menschen, die nicht technisch arbeiten. Du kannst unterschiedliche Anforderungen und Perspektiven zusammenbringen und sicher mit Stakeholdern umgehen. Du arbeitest selbstständig, zuverlässig und lösungsorientiert. Du behältst auch dann den Überblick, wenn Anforderungen sich verändern, Informationen zunächst unvollständig sind oder mehrere Themen gleichzeitig auf dem Tisch liegen. Du hast Freude daran, in solchen Situationen Ruhe, Struktur und Verbindlichkeit zu schaffen. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sind für die Kommunikation im Team und mit unseren Stakeholdern unerlässlich. Was uns wichtig ist Wir entwickeln nicht zum Selbstzweck. Unser Ziel ist Software, die unmittelbar Wirkung entfaltet: für unser Geschäft, für die Vervielfachung unserer Lizenzen und für unsere Redaktionen, die täglich anspruchsvolle Inhalte produzieren. Dafür suchen wir eine Persönlichkeit, die Verantwortung übernimmt, Fragen stellt und sich aktiv einbringt. Du solltest dich in einem meinungsstarken, dynamischen Umfeld wohlfühlen, unterschiedliche Perspektiven aushalten und deine eigenen Ideen überzeugend vertreten können. Gleichzeitig ist uns wichtig, dass du pragmatisch bleibst und gemeinsam mit anderen zu guten Lösungen kommst. Benefits Wir bieten dir: Eine Schlüsselposition in einem innovativen und wachstumsstarken Medienunternehmen Die Möglichkeit, unseren Tech-Stack aktiv mitzugestalten und weiterzuentwickeln Viel Eigenverantwortung und kurze Entscheidungswege Einen vielseitigen Job mit direktem Einfluss auf unser Business und unsere Produkte Eine unbefristete Festanstellung in Teilzeit oder Vollzeit 28 Tage Urlaub Flexibilität bei Arbeitszeit und Arbeitsort > Drei Tage pro Woche in unserem Büro in Berlin-Mitte, zwei Tage im MobileOffice Persönliche und fachliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in einer echten Wachstumskultur Eine offene, freundliche Atmosphäre mit Partnerinnen, Partnern und Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus der ganzen Welt Deine Bewerbung Wir freuen uns auf deinen Lebenslauf und ein kurzes, persönliches Motivationsschreiben mit maximal 1.000 Zeichen: Warum möchtest du als Full Stack Product Developer (m/w/d) bei Table.Briefings arbeiten? Uns interessiert besonders, welche Probleme du gerne löst, wie du mit unterschiedlichen Anforderungen umgehst und was dich daran reizt, Technologie mit konkretem unternehmerischem und redaktionellem Nutzen zu entwickeln. title: Commercial Account Executive, DACH
description: <div class="content-intro"><div><span id="m_8220454926977230902gmail-docs-internal-guid-9a9f34f4-7fff-014a-c97c-98ca90610a47">Algolia is the retrieval intelligence layer that turns intent into trusted, decision-grade outcomes. Powering more than 1.7 trillion queries a year for over 18,000 customers with millisecond latency and 99.999% reliability, we are the recognized leader for Search and Product Discovery by top industry analyst firms. The Algolia platform turns a company's products, content, and business rules into data that humans, applications and AI agents can act upon. The result is trusted customer experiences with stronger conversions for measurable business impact.</span></div> <div> </div></div><p>At Algolia, we are passionate about helping businesses connect their end-users with what matters most in milliseconds!</p> <p>As an Algolia Account Executive, you will be responsible for creating strong relationships with our customers/prospects and building on these relationships to expand our footprint or close new businesses. You should be comfortable researching prospective customers and adapting sales strategies to meet their needs. You will also play an integral role in defining our sales model. You know the ins and outs of Algolia, understand how we can benefit each prospect and will ultimately be the front line of our revenue growth in the German-speaking and CEMEA markets.</p> <p>Algolia has been growing exponentially over the past few years with Germany representing one of our core markets. We are now expanding our existing German-speaking team to further accelerate in this region, providing you with the opportunity to become one of the core players in our success story. You will be an important voice in how we address this market and able to gain a lot of visibility both within our fast-growing tech company as well as within the German eCommerce/ retail segment.</p> <p>Are you a resilient problem-solver who isn't afraid to think outside the box and get their hands dirty? We expect you to take ownership and be able to execute, defining your own territory strategy. We're looking for candidates who raise the level and bring sales excellence to the revenue organisation. You should value and practice transparency, have the humility to accept your weaknesses and continuously strive to improve both personally and professionally.</p> <h3><strong>YOUR ROLE WILL CONSIST OF:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Managing and growing a sales pipeline</li> <li>Driving inbound and outbound leads through complex sales cycles to closed won</li> <li>Working your network and collaborating with external partners to source and facilitate new projects in the Commercial segment</li> <li>Managing and prospecting with an existing account base to drive usage-based and feature-based upsells</li> <li>Generating new projects from booking self-driven outbound meetings</li> <li>Building compelling demonstrations with the pre-sales team, sales material and ROI studies bringing value to our customers</li> <li>Forecasting accurately to help the team hit their numbers</li> <li>Collaborating with sales developers, solutions engineers, customer success managers, legal, partner managers and marketing.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>YOU MIGHT BE A FIT IF YOU HAVE:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>2 - 4 years of experience in a closing role (esp. in B2B, MarTech, SaaS tech sales)</li> <li>Excellent spoken and written German and English skills, Polish or Czech a plus</li> <li>Hunter mindset: Strong familiarity with outbound prospecting techniques, tools and processes</li> <li>Strong Plus: Experience in working with partners (solution integrators, consultancies, independent software vendors)</li> <li>Multi-tasker who can adapt to changing situations</li> <li>Quick thinker, must be able to handle questions on the fly</li> </ul> <h3><strong>NICE TO HAVE:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>You love tech sales;</li> <li>You have a curious mindset and are capable to understand prospects’ pains and how a deep tech solution like Algolia can solve it;</li> <li>You thrive in dynamic environments and are capable to adjust to constant change;</li> <li>You are excited by the idea of building things and have a structured and strategic approach to working your territory;</li> <li>You believe you are in charge of your own success and you have the grit to continue going when things get challenging.</li> </ul> <p>#LI-Hybrid </p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>Algolia does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, military status, veteran status, disability status, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law.</p> <p>The annual total cash compensation range (base salary and commission) for this role reflects market pay data within this location. The exact compensation offered for this role may vary depending on specific location and job-related knowledge, technical skills, and experience; and is only one part of our Total Rewards philosophy to compensate and recognize employees for their work.</p></div><div class="title">On-Target Earnings Pay Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>€120.000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>€160.000 EUR</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>FLEXIBLE WORKPLACE STRATEGY:</strong></p> <p>Algolia’s flexible workplace model is designed to empower all Algolians to fulfill our mission to power search and discovery with ease. We place an emphasis on an individual’s impact, contribution, and output, over their physical location. Algolia is a high-trust environment and many of our team members have the autonomy to choose where they want to work and when. </p> <p>We have a global presence with offices in Paris, NYC, London, Sydney and Bucharest, however we also offer many of our team members the option to work remotely either as fully remote or hybrid-remote employees.<strong> Positions listed as "Remote" are only available for remote work within the specified country. Positions listed within a specific city are only available in that location - depending on the role it may be available with either a hybrid-remote or in-office schedule.</strong></p> <p><strong>WE’RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO CAN LIVE OUR VALUES:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>GRIT</strong> - Problem-solving and perseverance capability in an ever-changing and growing environment.</li> <li><strong>TRUST </strong>- Willingness to trust our co-workers and to take ownership.</li> <li><strong>CANDOR</strong> - Ability to receive and give constructive feedback.</li> <li><strong>CARE</strong> - Genuine care about other team members, our clients and the decisions we make in the company.</li> <li><strong>HUMILITY</strong> - Aptitude for learning from others, putting ego aside.</li> </ul> <p>We’re looking for talented, passionate people to help build the world’s best search and discovery technology. We value autonomy, diversity, and collaboration. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone is respected and supported—regardless of race, age, ancestry, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, color, veteran status, disability, or socioeconomic background.</p> <p><strong>IMPORTANT NOTICE FOR CANDIDATES - Recruitment Fraud Notice</strong></p> <p>We’ve recently seen an increase in recruitment scams targeting job seekers. To help protect yourself, please keep the following in mind:</p> <ul> <li>Our open positions may appear on third-party job boards, but the <strong>best way to apply safely</strong> is directly through our <strong>careers page</strong>.</li> <li>All genuine communication from Algolia will come from an ----- email address. If you receive an email from someone claiming to work at Algolia who does not have an ----- email address, please do not respond or share any personal information.</li> <li>We’ll <strong>never ask for payments, purchases, or financial details</strong> during the hiring process.</li> </ul> <p><strong>READY TO APPLY?</strong></p> <p>If you share our values and our enthusiasm for building the world’s best search & discovery technology, we’d love to review your application!</p></div> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Key Account Manager
description: <p></p> <h2><span style="color: rgb(35, 111, 161);">Why Verifone</span></h2> <p>For more than 40 years Verifone has established a remarkable record of leadership in the electronic payment technology industry. Verifone has one of the leading electronic payment solutions brands and is one of the largest providers of electronic payment systems worldwide.</p> <p>Verifone has a diverse, dynamic and fast paced work environment in which employees are focused on results and have opportunities to excel. We take pride in the fact that we work with leading retailers, merchants, banks, and third party partners to invent and deliver innovative payments solution around the world. We strive for excellence in our products and services, and are obsessed with customer happiness. Across the globe, Verifone employees are leading the payments industry through experience, innovation, and an ambitious spirit. Whether it’s developing the next platform of secure payment systems or searching for new ways to bring electronic payments to new markets, the team at Verifone is dedicated to the success of our customers, partners and investors. It is this passion for innovation that drives each one of our employees for personal and professional success.</p> <p>Verifone is proudly an in-office work culture as we see immense benefits to career development and business results from our colleagues being physically co-located. Currently, we do allow a hybrid work schedule but we regularly revisit our attendance policy.</p> <p></p> <h2><span style="color: rgb(35, 111, 161);">What's Exciting About The Role</span></h2> <p><span style="color: rgb(35, 111, 161);"></span></p> <div>To ensure the long-term stability and growth of strategically important international customer relationships, we are hiring a <strong>Senior Key Account Manager</strong>. Reporting to and working closely with the current Global Account Manager, you will support the operational and strategic management of key accounts, ensuring continuity of customer relationships while developing the expertise required to assume full account responsibility over time.</div> <div> </div> <div>This role sits within our <span class="NormalTextRun SCXW103058534 BCX8">DACH sales title: (Junior) Finance Manager (German Speaking) (m/w/d)
description: DEINE ROLLE Zahlen sind für dich kein Selbstzweck, sondern die Grundlage guter Entscheidungen? Du willst kein kleines Rädchen in einer großen Finanzabteilung sein, sondern echte Verantwortung und tiefe Einblicke in die Abläufe eines FinTechs? Dann bist du bei uns richtig. Als (Junior) Finance Manager (m/w/d) arbeitest du in einem schlagkräftigen, kleinen Finance Team direkt mit dem VP Finance zusammen – und übernimmst von Tag eins an Verantwortung. Von der laufenden Buchhaltung über Monats- und Jahresabschluss bis zu Reporting, Forecasts und der Automatisierung unserer Prozesse deckst du die gesamte Bandbreite ab – und siehst unmittelbar, wie deine Arbeit bei Management, Investoren und Board ankommt. So entwickelst du ein tiefes Verständnis der finanziellen Steuerung eines der führenden digitalen Vermögensverwalter Europas – und prägst sie aktiv mit. Was machst du dabei konkret? Monatsabschluss: Du übernimmst eigenständig wiederkehrende Reporting- und Abschlussaufgaben und sorgst dafür, dass unser Monatsabschluss steht – pünktlich und verlässlich Jahresabschluss: Du bringst dich in die Vorbereitung des HGB Jahresabschlusses ein und unterstützt unsere Accountants und Wirtschaftsprüfer beim Audit. Reporting: Du erstellst KPIs und Finanzkennzahlen für Management-Präsentationen und wirkst an Investoren- und Board-Unterlagen mit. Analysen: Du baust Finanzmodelle, Forecasts und Abweichungsanalysen und machst aus Zahlen belastbare Insights. Prozessautomatisierung: Du digitalisierst und automatisierst unsere Finanzprozesse u.a. über AI Anwendungen – und findest die Tools, die uns morgen schneller machen. DAS BRINGST DU MIT Erfahrung & Qualifikation: Du hast eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung und/oder ein Studium. Erste praktische Erfahrung im Accounting/Controlling, Consulting, Investment Banking oder Venture Capital ist ein Vorteil. Analytische Fähigkeiten: Zahlen sind dein Zuhause: Du denkst analytisch, arbeitest sicher in Excel und findest dich schnell in Tools wie NetSuite, Abacum, Moss oder PowerPoint zurecht. Erfahrung mit Automatisierung und AI Tools ist ein Plus – vieles davon lernst du bei uns on the Job. Mindset: Du bringst eine proaktive, sorgfältige und detailorientierte Arbeitsweise mit und blühst in einem dynamischen, schnell wachsenden Startup Umfeld auf. Du bist ambitioniert, übernimmst gerne Verantwortung und ziehst Dinge eigenständig durch. Sprache: Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch (mindestens C1) und fühlst dich in einem internationalen Arbeitskontext wohl. So geht es für dich weiter Eine ausgezeichnete Candidate Experience und Transparenz haben für uns im Interviewprozess die höchste Priorität. Die verschiedenen Bewerbungsphasen helfen uns zu verstehen, wie eine Zusammenarbeit aussehen könnte. Erstes virtuelles Kennenlernen mit Larissa: Wir tauschen uns aus, ob Deine Erfahrungen und Erwartungen an die Position mit unseren Anforderungen übereinstimmen. Interview mit Jessie : Wir tauchen tiefer in die Rolle und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten ein und lernen uns noch besser kennen. Du hast die Möglichkeit, Fragen zu stellen und mehr über das Internship zu erfahren. Case Study Runde: Gemeinsam mit Jan und einem weiteren Senior Teammitglied wird auf eine typische Situation eingegangen, die Dir in dieser Rolle begegnen könnte. So bekommst Du den bestmöglichen Einblick in den praktischen Alltag. Kennelernen vor Ort: Besuche unser Berliner Büro, lerne die Menschen persönlich kennen, mit denen du eng zusammenarbeiten wirst, und bekomme ein echtes Gefühl für unsere Kultur, unsere Arbeitsweise und unsere gemeinsamen Ziele. Über uns Wir sind LIQID, einer der führenden digitalen Vermögensverwalter in Europa und eines der am schnellsten wachsenden deutschen Fintechs. Unsere Mission ist es, gleiche Bedingungen für wohlhabende Anlegerinnen und Anleger zu schaffen, indem wir ihnen Zugang zu Expertise und Anlagelösungen ermöglichen, die ihnen bisher verschlossen waren. Dabei setzen wir auf ein Gleichgewicht zwischen Mensch, Umwelt und Profit. Wir bieten unseren Kundinnen und Kunden umfassende Anlagelösungen – von erstklassiger Vermögensverwaltung bis hin zu kuratierten Portfolios aus den weltweit besten Private-Equity- und Venture-Capital-Fonds. Mit einem betreuten Vermögen von über 4 Milliarden Euro gehören wir schon jetzt zu den führenden Vermögensverwaltern in Deutschland. In unserer weiteren Entwicklung arbeiten wir mit starken und erfahrenen Partnern wie LGT , Toscafund , HQ Trust und Project A zusammen. LIQID ist ein Arbeitgeber, der für Chancengleichheit steht. Alle qualifizierten Bewerbungen werden ohne Rücksicht auf Hautfarbe, Alter, Religion, Geschlecht, ethnische und nationale Herkunft, Behinderung oder aufgrund von anderen durch Gleichbehandlungsgesetze geschützte Eigenschaften berücksichtigt. We close critical skill gaps in the workforce, in AI, data, engineering and more, through applied, guided and equitable learning programmes with measurable impact. The role Multiverse Germany's MD Office is looking for a proactive, tech-forward and experienced Executive Business Partner (m/w/d) to support the Managing Director (MD) and Chief of Staff (CoS), to help run a fast-growing Berlin office. preparing agendas, drafting emails, preparing phone calls or customer meeting briefings Manage the MDs and senior executives’ travel logistics and activities , including accommodations, title: Senior AI Product Manager (f/m/d)
description: OUR PURPOSE AT PLANCRAFT Building the backbone of European trades together – with AI-first software. We’re not just building software – we’re on a mission to create space for contractors & tradespeople by equipping them with AI solutions that work the way they do: fast, practical, and AI-first. With Tier 1 Investors from Europe and the US, like Headline and Creandum as well as 30,000+ tradespeople as customer base, we’re scaling across Europe to turn scattered tradespeople into thriving communities. We believe in zero admin, not zero personality – and we build every feature with the people in mind who wear the boots, not the suits. We’re #stoked to shape the future, #together as a team, and #humble in our mission to support the builders of tomorrow. YOUR MISSION AT PLANCRAFT As a Senior AI Product Manager, you move plancraft closer to becoming the autopilot for the trades : Evolving our product from software that helps tradespeople manage their work into one where AI agents can take on meaningful parts of their daily workload. This is not about adding AI features to an existing roadmap. You’ll own an emerging problem space and identify where agents can create the highest leverage for our customers beyond what Plancraft does today. That means getting close to tradespeople and their businesses, uncovering the problems worth solving, and working with Engineering and UX to turn them into reliable, trustworthy products customers are willing to rely on for real work. You’ll operate across the full product journey: from spending time with tradespeople in the field and deciding which opportunity to pursue, to working with Engineering to understand technical requirements and trade-offs, defining evaluation criteria, shipping to production, and learning from real-world usage. The impact should be tangible. The products you build will aim to help trades businesses improve outcomes such as profit margins, quote acceptance rates, and capacity utilisation — while opening up entirely new product and growth opportunities for plancraft. YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES Own the product strategy, roadmap, and delivery for Plancraft’s customer-facing AI agents and workflows. Identify high-potential customer problems beyond today’s platform and translate messy, real-world trades workflows into focused opportunities for agentic products. Define and own the single co-worker interface for customers to interact with and manage agents and their underlying workflows. Work in a Product Trio with Engineering and UX throughout discovery, evaluation, and delivery, from early problem validation to production-quality releases. Establish a repeatable AI product operating loop across discovery, evaluation, release gates, monitoring, and iteration. Define and maintain evaluation sets, quality standards, and release criteria for customer-facing AI products, including accuracy, correction rates, latency, and safe rollback conditions. Instrument and monitor AI product performance, using customer behaviour and quality signals to decide what to scale, change, or stop. Demonstrate measurable customer outcomes from AI-powered workflows, including improvements in efficiency, profitability, quote acceptance, capacity utilisation, activation, and retention. Contribute the Product perspective to technical and platform trade-offs, including customer value, quality, cost, and time to market, together with Engineering and the shared AI infrastructure counterpart. Partner across Product and Engineering to manage dependencies, reusable AI experience patterns, mobile and voice input, and handovers between customer workflows. Work closely with RevOps, Sales, and Customer Success to understand adoption and willingness-to-pay signals and contribute to AI pricing and monetisation experiments. Must-Have Skills 7+ years of product management experience , including at least 2 years owning and shipping AI products in production end-to-end. Strong applied GenAI literacy across LLMs, agents, RAG, and evaluation frameworks — sufficient to understand technical requirements and help evaluate Product, quality, cost, and time-to-market trade-offs together with Engineering. Experience building 0-to-1 AI products or new product areas , from customer discovery and problem definition through production launch and iteration. Experience defining quality and success criteria for AI products , including evaluation metrics, release thresholds, customer outcomes, and post-launch monitoring. Strong customer discovery and product judgment , with the ability to turn complex real-world workflows into focused AI product opportunities. Experience in a fast-moving startup or scale-up environment , with a track record of creating structure, setting priorities, and delivering despite ambiguity. Proven cross-functional ownership , working closely with Engineering and UX from discovery through production and managing dependencies across teams. English at C1 level and German at C2 level. Willingness to stay close to customers and the team , including field discovery with tradespeople and regular presence in Hamburg (approximately one week per month or equivalent). Nice-to-Have Skills Experience with voice, mobile, or document AI , particularly products that turn unstructured inputs into reliable workflows. Experience with AI monetisation , including usage-based, credit-based, or hybrid pricing models. Background in B2B SaaS for SMBs, field service, construction, or the trades . Familiarity with product and research tools such as PostHog, Sentry, Dovetail, or ProductFruits . Additional language skills in Italian, Spanish, Dutch, or Polish . WHO THIS ROLE IS FOR You’ll probably enjoy this role if you want to build rather than inherit. You like starting with an important but not fully defined problem and creating clarity through customer insight, data, experimentation, and strong product judgment. You’re excited by AI because of the problems it can solve — not simply because the technology is new. You’re comfortable working closely with engineers, understanding technical requirements and evaluation results, and translating them into sound Product decisions. You want meaningful ownership. You’re comfortable making decisions with incomplete information, narrowing a large opportunity space into the right first wedge, shipping it, learning from real usage, and changing course when the evidence tells you to. And importantly, you want your work to have a visible outcome. The products you build here should change how trades businesses operate — and their adoption, customer value, and commercial impact will be measurable. WHY PLANCRAFT? Team Spirit : We’re driven by passion, commitment, and a shared mission. Team spirit matters to us — and we make it visible: with four major team event weeks per year, casual monthly on-site and remote formats, and a strong recognition culture where we regularly celebrate both the big and small wins together. Ownership : You’re encouraged to take ownership from day one. In a flat hierarchy and high-trust environment, you’re empowered to make meaningful decisions and drive real impact. Learning & Growth : We invest in your personal and professional development through a strong feedback culture with 6-monthly 360° growth reviews, a personal learning budget (1.500€/year), 2 paid days of educational leave, and targeted enablement formats. Our goal is to help you unlock your full potential. AI Enablement : Our internal tools and workflows are AI-enabled by design. We support every team and individual in applying AI at the next level in their daily work. Tech & Tooling : You’ll receive a MacBook, premium headphones, and everything else you need — from hardware to tools — to be effective in your daily doing. Flexibility : Whether remote, hybrid, abroad or on-site — you work where you’re at your best. Our Hamburg office (with a rooftop terrace) is always open, and you decide each week how often you come in. And if you need a change of scenery, working abroad worldwide up to 2 months is always an option. Recharge : To ensure the needed rest, we offer 30 vacation days per year (based on a 5-day week) plus Dec 24th off. We also subsidize your Urban Sports Club membership and organize internal sport meetups. Mobility : You can lease a "JobRad" (Bike) and get a subsidized "Deutschlandticket" or "BahnCard" for public transport to be supported in your commute. International Environment : We’re becoming more international every month, with team members already in Italy, Spain, the Netherlands, and Austria — which is why English is our internal company language. We’re #stoked to shape the future, #together as a team, and #humble in our mission to support the builders of tomorrow. For a first impression of us, take a look at our Instagram and LinkedIn page . Diversity makes us better. We welcome people of all backgrounds, identities, abilities, and experiences, and we believe that different perspectives lead to better ideas, stronger products, and a healthier workplace. If you’re excited about our mission but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be exactly who we’re looking for. ______ On the application process We want your candidate experience with us to be smooth, transparent, and enjoyable. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process typically takes about 4 weeks from start to finish, though this may vary by role. You can learn more about our process here . If you need adjustments or flexibility at any stage, please don’t hesitate to let us know — we’ll do our best to make it work for you. Note on creating a test account: If you would like to create a test account as part of the challenge, please enter "Applicant" in the relevant field during registration and select "Other" under Trade. This ensures that our sales team does not mistakenly register you as a craft business and reach out to you unnecessarily. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Fullstack Software Engineer (M/W/D) – AI-Native Development
description: Was wir tun Als IoT Pioniere entwickeln wir mit mittlerweile über 40 Kollegen*innen an drei Standorten IoT-Komplettlösungen für unsere Kunden. Aktuell sind weltweit über 500.000 Geräte und Anlagen mit unseren Lösungen für Machine-to-Machine-Kommunikation ausgestattet. Unsere Kompetenz liegt in der Entwicklung kundenspezifischer IoT-Lösungen, basierend auf unserer Erfahrung, unseren erprobten Software-Bausteinen und einer Vielzahl von bereits realisierten Projekten. Unser Team Seit der Firmengründung im Jahr 2004 sind wir stetig gewachsen und haben uns in diesem Markt über die Jahre als starker Partner etabliert. Damit das auch so bleibt, erweitern wir kontinuierlich unser Team mit talentierten und qualifizierten Entwickler*innen. Durch vielseitige Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten, Teilnahme an Konferenzen und Workshops sowie eine ausgeprägte Feedback-Kultur heben wir unser Team auf die nächste Stufe. Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt eine(n) Fullstack Software Engineer (M/W/D) an den Standorten GARBSEN (bei Hannover), BISSENDORF (bei Osnabrück) oder Berlin Deine Aufgaben Du willst nicht nur Features abarbeiten, sondern Anwendungen als Ganzes verstehen, gestalten und weiterentwickeln? Bei der INSIDE M2M GmbH entwickelst du anspruchsvolle Softwarelösungen für unsere IoT-Plattform. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt in Angular und TypeScript – und du entwickelst den Fluss durchgängig über Backend-Services mit Java und Quarkus – bis hin zu den Devices. KI-gestützte Coding-Tools und Coding Agents gehören für dich zum Handwerk, nicht zum Hype. Du setzt sie souverän ein, bewertest ihre Ergebnisse kritisch und verantwortest Qualität, Sicherheit und Wartbarkeit deines Codes. Du entwickelst komplexe Angular-Anwendungen mit sauberer Komponentenarchitektur – von der Konzeption bis zur produktiven Nutzung. Du arbeitest an den dazugehörigen Backend-Services in Java und Quarkus und gestaltest die Schnittstellen zwischen Frontend und Plattform mit. Du integrierst KI-gestützte Coding-Tools und Coding Agents fest in deinen Workflow. Du bringst dich in Architekturentscheidungen, Code Reviews und die Verbesserung unserer Entwicklungsprozesse ein. Du arbeitest eng mit deinem Team, unseren Kunden und weiteren technischen Ansprechpartnern zusammen. Das bringst du mit Mehrjährige Praxis in der professionellen Softwareentwicklung. Ausgeprägte Praxis in Angular und TypeScript sowie gute bis sehr gute Kenntnisse in Java und Quarkus im Backend. Vertrautheit mit REST-APIs, Datenbanken und ORM. Erfahrung mit automatisierten Tests, inklusive E2E-Testing. Nachweisbare Praxis mit AI-Coding-Workflows – z. B. mit Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot oder vergleichbaren Tools. Du kannst erklären, welche Prompts, Setups und Guardrails bei dir funktionieren – und wo die Grenzen liegen. Gutes Gespür für Softwarearchitektur, Codequalität und langfristig wartbare Lösungen. Eine eigenverantwortliche, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift – für die Zusammenarbeit mit Team und Kunden zwingend erforderlich. Gute Englischkenntnisse für technische Dokumentationen und internationale Tools. Ein Plus, aber kein Muss Hintergrund in der Entwicklung oder Weiterentwicklung einer IoT-Plattform Erfahrung mit verteilten Systemen, Gerätedaten, Messaging oder technischen Schnittstellen Kenntnisse in Docker, Kubernetes und Cloud-native Development Vertrautheit mit CI/CD, Observability oder Platform Engineering Klingt nach dir? Dann möchten wir dich kennenlernen. Erzähl uns gerne, an welchen Softwarelösungen du bisher gearbeitet hast und wie du KI-gestützte Werkzeuge in deinem Alltag einsetzt. title: Senior Customer Success Manager (all genders)
description: Als VC-backed Foodtech-Startup schaffen wir den Spagat zwischen gesunder Ernährung, Verfügbarkeit und Nachhaltigkeit. Mit unseren Foodjis bringen wir ultrafrische, leckere Gerichte genau dorthin, wo du die meiste Zeit verbringst – denn wir haben uns zum Ziel gesetzt, über 10 Millionen Arbeitnehmern endlich Zugang zu gesunder Ernährung zu ermöglichen und gleichzeitig Foodwaste zu reduzieren. Gestalte das perfekte Foodji-Erlebnis Ein großartiges Produkt allein reicht nicht – echte Kundenzufriedenheit entsteht durch starke Beziehungen und einen klaren Blick auf die Entwicklung des Kundenportfolios. Du machst den konkreten Nutzen und Mehrwert von Foodji sichtbar und schaffst damit die Grundlage für langfristige Partnerschaften. Deine Mission bei Foodji: (Enterprise-) Kund:innen begleitest du von der Testphase über den Vertragsabschluss durch die gesamte Customer Lifetime. Für dein Kundenportfolio übernimmst du Verantwortung und sorgst dafür, dass Kund:innen Foodji erfolgreich nutzen, langfristig bleiben, wachsen und uns weiterempfehlen. Stabile und vertrauensvolle Beziehungen zu zentralen Entscheider:innen und dezentralen Stakeholdern baust du gezielt auf und entwickelst sie weiter. Verantwortung für die Gesundheit und Weiterentwicklung deines Enterprise-Kundenportfolios – von der KPI-basierten Analyse der Account Health bis zur Ableitung gezielter Maßnahmen. Vertragsverlängerungen bereitest du aktiv vor und erkennst Kündigungsrisiken frühzeitig – auch wenn sie zunächst nur an einem einzelnen Standort auftreten. Steuerung von internen und crossfunktionalen Projekten zur Weiterentwicklung des Customer Success Bereichs. DAS BRINGST DU MIT Mindestens drei Jahre Erfahrung im Customer Success Management sowie nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Steuerung von Retention-, Vertragsverlängerungs- und Churn-Kennzahlen über ein Kundenportfolio hinweg. Strukturierte, datengetriebene und eigenständige Arbeitsweise mit einem guten Gespür für Kundenbeziehungen sowie der Fähigkeit, Risiken, Kundenpotenziale und nächste Schritte selbstständig zu priorisieren. Erfahrung im Umgang mit CRM-Systemen, insbesondere Salesforce, sowie sehr gute Excel-Kenntnisse. Kommunikationsstärke auf Entscheider:innenebene – auch in anspruchsvollen Gesprächen – sowie die Fähigkeit, komplexe Multi-Standort-Accounts mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern strategisch zu betreuen. Deutschkenntnisse auf muttersprachlichem Niveau sowie fließende Englischkenntnisse. Präsentations- und Argumentationsfähigkeit sowie ausgeprägte Networking-Kompetenzen. Ein „Do-it“-Mindset, Teamfähigkeit, Selbstbewusstsein sowie eine lösungs- und zielorientierte Arbeitsweise. NOCH FRAGEN? Wir freuen uns auf deine Nachricht und helfen dir gerne weiter! DAS BIETEN WIR Office Foodji & Lunchit App: Immer bestens versorgt bei uns im Office oder Remote Uncapped Bonus: Deine Leistung bestimmt dein Gehalt – nach oben gibt es keine Grenze bAV: Mit der Degura Pension Cloud sichern und bezuschussen wir jetzt schon deine Rente Spendit Card: Wir stocken dein Gehalt auf! Mit Spendit stehen dir bis zu fünfzig Euro netto im Monat on top zur freien Verfügung EGYM Wellpass: Mit uns bleibst du fit & wir bringen dich deutschlandweit in die angesagtesten Fitness- und Wellnessstudios JobRad: Spring mit uns aufs Rad und lease dir dein Traumrad oder Pedelec KITA/Kiga Kostenzuschuss: Wir bezuschussen deine Kosten für die Kinderbetreuung, damit deine Kinder immer bestens versorgt sind Mitarbeiterrabatte: Du erhältst attraktive Promotions und Discounts verschiedener Brands Food Tastings: Teste dich mit unserem Foodteam durch unsere Produkte und gestalte unser Sortiment von morgen Development: Deine Weiterentwicklung liegt uns am Herzen und mit regelmäßigen Feedbackgesprächen und Trainings bieten wir dir spannende Entwicklungspfade – z. B. vom SDR zum Account Executive Flexwork: Arbeite 30 Tage im Jahr aus dem EU Ausland Top Office Lage: Genieße eine erstklassige Arbeitsumgebung im Münchener Glockenbachviertel mit der Isar vor der Tür Team Events: Wir sind ein Team - beim Skiday, Frühstück, Culture Week oder Office Party feiern wir gemeinsam! ÜBER UNS Hi, schön, dass du da bist! Wir sind Foodji - ein Team aus Food-Lovern & Tech-Nerds. Unsere Mission ist es, frisches, gesundes und vor allem leckeres Essen überall dort anzubieten, wo Menschen den Großteil ihres Alltags verbringen – in Büros, ganz gleich, ob im Gewerbegebiet oder mitten in der Stadt, während langer Schichten im Krankenhaus oder in den Tiefen einer Produktionshalle, in der rund um die Uhr Menschen arbeiten. Überall bieten wir vollwertige Gerichte, Snacks und Getränke genau dort an, wo und wann du sie brauchst. Proprietäre Technologien, selbstlernende Algorithmen und effiziente Lieferketten helfen uns dabei, das Paradox zwischen frischem Essen, Verfügbarkeit und Nachhaltigkeit aufzulösen. Mit unserer eigens entwickelten Technologieplattform optimieren wir die Mengenplanung und sagen Food Waste den Kampf an. Wir wollen einen positiven Effekt erzielen – auf die Umwelt, den Alltag unserer Kund:innen und unsere Communities. Deshalb spenden wir übrig gebliebene Gerichte an Foodsharing und andere soziale Initiativen direkt vor unserer Haustür. Als Marktführer versorgen wir mit Foodji bereits täglich Tausende Menschen in ganz Deutschland. Zu unseren Kund:innen zählen unter anderem der Münchner Flughafen, Klarna, Enpal und Wingcopter. Und wir fangen gerade erst an: Allein in Deutschland gibt es mehr als 100.000 relevante Standorte für uns. Trage auch du deinen Teil dazu bei und bewirb dich jetzt. title: Senior Odoo Engineer ERP & E-Commerce (all genders)
description: Introduction Do you want to do more than just maintain an ERP system—do you want to help shape its future? As a Senior Odoo Engineer for ERP & E-Commerce (all genders), you’ll take responsibility for our Odoo platform—the system that powers sales, order processing, logistics, and accounting. You’ll further develop our in-house modules, continue the migration to the Odoo standard, integrate new countries, standardize payment processes, and build our new online store—ensuring it’s fully upgradeable, with streamlined workflows and genuine creative freedom. Your mission The focus is on further developing our Odoo platform—which includes approximately 25 in-house modules—and upgrading it to the target version. In doing so, you’ll rely on an upgrade-friendly architecture based on inheritance rather than modifications to the Odoo core Another key focus of your work will be migrating existing processes to the Odoo standard and integrating new countries—including localization, accounting, and country-specific requirements You’ll ensure seamless and efficient payment processes by integrating PSP connections, SEPA direct debit, and PSD2/SCA, and by managing the interfaces with adjacent systems Together with the relevant stakeholders, you’ll implement our new, mobile-friendly website and online store based on Odoo E-Commerce You ensure code quality and testability, document architecture and design decisions, and provide technical guidance to development partners Your profile You have several years of experience in Odoo development with Python and have implemented your own modules from requirements through to go-live You have worked with Odoo Enterprise in production environments—including Odoo.sh—for several years and are proficient with Git in professional development and deployment processes For you, Odoo is not just a configuration tool: ORM, inheritance, Views, and QWeb, access rights, and cron jobs are all part of your skill set—ideally complemented by Odoo E-Commerce You confidently analyze existing software, refactor it strategically, and further develop it with a focus on quality, maintainability, and stability Experience with Odoo upgrades, data migrations, multi-company setups, or integrating payment service providers is a definite plus You work in a structured and independent manner, document clearly, and communicate on an equal footing in German and English Why us? Diversity enriches our team and creates space for innovation and shared success. Values that bring us together For ValueNet, sustainability is more than just a word—it is an integral part of our actions, our products, and our services. Enthusiasm, trust, courage, and responsibility shape our culture. title: Product Engineer (Backend/AI) @Briink
description: What we do At Briink , we’re building AI technology for the global sustainability economy. We work with the world’s largest climate organizations, including CDP and PRI, and multinational companies such as Bayer, Siemens, Commerzbank, E.ON, and Heidelberg Materials. Our technology helps automate how sustainability data is collected, analyzed, verified, and acted on. Through our work with global climate organizations, what you build at Briink will directly impact the sustainability workflows of more than 30,000 companies, investors, and cities worldwide. We’re a small team working at enormous scale. Your code won’t sit behind an internal tool or an experimental demo — it will help shape how some of the world’s largest organizations understand and act on their environmental impact. Based at Berlin’s AI Campus, with a second office in London, and backed by over €7 million in funding, we want to prove that some of the world’s most powerful technology can also be a powerful force for good. Application requirement: Intro video As part of your application, please submit a short intro video (max 2 minutes) answering: Who you are and what you have done/built that is relevant for this role. Why you’re excited about owning and shipping AI-powered products at Briink. Why Briink’s sustainability mission resonates with you. Upload your video using this form (YouTube unlisted, Loom, or any other solution is fine). We do this to get a better sense of candidates before continuing the process. Any application without a video will not be considered ;) Your role As Briink’s Backend/AI Product Engineer , you’ll join a small, high-ownership product and engineering team building AI-powered products for sustainability professionals. This is not a narrowly scoped backend role. You’ll take meaningful product problems from initial discovery and user conversations through technical design, implementation, and iteration to deploy them at scale across the ESG market. You’ll combine strong backend and AI/LLM engineering with product judgement and the initiative to work out what should be built - not just how to action a predefined ticket. You will: Own product features end to end , from understanding the user problem and defining the right approach through to delivery, measurement, and improvement. Design and build scalable backend systems , including APIs, data models, workflows, and infrastructure for complex enterprise products. Build and ship applied AI/LLM features , such as LLM chains, RAG systems, tool-using agents, structured-output pipelines, and evaluation workflows Create reusable, extensible platform building blocks that support multiple user journeys and reporting workflows rather than solving each problem in isolation. Improve the robustness of our systems , strengthening reliability, testing, observability, performance, and maintainability as we scale. Work directly with users, product, and data , using qualitative feedback and product data to understand the real problem and evaluate whether a solution works. Prototype and test new AI capabilities , turning promising ideas into practical product improvements that accelerate our roadmap. Bring thoughtful opinions and constructive challenge , helping the team make better product and technical decisions. Collaborate closely with other engineers , including through pair programming, technical design discussions, and shared problem-solving. Your profile Technical requirements Strong professional backend engineering experience , with a track record of designing and shipping reliable production systems. Experience in a small, high-ownership product team , ideally within a startup or scale-up engineering organisation of roughly 5–20 engineers. Evidence that you have shipped meaningful products end to end , rather than owning only a narrow component within a much larger organisation. Strong experience in Python (or another modern backend language such as Java, Ruby, or TypeScript, combined with the ability and willingness to become productive in Python quickly). Strong API, database, and systems design skills , with the ability to model complex workflows and build maintainable foundations for enterprise products. Applied AI/LLM experience : you have experience or a strong interest in LLM-powered features, ideally involving RAG or retrieval, tool use, agents, structured outputs, or evaluation systems. A solid software-quality mindset , including testing, code review, CI/CD, observability, and pragmatic approaches to reliability and security. Cloud and container experience , with an understanding of how to deploy, operate, and scale production workloads. Fluent English (C1+) , both written and spoken. Nice to have Experience building workflow, reporting, questionnaire, or other complex B2B SaaS products . Familiarity with backend technologies such as FastAPI, PostgreSQL, background queues Any experience with LangChain, LangSmith, or other LLM frameworks Deeper experience with RAG, retrieval, agents, LLM evaluation, and production AI systems . Experience improving latency, cost, and reliability for AI workloads. Knowledge of ESG, sustainability, climate tech, or corporate reporting . German language skills. Who you are Kind and collaborative : You treat people well, communicate clearly, and help create a supportive, low-ego team environment. Mission-driven : You care about using technology to accelerate sustainability and climate action. Sharp and curious : You learn quickly, ask good questions, and enjoy getting to the root of difficult product and technical problems. A product-minded builder : You think beyond the task in front of you, focus on the user’s real problem, and care about whether what you ship creates value. Highly self-directed : You thrive in a fast-moving environment with autonomy, ambiguity, and limited oversight. Pragmatic and action-oriented : You can move from ideas to experiments to production without waiting for perfect requirements. Opinionated but open-minded : You challenge ideas constructively, welcome pushback, and enjoy thinking through problems with others. Commercially aware and creative : You balance technical quality with user needs, business value, and speed. If your experience doesn’t align precisely with all the criteria, don't worry! We encourage you to still apply. Many people miss out on opportunities because they feel they don’t fit every requirement—we believe in attitude, growth and iteration, not perfection! What we offer Competitive salary and equity , reflecting your impact and ownership. Purpose-driven mission : Build tools that help organisations act more sustainably and make the ESG data ecosystem more transparent. Flexible hybrid setup : Berlin or London based candidates are strongly preferred, with access to our team and the wider startup community at the Merantix AI Campus. Trust and autonomy : Own meaningful problems, shape the product, and influence how we build as the company grows. A genuinely high-impact role : Increase our delivery capacity, strengthen the robustness of our platform, and accelerate product innovation. Dynamic environment : Work in a small, ambitious team at the intersection of applied AI, enterprise software, and sustainability. Learning budget and quarterly hackathons : Explore new technologies and prototype ideas that push Briink forward. A thoughtful hiring process : We are focused on finding the right person, and are willing to take the time needed to do so. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Software Engineer: Full-Stack, Backend, Frontend (m/w/d)
description: Was wir bieten Eine dynamische und ehrgeizige Umgebung, die dir eine steile Lernkurve und die Möglichkeit zum Wachstum garantiert. Eine flexible und moderne Arbeitskultur, die dir die Vorteile der heutigen digitalen Möglichkeiten und Tools bietet. Innovative Technologie und Herangehensweisen, die sicherstellen, dass deine tägliche Arbeit sinnvoll und wirkungsvoll ist. Ein engagiertes Team, das zusammenarbeiten und voneinander lernen möchte. Sei Teil unseres agilen, interdisziplinären Entwicklungsteams und entwerfe und realisiere UI-Komponenten, Backend-Funktionalitäten, DevOps Pipelines, Datenintegrationen oder Systemarchitekturen. Arbeite mit aktuellen Technologien und Standards wie Azure, Terraform, Kubenetes, Domain Driven Design, Micro Service Architekturen, OPC-UA oder MQTT. Sei technischer Ansprechpartner für unsere Kunden und präsentiere technische Konzepte und Ergebnisse. Dein Profil Du bringst sehr gute Kenntnisse TypeScript/JavaScript (Node.js sowie React, Angular oder vergleichbare Web-Component-Ansätze) mit. Wünschenswert sind außerdem gute Kenntnisse in Java Spring Boot und Python. Du hast bereits Berufserfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung, vorzugsweise in agilen Umgebungen. Docker, Terraform, Kubernetes oder OpenShift sind keine Fremdwörter für dich. Du bringst Interesse an Daten und KI-Lösungen mit. Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium in Informatik, einem vergleichbaren Fachgebiet oder eine gleichwertige praktische Erfahrung. Du hast eine selbstständige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise und triffst technische Entscheidungen auch dann, wenn die Anforderungen noch nicht vollständig sind. Du hast hervorragende Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch und Englisch in Wort und Schrift. Du scheust nicht davor zurück eng mit technischen Kundenansprechpartnern zu arbeiten und hast eine Reisebereitschaft von bis zu 80%. Wie wir ticken Jeder bei uns handelt, wie ein Entrepreneur : Wir lieben die Freiheit selbstbestimmt und mit Wirkung zu arbeiten. Wir fördern flache Hierarchien. Dies erreichen wir dadurch, dass jeder auf die eigene Person, Position und Fähigkeit angepasst wie ein Entrepreneur handelt. Wir helfen Innovatoren zu gewinnen: Wir sind Evangelisten der Innovation! Innovation = Idee + Umsetzung + Mehrwert! Für uns steht es im Vordergrund, die Welt mit Innovationen zu verbessern. Bei unseren Kunden arbeiten wir oft mit Innovatoren zusammen, die viele Herausforderungen vor sich haben. Unser Ziel ist es, ihnen zu helfen erfolgreich mit Ihren Vorhaben zu sein. Wir handeln eigenverantwortlich aber teamorientiert: Jeder und jede Einzelne übernimmt die Verantwortung für seine Aufgaben und Entscheidungen, behält dabei jedoch immer das gemeinsame Ziel und die Zusammenarbeit mit dem Team im Blick. Es geht darum, selbstständig zu handeln und gleichzeitig die Stärken aller zu nutzen und zu fördern. Wir überholen unsere Wettbewerber indem wir schneller lernen: In unserem Umfeld finden rasante Entwicklungen statt und der Markt ändert sich in hohem Tempo. Wir können nicht alles wissen, wollen uns aber konsequent weiterentwickeln, Neues ausprobieren und Erfahrungen rasch in Verbesserungen umsetzen. Durch diesen Fokus auf schnelles Lernen können wir zügiger auf Marktveränderungen reagieren und Innovationen vorantreiben. Wir achten uns, die Dinge, die wir tun und wie wir diese tun: Wir behandeln uns selbst, unsere Mitmenschen und unsere Aufgaben mit Sorgfalt und Respekt. Dabei geht es nicht nur um das Ergebnis, sondern auch um den Weg dorthin – wir sind uns der Auswirkungen unseres Handelns bewusst und setzen uns für einen positiven Einfluss ein. You partner with product, design and other engineers to make sure we build what matters - not just what you have been told to do. You take real responsibility for production: when something is slow, you find out why, whether the answer is a bad query, application code or the infrastructure underneath. You also help us make AI reliable in production. Document extraction, long-running analysis jobs and agentic features are core to where the product is going, and we need people who make these workflows testable and dependable rather than impressive in a demo. Integrate LLMs into backend workflows - especially document and data extraction - and make them reliable, verifyable and testable. Debug production. You have taken ownership of at least one core area e.g. the permission model, the job orchestration layer or the LLM extraction pipeline and are the person the team goes to for it. You designed workers, dealt with retries and partial failures, orchestrated multi-step workflows. You've designed or worked with authorization for a multi-tenant product and know where it might get hairy. You'd rather have one integration test that hits a real database schema than ten unit tests mocking everything. You write the test that catches the broken migration. You treat production as a debuggable system. You can navigate dashboards and traces to figure out why something is slow, and you don't treat infrastructure as someone else's problem. You communicate clearly - with engineers, product and, when needed, directly with customers. You speak German at C1 level or better and English fluently. Our customers are German banks and asset managers, and you will talk to them. Bonus: AWS (S3, SES, ECS, RDS, …) and IaC. LLMs in production, especially document or data extraction and making it reliable for actual user workflows. Data pipeline work: staged, reproducible processing, dataset versioning. Mentoring or leading engineers, or wanting to grow into it. Debugging tooling and build issues, not just application code. Our toolchain moves fast and is occasionally non-standard. Why Predium? Stage: ~40 people, well-funded, on the way to defining the category. Early enough that a lot still needs to be built. Yes, it's messy sometimes - that's the whole point. If you're looking for a job with a finished playbook, this isn't the right fit. Impact: You're not cog #100 in some company. What you build here runs in production and is what customers rely on every day. Your contribution shows up directly, in revenue and in the product. Ownership: We don't manage your time, we measure your results. You get responsibility and freedom - and the expectation that you'll use both. Compensation: Competitive salary, bonus, and equity. title: Senior Software Engineer
description: <p>Catapult is building the future of sports performance technology, with a mission to <strong>Unleash the Potential</strong> of every athlete and team on earth. We don't just work in the sporting industry; we are actively changing it.  Since 2006, our solutions have been leading the way in sports performance software, science, and data, in a world where 1% can literally mean the difference between winning and losing.</p> <p>We work with over 5,000+ teams around the world, empowering coaches, managers and trainers in premier teams in the NFL, NBA, NHL, MLS, EPL, AFL, NRL, NCAA and more. We provide the information they need to optimize athletes’ health, game-day readiness, and performance, as well as in-game tactics.  </p> <p>Catapult is a sports technology company that empowers professional teams to make data-driven decisions. We deliver health, performance, video, and AI insights from the locker room to competitive environments, ensuring every decision is an opportunity to gain an advantage, sharpen performance, and build lasting success.</p> <h3><strong>WE WANT PEOPLE WHO ARE PASSIONATE ABOUT </strong><strong>STATE-OF-THE-ART TECHNOLOGY</strong><strong>  </strong></h3> <p>We are looking for a talented <strong>Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer</strong> with a drive to build quality products.</p> <p>This role offers the opportunity to contribute across multiple applications and throughout the entire technology stack, from databases and backend services to APIs and front-end development.</p> <p>Based in Cologne, you will be a key player in the Engineering team working on the IMPECT family of applications. You’ll contribute to IMPECT’s internal services that power our data ecosystem, sourcing and managing data from external providers, ingesting and recording video content, and enabling large-scale event collection and annotation. You’ll also help build and evolve the systems that support our data collection workforce, including tools for task assignment, progress tracking, deadline management, quality assurance, and accurate compensation. In addition, you’ll develop database-driven tools that ensure consistency and detect anomalies, safeguarding data quality when integrating multiple data sources. IMPECT’s applications are written in modern frameworks and provide exciting challenges. As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you’ll be part of a highly motivated team building and evolving the core services that power our data collection platform, forming the foundation for the applications we deliver to our customers.</p> <p>We believe that our customers deserve to have the leading technology, and we are on a mission to make the best possible products to enhance their performance.  Our engineers drive this ethos by making sure all of this technology comes together in a way our customers love to use.</p> <p><strong>WHAT YOU’LL DO </strong></p> <ul> <li>Contribute to the full software development lifecycle, including requirements gathering, design, implementation, testing, and deployment.</li> <li>Build and maintain Angular web applications</li> <li>Build and maintain Java Spring Boot APIs and backend services that power our applications</li> <li>Design and implement database schema</li> <li>Profile and optimize query performance in backend applications</li> <li>Engage in architectural discussions to help design scalable and resilient systems.</li> <li>Work directly with Product and Design on scoping and designing features</li> <li>Work in multidisciplinary teams and interface with other engineers in our team and across various domains.</li> <li>Document your work in a shared knowledge base platform.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>WHAT YOU’LL NEED</strong></h3> <ul> <li>At least 5 years of software development experience.</li> <li>Demonstrated experience programming in Typescript, Javascript, and Angular</li> <li>Demonstrated experience programming in Kotlin or Java.</li> <li>Demonstrated experience working in SQL and designing database schema</li> <li>Ability to reason about and debug complex systems and applications</li> <li>Experience with Git code management is highly desired.</li> </ul> <p>Other Requirements:</p> <ul> <li>Very strong attention to detail.</li> <li>Proven self-starter.</li> <li>Ability to communicate well, both verbally and in writing.</li> <li>Ability to prioritise and a “can-do” attitude.</li> <li>Occasionally providing technical assistance to our customer support team</li> </ul> <p><strong>WHY CATAPULT? </strong></p> <ul> <li>We have amazing people. We can promise you will work with some of the most ambitious and intelligent people in an exciting industry, and you will do some of the best work of your life.</li> <li>We encourage our people to have constructive, open and honest communication in order to make Catapult extraordinary; innovate and create smart solutions; establish a collaborative, yet challenging, environment to develop our performance and the performance of our customers.</li> <li>Our workforce spans more than 20 countries, you'll have the opportunity to work across multiple nationalities and cultures, and build your global awareness and capability </li> <li>We value improvement and development. title: Senior Software Engineer - Platform & Infrastructure (f/m/d)
description: The product you will work on The HOLOPLOT Matrix Array is a new type of sound system built around precise, software-defined control of sound in three dimensions - grounded in physics and implemented through a combination of custom hardware and purpose-built software. HOLOPLOT deployed Matrix Arrays in various venues, including the Sphere in Las Vegas - the world’s most advanced entertainment venue and, notably, home to the world’s largest audio installation in entertainment. Audio processing in HOLOPLOT systems is distributed: every loudspeaker runs embedded Linux, and hundreds of them have to be configured, coordinated, monitored, and updated as one system. This is enabled by multiple open source and in-house developed services running on an on-premises Kubernetes cluster. AWS-hosted services connect venues to remote monitoring, telemetry, and configuration. Many venues are air-gapped or only intermittently connected for remote servicing, and that constraint shapes most of the design decisions in the platform. The ideal candidate is We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer who builds the platform our sound systems run on, and who takes responsibility for how it behaves in production. This is a software engineering role first. You will spend your time writing software, either with your own team or embedded with one of the other HOLOPLOT teams: services, controllers, agents, and tooling that provision, configure, observe, and update our systems. Our infrastructure is defined as code and evolves through the same review and release process as the rest of our software. You design the operational side, you build it, and you are on call when it misbehaves in the field. Your role and responsibilities You will join the team that owns the platform underneath our installations and connected services, working alongside backend, embedded, and frontend engineers who are organized in cross-functional product teams. Build the platform Architect and implement services to provision, configure, and manage server fleets across AWS and local clusters. Create control-plane logic for venue systems to ensure consistency, health monitoring, rollout management, and recovery, even during uplink disruptions. Establish end-to-end provisioning workflows for embedded Linux hardware, spanning from initial manufacturing to customer deployment. Enhance update processes to streamline software deployments for active customer installations. Develop APIs and developer tooling that empower engineering teams to independently deploy, observe, and troubleshoot their services. Embed telemetry capabilities into the platform to facilitate remote diagnosis of venue system behavior . Run what you build Own the AWS infrastructure behind our connected services: remote access, access control, telemetry ingestion, remote backup, secret management, and monitoring. All of it is infrastructure as code. Operate and evolve the on-premises Kubernetes footprint at venues, including air-gapped and intermittently connected installations. Monitor large environments, investigate problems across the software/hardware boundary, and turn each incident into a fix in the code. Be part of a compensated on-call rotation Set the technical direction Advise and collaborate with product teams on building distributed systems that are scalable, secure, and observable, and review their designs with production reality in mind. Research and introduce tools and technologies where they measurably improve how we build and operate. Contribute back to the open-source projects we depend on, through issues and fixes. What you need to succeed in this role Several years of professional software engineering experience, most of it spent designing and shipping production systems. Fluency in software engineering as a craft: concurrency, error handling, testing, and designing APIs that other teams build on. Working knowledge of the Kubernetes control plane and the operator/controller pattern, including how clusters behave when they are unhealthy. Hands-on experience with AWS, and a firm belief in infrastructure as code. Terraform and Ansible are what we use today. Comfort across several languages, and the ability to pick up a new one when the problem calls for it. Our platform work is mostly Go and Python, with Rust and C++ elsewhere in the stack. Experience building distributed systems, and a clear understanding of how they fail: partitions, partial rollouts, clock skew, retries, and reconciliation. A good sense for software architecture and maintainability, and the habit of writing code that colleagues can pick up and change. A strong command of Linux, scripting, and automation. Experience instrumenting software for telemetry and using it to answer real questions about running systems. Good judgment about what to automate and what to leave alone. Strong communication skills in English. You can explain a design or a failure clearly to engineers, product stakeholders, and non-specialists. Willingness to take part in compensated on-call and weekend work when installations need it. A can-do mentality, an eye for detail, and the courage to take on problems outside your comfort zone. Experience in using AI for engineering. Nice to haves Experience with NATS, Prometheus/Thanos, or PostgreSQL in production. Experience with air-gapped or intermittently connected installations. Experience running Kubernetes in production, not only deploying to it. Experience with embedded Linux, device fleet management, or IoT security. Networking depth: multicast at scale, WireGuard, BGP, IPv6. Experience in the audio, broadcast, or live events industry. Contributions to open-source infrastructure projects We offer you At HOLOPLOT we work in a flexible hybrid setup with trust-based working hours, giving you the freedom to organise your day in a way that supports focus, deep work and balance. Pay is competitive and fair, and we offer perks and benefits such as subsidised public transport, lunch allowances, Urban Sports and a company pension scheme. You’ll join an international, open-minded team across software, hardware, product and research, in an environment with plenty of autonomy and ownership. You’ll work on cutting-edge audio technology, turn complex requirements into working solutions and contribute to global projects, with support for your growth through individual development plans, mentoring and coaching. title: Senior Director Software Engineering (f/m/d)
description: Who we are and what you’ll do HOLOPLOT is seeking a decisive, technically strong and business-oriented Senior Director Software Engineering (f/m/d), to lead our 20-person software engineering organization, drive cross-functional delivery, and own the long-term software architecture for our high-performance audio products. Working closely with engineering leads who focus on deep technical problem-solving and team mentorship, this role leads overall software delivery, strategic technical vision, and cross-departmental alignment. Main objectives of the role As Senior Director Software Engineering (f/m/d), you will take full technical ownership of the end-to-end delivery of HOLOPLOT’s software ecosystem, spanning embedded and distributed Linux systems, audio DSP, 3D/GPU, C++, Rust and web-based front-end applications, Kubernetes cluster and cloud infrastructure. You will act as the operational bridge between software engineering, hardware development, research, product, customer success teams, and key enterprise clients. You will work closely with the Director of Product for Software as well as the CPO, and report to the CTO. Your role and responsibilities Strategic Software Vision & Architecture : Own and drive the strategic vision for the technical backbone of the HOLOPLOT product ecosystem. Proactively identify architectural risks and ensure performance and scalability across embedded hardware, audio processing platforms, and user interfaces. Execution & High-Stakes Delivery : Take full accountability for software delivery timeliness, quality, and reliability. Proactively lead critical client-facing missions, OS rollouts, and on-site integration handovers (e.g., venue acceptance testing and integration protocols), including regular international travel High-Performing Mission-Driven Teams : Attract, grow, and retain strong engineering talent to build highly successful, cross-functional product development teams. Foster a culture of excellence, ownership, agency, and innovation that drives high employee engagement, productivity, and strong outcomes for our customers. Cross-Functional Alignment : Drive seamless collaboration between Software, Research, Customer Success, Product Management, and external technical partners (such as client IT security and external system integrators). Eliminate inter-departmental friction and establish clear integration pathways. Business-First Leadership : Together with Product, align software priorities and architecture directly with HOLOPLOT’s strategic and commercial objectives. Make decisive, well-reasoned trade-offs under pressure while optimizing engineering output for maximum company value. Operational Leadership & Partnering : Partner with dedicated Engineering Managers and Tech Leads who oversee team culture, individual mentoring, and deeply technical topics. Foster a culture of engineering excellence, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Focus your impact on operational discipline, accountability, and clear departmental direction. AI Strategy & Development Workflows : Define and execute HOLOPLOT's AI strategy for software development. Integrate AI-assisted engineering tools, automated workflows, and emerging AI technologies into the software development life cycle to elevate team productivity and explore modern product capabilities. Platform, Quality & Operational Excellence: Ensure high standards of quality, reliability, maintainability, and scalability across all software solutions. Identify, assess, and mitigate technological risks, including technical debt and platform lifecycle challenges. Define and improve engineering processes, development standards, and tooling to enable predictable, high-quality delivery. Security, Compliance & Risk Management: Drive HOLOPLOT’s technology security strategy, including cybersecurity, data protection, and secure-by-design principles. Ensure compliance with relevant industry standards, validation/certifications, and regulatory requirements. Ensure systems are resilient, reliable, and fit for production and customer use. What you need to succeed in this role Engineering Leadership : Extensive experience managing software teams of significant size (15-30+ engineers) in complex, multi-disciplinary technology environments Deep-Tech Literacy : Comfortable navigating a highly heterogeneous tech stack encompassing Low-Level/Embedded C++ & Rust, Audio DSP, 3D/GPU rendering, Linux, Kubernetes, NATS, gRPC, JUCE, CI/CD and Web services. Track Record of Ownership : Proven experience driving complex hardware-software product rollouts and managing high-stakes client or partner integrations end-to-end.
