title: Senior Product Manager (ISR) Defence & Intelligence (f/m/x)
description: Build the Market Leader in Satellite Analytics with us at LiveEO We are looking for a Senior Product Manager ( ISR ) (f/m/x) to own the product and delivery side of LiveEO's defence and intelligence business. Sektion 4 builds AI-based ISR capabilities for German and allied defence and intelligence customers: object and change detection in very high resolution satellite imagery, 3D terrain products derived from stereo imagery, and the analytics that turn imagery into decisions. You will run our customer-facing defence products end to end from a product management perspective including analytical products as well as end user applications. You will also build the roadmap that connects different customer timelines, our concept of operations and the actual maturity of our technical components into one plan that engineering and sales both work from. This role exists because our LiveEO engineers build world class AI models and your work will help to bring them into operations and roll them out to many more end users. We need someone who can say how an analyst does the job, write requirements a military user would recognise, and hold the line on what we ship. LiveEO is a dynamic team that thrives on big challenges and fast learning cycles. We move quickly, stay curious, and genuinely enjoy building together. We are on a mission to break the "curse of Earth Observation": turning incredible satellite data into reliable, actionable decisions that people can trust and use in real operations on scale. You will be part of Sektion 4, LiveEO's government-solutions product team. Sektion 4 owns its roadmap and delivers funded R&D projects and defence engagements end-to-end, from research through to production, and sets its own technical direction. You will work day to day with the team's ML engineergs, full-stack engineers and geospatial data egineers, and across LiveEO with sales, pre-sales and the teams building the Twinspector satellite programme. Externally you are in front of military and agency users, partners and integrators, in workshops, requirement sessions and user tests. Tech stack & tools: Linear (backlog, sprints) Confluence Google Workspace LiveEO's own ISR and analytics applications Figma QGIS and comparable viewers STAC -based imagery catalogs Data: very high resolution optical imagery synthetic aperture radar 3D surface models cloud and secure on-premise / air-gapped deployments agentic tools for a variety of work. Your challenge As Product Manager (f/m/x), you own what we build for defence and intelligence customers, and you are accountable for it reaching them. Own the ISR product: take our imagery intelligence application from working demonstrator to deployable product. Define the release scope, the deployment and support model for secure on-premise environments, and drive the first installation at a real user. Run the backlog: work with the engineering team in two-week sprints. Translate operational needs into written requirements and user stories, prioritise ruthlessly, cut scope when it is the right call, and keep the team pointed at what matters. Deliver defence projects end to end: own scope, milestones, deliverables and stakeholder communication for our customer-facing defence engagements, and take on new projects as the pipeline converts. Build and maintain the roadmap: reconcile project timelines, our concept of operations and component readiness into one roadmap that is used to set priorities, not to describe them afterwards. Be the ISR authority in the team: bring operational depth on the intelligence cycle, collection and tasking, and imagery exploitation. Be the person engineering asks how an analyst would really use this, and the person sales asks what we can credibly claim. Work with users and customers: run workshops and user sessions, gather and structure feedback, demonstrate the product, and support bids and proposals with operational substance. Your profile Professional ISR , GEOINT or IMINT background: Bundeswehr, the intelligence community, defence procurement, or an ISR role in industry. Real operational fluency in the intelligence cycle, collection and tasking, and how imagery products are produced and consumed at a staff. Proven ability to translate operational needs into written requirements that engineers can build from. Track record of driving work to a deadline across dependencies you did not control. German at native or fully fluent level, and professional English. German or European citizenship and eligibility to obtain a German security clearance (Sicherheitsüberprüfung). Willingness to work on-site in Berlin, hybrid with at least two days per week in the office, and to travel within Germany to customers and users. You take ownership and proactively push work forward. You communicate clearly and collaborate smoothly within and across teams. Pragmatic mindset: you balance operational ambition with what can actually be shipped. You enjoy working with complexity and turning ambiguity into structure. Product management or product ownership experience: backlog, sprint cadence, release scoping is a plus. Project management experience in defence or publicly funded programmes (national, EU, NATO) is a plus. Experience writing CONOPS , operational requirements or capability documents is a plus. Familiarity with satellite imagery, remote sensing, or AI and machine learning products is a plus. Experience delivering software into secure on-premise or air-gapped environments is a plus. An existing valid German security clearance (SÜ2 / SÜ3) is a plus. Working knowledge of NATO standards and interoperability for imagery and geospatial data is a plus. Your Benefits The opportunity to create a product that can improve business processes and lives across the globe. Flexible working hours and hybrid work model - we trust our employees to get their work done while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. We empower employees to drive their own career development, take initiative and have the freedom to be creative and bold. Not an overtime culture - we take care that overtime is done only as a necessity and always offset with time off and rest. A collaborative and learning environment - frequent internal workshops, knowledge sharing sessions, journal clubs and hackathons. Office located in the centre of Berlin Kreuzberg with free fruit, nuts and drinks. Potential to participate in the employee stock option program. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>About the role</strong></h2> <p>As an Intermediate Backend Engineer, you will take backend features and improvements from clarifying the problem through shipping them and following up in production. You will work within a product area, partnering with Product Management, Frontend, Infrastructure, and Security to deliver predictably and contribute to the quality, security, performance, and maintainability of shared backend code and services. You will be trusted to work with minimal guidance, to know when to seek help, and to communicate clearly in a remote, asynchronous environment — with other tenured engineers alongside you to review your work, think through hard problems with you, and help you grow.</p> <h2><strong>Why you’ll love this role</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Ownership:</strong> You'll take features from requirements through delivery and follow-up; your code will run on a platform used by millions of users.</li> <li><strong>Learning and Growth :</strong> You’ll work alongside your engineering team, who treat code review and design review as a learning loop rather than a gate — one of the fastest ways to grow your engineering judgment.</li> <li><strong>Innovative Culture:</strong> You’ll use AI as a genuine part of daily engineering work, developing the judgment to know when to trust it and when not to.</li> <li><strong>Autonomy:</strong> You’ll thrive in our remote-first, asynchronous organization, where clear written communication and self-direction are the pillars of success.</li> <li><strong>User-Centric Collaboration:</strong> You’ll partner closely with PMs and designers to shape requirements, so you understand why you’re building something, not just what.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Own and Ship Features:</strong> Design, implement, test, and ship backend features and improvements with minimal guidance, working in Ruby/Rails, Go, or any other modern languages.</li> <li><strong>Build for Production:</strong> Write maintainable, secure, observable, and performant code. Design and maintain APIs, background jobs, integrations, and bounded service functionality, and work with data models, migrations, indexes, and query behavior.</li> <li><strong>Test and Review:</strong> Add and improve automated coverage — unit, integration, contract, and end-to-end where appropriate — and review others’ code for correctness, maintainability, security, performance, and operational risk.</li> <li><strong>Operate What You Build:</strong> Investigate build, test, deployment, and runtime failures at the feature boundary, identify technical debt and propose practical improvements, and take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.</li> <li><strong>Leverage AI:</strong> Use AI productively in daily work, validate what it produces, and understand where its limitations matter.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Backend Fundamentals:</strong> Professional experience building and shipping production backend applications, with strong programming, API, database, testing, debugging, and performance fundamentals.</li> <li><strong>Adaptability:</strong> Experience with Ruby/Rails, Go, or any other modern backend language. We value the ability to learn and adapt over mastery of a single language.</li> <li><strong>Feature Ownership:</strong> The ability to take a feature from clarification through delivery and follow-up, working independently while seeking input at the right time.</li> <li><strong>Practical Judgment:</strong> Sound instincts about security, reliability, performance, maintainability, and operational risk, plus an understanding of modular backend boundaries and the consequences of coupling.</li> <li><strong>Clear Communication:</strong> Strong written communication and effective collaboration in a remote, asynchronous environment.</li> <li><strong>AI Fluency:</strong> Practical experience with AI coding tools, including the ability to review and correct what they generate.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Helpful experience</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Production Go services, APIs, concurrency, profiling, or gRPC.</li> <li>Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, CI/CD, or cloud deployment.</li> <li>Rust, particularly for systems, security, performance, or platform work.</li> <li>PostgreSQL, schema evolution, caching, queues, messaging, or event-driven workflows.</li> <li>Observability using metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, and alerts.</li> <li>Contributing to a modular monolith, bounded context, shared component, or independently operated service.</li> </ul><div If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. title: Senior Finance & FP&A Manager
description: Mission Integral was founded in October 2024 and is already one of the fastest-growing startups in Germany. We're building the leading AI-native platform for accounting, payroll, and tax for European SMEs, and we're looking for the sharpest people to help us get there. As our first dedicated Senior Finance & FP&A Manager, you will build the financial planning & analysis function from the ground up and report directly to the CFO. You will own the group's forecasting and planning engine, sharpen ARR and liquidity steering, and be a core partner on fundraising, board reporting and go-to-market economics. This is a high-visibility, high-autonomy role for someone who wants to build. Your Tasks Planning & forecasting: Own and continuously improve the integrated business plan (P&L, cash flow, balance sheet), including consolidation logic. Budgeting: Run the annual budget and rolling re-forecast; translate strategy into a defensible operating plan and use-of-funds. Performance steering with KPIs & BI: Define and report the KPIs that matter and build them into our BI dashboard. Flag risks and levers early. IR & fundraising: Support board and investor reporting and potential future funding rounds with models and investor-grade materials. GTM & cohorts: Build and own cohort analytics tied to go-to-market (e.g. retention, payback period, LTV/CAC and margin by acquisition channel). Turn these into concrete recommendations on spend and channel mix. Business partnering: Partner with Commercial and Service Operations leaders on unit economics, pricing, funnel efficiency and investment decisions. Scalable processes & automation: Design processes that scale with rapid growth by using AI and agentic tooling to make planning faster, cleaner and repeatable. Operational Finance: Own accounts payable and receivable, and drive timely, accurate month-end and year-end closes together with our tax advisory team. Your Profile Experience: 5+ years in FP&A, accounting/controlling, investment banking or a comparable analytical finance role, ideally with high-growth / VC-backed / scale-up exposure. Modelling: Expert financial modelling; you build clean, three-statement models and defend the assumptions. Commercial: Fluent in unit economics, recurring-revenue and cash metrics; comfortable turning messy data into decisions. Tools: Advanced Excel/Sheets; experience with BI/planning, DATEV and AI tooling a strong plus. Language: You operate in English and German; investor and board materials are produced in English. Mindset: Hands-on, structured, comfortable with ambiguity and first-of-role ownership in a scaling environment. Agentic mindset: You default to AI and agentic tools to automate the repetitive and build leverage - you think in reusable processes and systems, not one-off spreadsheets, so finance scales faster than headcount. Qualification: Degree in finance, business or a quantitative field; CFA, MBA or qualified-accountant background welcome. What we're not looking for People who wait to be told what to do. "That's not my job" energy at the handoff between teams. Anyone who treats compliance and documentation as red tape to skip rather than the thing that protects the client. Process We move fast. For the right candidate the whole process takes less than two weeks. Virtual call ​with our Talent Team Virtual Case Study based on a real challenge we're facing that you'd solve Invitation to our office to meet the team, product, and run through your case study Reference call Our Offer Direct line to the CFO and Co-Founder/CEO exposure Competitive compensation package 28 vacation days per year, plus half-days on December 24 and 31 Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft, Sachbezüge/Coupons to over 200 partners or a Deutschland Ticket Company pension scheme (bAV) Modern equipment setup for your needs to succeed Modern office in the heart of Berlin Prenzlauer Berg Weekly team lunches on us, office BBQs, and a dinner budget for late nights after 8 p.m. A team of 50+ (and growing) ambitious, diverse experts, 20%+ ex-founders, learning and building together A category-defining growth story in a large, underserved market, with an AI-enabled operating model. We value diversity and hire people based on their abilities and capabilities to succeed in this role. We welcome people of every background, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability status, political belief or marital status. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Werkstudent (m/w/d) Sales & Business Development (apeiron)

title: Account Executive (m/f/d)

Our customers can look very different. One week, you may be discussing a fleet deployment with a taxi or car-sharing company. The next, you may be showing the vehicle to a real-estate company, law firm, mobility operator, or prospective individual customer. This is not a role where you inherit a mature market, established category, and optimized sales playbook. Driverless technology is only getting started in Europe. You will need to understand unfamiliar customer problems quickly, figure out how Bliq can solve them, and help us discover how this technology should be sold. You will work closely with the Commercial Lead and founders to refine Bliq’s sales playbook market by market. title: System Software Engineer (gn) Cloud & Simulation
description: Your mission At Wandelbots, we are building NOVA, a platform that makes industrial robot programming accessible to everyone. Our Simulation team develops the technologies that allow partners, customers, and internal teams to work with photorealistic digital twins of real production environments. This includes a pipeline that transforms real-world scans into usable 3D scenes through Gaussian Splatting, as well as a browser-based streaming platform built on NVIDIA Omniverse and Isaac Sim. Both technologies work today, but neither is yet operated as a product. Your mission is to change that. The first step is internal standardization. We want to replace individually maintained environments and hand-crafted deployments with one reproducible, documented solution that teams can use independently: scene in, session out, without requiring the Simulation team to operate every setup. The second step is external productization. The same capabilities need to be packaged so that partners and customers can operate them in their own environments. E.g. with versioned releases, stable interfaces, tenant isolation, diagnostics, upgrade paths, and documentation. You will join the Simulation team and focus on the infrastructure and operational foundations of these systems. You will not be building them in isolation: Wandelbots has an established infrastructure team responsible for shared infrastructure and platform capabilities. You will work closely with that team while owning the simulation-specific workloads, deployment patterns, and operational requirements. This is a hands-on engineering role with room to shape architecture and make technical decisions in collaboration with the teams involved. What you will work on Build and operate the GPU infrastructure required by our simulation workloads, including NVIDIA GPU Operator, device plugins, driver lifecycle, and GPU sharing through MIG or time slicing Work with the infrastructure team to integrate simulation workloads into our shared Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure Make deployments declarative and reproducible using Infrastructure as Code and GitOps, and help consolidate the tooling used across today’s environments Own CI/CD and the container and image lifecycle for CUDA - and NGC -based workloads Design scheduling and autoscaling for two distinct workload profiles: latency-sensitive interactive streaming sessions and compute-intensive Gaussian Splatting jobs Turn the Gaussian Splatting pipeline into a reproducible workflow, from data capture and training to OpenUSD assets Operate and extend our Omniverse and Isaac Sim streaming platform, including Kit App Streaming, session lifecycle, and tenant isolation Establish the platform as an internal standard through self-service workflows, golden paths, templates, onboarding, and documentation Prepare the solution for operation by partners and customers through packaged deployments, versioned releases, upgrade paths, and actionable diagnostics Support deployments across cloud, on-premises, and partner-managed environments Build meaningful observability using metrics, logs, GPU telemetry, and actionable alerting Define the simulation-specific security and access model, including ingress, TURN and STUN for WebRTC, RBAC , secrets management, SSO , and tenant boundaries Work closely with our robotics, product, and platform teams to ensure that the solution supports real development and customer workflows Your profile We are looking for an engineer who is interested in how complex systems are built, deployed, and operated, not only in delivering the next application feature. You should bring: Experience building or operating production systems in platform engineering, infrastructure, SRE, DevOps, or systems software Practical Kubernetes experience, including resource management, workload scheduling, and debugging distributed systems under load Experience with Infrastructure as Code, GitOps, and CI/CD, together with the ability to evaluate tools based on the problem rather than a fixed preference Solid knowledge of Linux, containers, and networking Good Python skills for automation, services, and data-processing workflows Experience with GPU workloads, or a strong technical foundation and clear interest in working with drivers, CUDA , and GPU scheduling The ability to turn working technology into a system that other teams can use independently A strong sense of operational ownership, including documentation, diagnostics, maintainability, and reproducibility Very good English; German is a plus We do not expect candidates to have prior experience with every technology in this description. A strong systems foundation, the ability to learn unfamiliar components, and an interest in this problem space are more important than matching every item. The scope and responsibilities of the role will grow with your experience. Nice to have Experience turning an internally developed system into a product that can be operated in customer-controlled environments Hands-on experience with NVIDIA Omniverse, Isaac Sim, Kit SDK, or OpenUSD Experience with Gaussian Splatting, NeRF , photogrammetry, or comparable 3D reconstruction pipelines Knowledge of WebRTC, pixel streaming, or other low-latency video technologies Python, Rust, or Go skills sufficient to contribute to existing services and infrastructure tooling Experience with robotics or simulation, such as ROS 2 or sim-to-real workflows Experience with multi-tenant platforms, air-gapped deployments, or customer environments with specific security and compliance requirements Why us? Make an impact! Work on an innovative, deep tech product that adds value to the robotics world and to society! Become a crucial part of something new, big and exciting where you can truly make an impact! Our teams inspire! Cross-functional communication is key. You'll get to know many of your 100+ colleagues. Collaborate with great people on our international teams who value knowledge sharing and unique ways of doing things! Be authentic! Work in a value-driven environment where everything may not be perfect, but we're working on it! Your feedback is required while you receive feedback and appreciation for your work! Help others! You can have up to 3 days of volunteer time off to help your favorite charity. Develop yourself! We offer training and mental health opportunities so that you can develop both mentally and professionally. And there is even more! Enjoy our free lunch, snacks and drinks, team events, 30 days of annual vacation + additional rest during Christmas season until New Year. title: Automation Engineer (gn) Industrial Robotics & Software Development
description: Your mission At Wandelbots, we combine modern software development with industrial robotics and automation. With NOVA, we are building a platform that makes the use of industrial robots easier, more flexible, and more software-driven. As an Automation Engineer , you will work right at this intersection: You will commission automation systems and robots, support our teams with your hands-on industrial expertise, and implement customer-specific solutions based on NOVA. You will support projects from technical concept and implementation through to commissioning at the customer site, while bringing insights from real-world automation projects back into our product and engineering teams. economic advantages of our approach.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="11,2,0">Collaborate with Sales and Developer GTM leadership to build repeatable qualification frameworks and deal structures for inference revenue.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Market Intelligence & Cross-Functional Leadership</h3> <ul> <li> <p data-path-to-node="13,0,0">Serve as Cloudflare's primary listener and synthesizer for prospective partners.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="17,4,0"><strong data-path-to-node="17,4,0" data-index-in-node="0">Adaptability:</strong> Comfort navigating fast-evolving markets, making description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. As an Outcomes Architect, you’ll be the build-beside partner who helps customers turn ambition into working systems inside Notion. You’ll own workflow adoption, value delivery, and renewal outcomes for a book of named accounts, with a focus on customers that are flat, at-risk, or need a stronger path to measurable impact. You’ll partner closely with Solutions Consultants on account strategy, expansion qualification, and customer success planning, while directly shaping outcomes that strengthen customer partnerships and contribute to predictable revenue. If you’re a builder who loves helping customers solve real business problems—and you want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, customer value, and revenue impact—this is the role. This role will be based in Dublin. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: - Drive workflow adoption and value realization for a book of named accounts, ensuring customers expand their use of Notion and as a result, Notion sees high NRR - Partner closely with the Solutions Consultant on account strategy for expansion and renewal, including owning the renewal opportunity for flat and at-risk customers - Shape customer outcomes, strengthen executive and team-level partnerships, and contribute directly to predictable revenue through retention, renewal, and expansion impact - Design and deploy workflows that solve specific business problems as a build-beside partner to the customer, translating goals into durable systems in Notion - Partner with Solutions Consultants on account strategy, customer planning, and identifying and qualifying expansion opportunities within existing accounts - Co-define, build, and manage against customer success plans that help every customer achieve their desired objectives and realize measurable value - Learn Notion’s product and the broader AI ecosystem inside and out so you can be the best build-beside partner for customers navigating new ways of working - Innovate and iterate on Outcomes Architect programs that retain and grow customers while mitigating churn or contraction risk SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: - Experience driving customer adoption, value realization, renewals, or expansion within a B2B software environment - Strong customer-facing discovery instincts, with the ability to understand business problems, map workflows, and translate goals into practical implementation plans - Technical fluency and genuine comfort building live in software—you can co-design, configure, and troubleshoot with customers in the room - Commercial awareness and the ability to partner with account owners on renewal risk, expansion potential, and account strategy - Strong program and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage success plans, timelines, risks, and customer commitments across a book of accounts - You operate with agency, urgency, and customer empathy, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and helping teams move from ideas to working systems - You’re obsessed with AI, constantly building with the newest tools and learning new ways of working - Additional languages NICE TO HAVES: - Prior experience in customer success, solutions consulting, implementation, technical account management, or post-sales strategy for productivity, collaboration, or workflow software - Experience working with flat, at-risk, or complex renewal accounts and helping customers return to a clear value path - Familiarity with usage-based or consumption-based models and the ability to connect adoption patterns to commercial outcomes - title: Risk Assurance Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍Dublin, Ireland  |💰 <strong>€68,00 - €83,000, Incentive Awards tied to your performance ➕ benefits</strong> | <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U62l09nB0M4">Hear from the team</a> </p> <p><strong>⭐Our Risk and Compliance team</strong></p> <p>Monzo Bank Europe (MBEU) is the Irish-based subsidiary of the Monzo Group and the strategic launchpad for our expansion across the European Union. We are looking for a seasoned Risk Assurance Manager to provide independent Second-Line of Defence (2LOD) assurance over the design and effectiveness of the bank’s risk management framework, controls and processes. You will ensure that key risks are managed in line with regulatory expectations, internal policies and our risk appetite, providing robust oversight and challenge across the full spectrum of the bank’s risk universe.</p> <p>In this role, you will ensure the bank complies with:</p> <ul> <li>Irish Regulatory Obligations, including CBI, CPC, AML/CFT legislation, and the Companies Act.</li> <li>EU Regulatory Requirements, including DORA, EBA Guidelines, ECB/SSM expectations, and GDPR.</li> <li>Internal Governance, including adherence to risk frameworks, policies, and risk appetite.</li> </ul> <p>Reporting directly to the Director of Risk Assurance, MBEU, you will design, execute, and report on 2LOD assurance reviews covering conduct, financial crime, fraud, credit, and financial risks. Your remit will also include operational risk, ICT and information security, outsourcing, data protection and governance structures. This role is critical in fostering a sound risk culture and supporting senior management and the Board in their oversight responsibilities.You will be instrumental in providing stakeholders with the assurance needed to ensure our growth is safe, resilient and compliant.</p> <p>The role you are applying for is a Controlled Function (CF-2) within the meaning of the Central Bank Reform Act, 2010. For this role, appointment will be conditional on Monzo being fully satisfied that the appointee meets the requirements as set out in the Fitness and Probity Standards 2018 issued by the Central Bank of Ireland. As a CF, the role holder will be subject to Conduct Standards under the Central Bank of Ireland Individual Accountability Framework and will be required to take reasonable steps to ensure that the relevant conduct standards are met.</p> <p><strong>🔑You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Assurance Plan</strong>: Planning, coordinating and executing comprehensive risk assurance activities, including effectiveness reviews to ensure EU-wide adherence to the enterprise risk framework.</li> <li><strong>Thematic Reviews:</strong> Conducting targeted thematic reviews across specific risk areas (e.g., conduct, compliance, financial crime, IT, prudential and strategic risk) to provide in-depth assurance over design adequacy and operating effectiveness.</li> <li><strong>Remediation</strong>: Identifying areas for improvement within the risk management framework and control environment, recommending practical, impactful solutions and tracking remediation efforts to completion.</li> <li><strong>Stakeholder Engagement</strong>: Proactively engage with business and risk stakeholders to understand Monzo Europe’s products and risk profiles, fostering a collaborative and transparent risk culture.</li> <li><strong>Strategic Planning</strong>: Contributing to the annual risk assurance plan by providing insights gathered through continuous monitoring of regulatory trends and horizon scanning, market practices and upstream developments.</li> <li><strong>Framework Governance</strong>: Contribute to the continuous improvement of the 2LOD Risk Assurance Framework, Methodology and Terms of Reference to ensure they remain fit-for-purpose and market-leading.</li> <li><strong>Cross-Functional Collaboration</strong>: Partnering closely with First-Line of Defence (1LOD) control testing, Group 2LOD, and Internal Audit to ensure alignment while maintaining strict independent challenge.</li> <li><strong>Reporting & Governance</strong>: Contributing to risk governance by reporting thematic insights, trends and remediation progress to senior management committees.</li> <li><strong>Risk Culture</strong>: Promote a strong risk and compliance culture, awareness and training programs across the organisation.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have a strong background in risk assurance, internal audit and/or risk management within banking or fintech in the European regulatory and financial services landscape. </li> <li>You have a proven ability to plan and execute diverse assurance activities, from effectiveness reviews to thematic deep dives, with a clear focus on root cause analysis.</li> <li>You’ve led reviews across a wide range of risk areas, including ICT and Information Security, Financial/Prudential (Liquidity, Treasury, Capital), Fraud and Financial Crime (AML/Sanctions), Operational and Conduct Risk (Consumer Protection/Vulnerability).</li> <li>You possess a deep understanding of risk and control frameworks (e.g., COSO, ISO) and can practically apply this knowledge to 2LOD oversight.</li> <li>You are skilled in the hands-on identification and testing of risks and controls, with a keen eye for detail and potential weaknesses.</li> <li>You have a track record of identifying gaps within risk management processes and frameworks and recommending practical, high-impact solutions.</li> <li>You combine sharp analytical skills with the ability to communicate findings clearly to diverse stakeholders, offering constructive challenge and influencing at all levels.</li> <li>You have strong data analysis skills, you know how to extract, interrogate and present data in a way that makes complex issues easy for stakeholders to understand.</li> <li>You’re proficient in Google Suite and can build high-quality decks for Committee and Board reporting. Experience with SQL or Python is a distinct advantage.</li> </ul> <p>Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!</p> <p><strong>🙌What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰A salary range of €68,000 - €83,000 and Incentive Awards tied to your performance</p> <p>📍This role will have a hybrid working model, based in our Dublin office 2 - 3 days a week </p> <p>⏰We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>🏝 Annual Leave - 34 days including public holidays (24 holiday days + 10 public holidays)</p> <p>📚€1,200 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏥Private healthcare scheme</p> <p>💰Pension scheme: the minimum contribution is 4% and Monzo matches any additional contributions that you make up to a maximum of 6%</p> <p>💛Wellbeing benefits: financial education, women’s and men’s health support, mental health benefits, including coaching and counselling</p> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>An introductory call with a member of our hiring team</li> <li>An initial call with the hiring manager</li> <li>A series of role specific and behavioural interviews</li> <li>A final call with a member of our Executive team</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 2-3 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out. </p> <p>If you're successful in applying for this role, we'll work with you to find a start date. In some cases, there might be a delay in when you can be released from your current role so that we can make sure things continue to run smoothly. For this role, appointment will be conditional on Monzo being fully satisfied that the appointee meets the requirements as set out in the Fitness and Probity Standards issued by the Central Bank of Ireland. As a CF, the role holder will be subject to Conduct Standards under the Central Bank of Ireland Individual Accountability Framework (IAF) and will be required to take reasonable steps to ensure that the relevant conduct standards are met.</p> <p> <strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <ul> <li>Acting as the second line subject matter expert for operational risk, technology (ICT and security risk (including cyber)), and operational resilience.</li> <li>Reviewing and challenging the design and effectiveness of controls over key technology systems, digital infrastructure.</li> <li>Providing effective oversight and challenge of first line risk and control self-assessments (RCSA), incident management and reporting, issue remediation and risk mitigation processes.</li> <li>Providing second line input into our technology and security strategies and business continuity planning.</li> <li>Supporting the ongoing development and maintenance of our Operational Risk Management Framework (ORMF), policies, standards and associated ICT,  Security and Resilience policies and risk appetite metrics.</li> <li>Co-ordinating second line assurance reviews and risk deep dives into critical operational and technology areas, providing actionable recommendations and insights.</li> <li>Overseeing ongoing compliance with  the digital operational resilience act (DORA) in the EU and ensuring alignment  with applicable local regulatory standards.</li> <li>Preparing operational and technology risk reports and providing updates to relevant governance forums, including risk committees and senior management.</li> </ul> <p> <strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have 8+ years’ experience in operational risk, technology risk or related roles in financial services, ideally within a digital or challenger bank, or a pan-European firm. </li> <li>You have a deep knowledge of risk management practices, regulatory expectations, and industry standards related to operational risk, technology and operational resilience. (e.g. EBA Guidelines on ICT & Security Risk Management, DORA, Central Bank of Ireland Guidance on Operational Resilience, General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), Payment Service Directive (PSD2/PSD3)).</li> <li>You have a strong understanding of digital banking technology, including cloud computing, cybersecurity, fintech integrations and data management.</li> <li>You have experience in evaluating and challenging risk and control environments, particularly in high-growth or fast-changing environments.</li> <li>You are an ambitious risk professional ready to leave the constraints of legacy firms behind. This role places you at the cutting edge of technology and operational risk, challenging you to define the governance needed for our next-generation platforms.</li> <li>You have strong analytical, problem-solving and project management skills.</li> <li>You have excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior leadership. </li> <li>You have a proven ability to navigate complex stakeholder landscapes such as working with regulators/managing regulatory engagements.</li> </ul> <p>Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. title: Technical Support Engineer, Application Security
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Available Location: Singapore</strong></h3> <h3><strong>About the Team</strong></h3> <p>The Cloudflare Customer Support Team solves complicated problems and answers technical questions via phone, email, chat and social media. Whether it is a Wordpress blogger using our services for free or a global Enterprise business with petabytes of web traffic, we are always eager to assist. We are the eyes and ears of Cloudflare, acting as the real-time voice of the customer to help communicate their needs and real-world use cases back to the rest of the company - for better service and future product development.</p> <h3><strong>What You'll Do</strong></h3> <p>Do you love solving complex technical issues and interacting with people? Are you passionate about providing premium-level support to customers and are a standout colleague? Cloudflare is seeking an experienced <strong>Technical </strong><strong>Support Engineer</strong><strong> for Application Services/Performance </strong>to join our team. You will work with our largest and most technically sophisticated customers on a variety of technical support issues to ensure they can deploy and operate Cloudflare's App Services solutions with confidence. </p> <ul> <li>Serve as a trusted technical advisor for our Enterprise customers, responding to and resolving inquiries and incidents related to Application Services/Performance, while delivering timely, high-quality and personalized assistance.</li> <li>Work directly with customers to diagnose, troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues involving DNS, HTTP Errors, IAM, Load Balancing, Caching, CORS, SSL/TLS, Network, and other Application Services/Performance related configurations.</li> <li>Work with Engineering and Operations teams to remediate issues, suggest steps to mitigate, and apply the appropriate mitigation, when applicable.</li> <li>Create and maintain knowledge base articles, technical guides, and troubleshooting documentation for internal and customer use.</li> <li>You have a solid grasp of problem-solving with command line tools (dig/traceroute/curl/tcpdump).</li> <li>You have experience writing scripts in Bash, Python, JavaScript, or other scripting language.</li> <li>You have experience installing and configuring web servers like Apache, Nginx, and IIS.</li> <li>Work with Engineering and Product teams to improve products and tools.</li> </ul> <h3>What We're Looking For</h3> <ul> <li>You must have a minimum of 4 years’ experience working as a Technical Support Engineer supporting globally distributed reverse-proxy CDN platforms, with hands-on expertise in content caching, performance optimization, traffic routing, and edge delivery services similar to Cloudflare’s core network offerings.</li> <li>Exceptional troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with the ability to simplify complex concepts for customers.</li> <li>Strong customer service orientation and communication skills, both written and verbal.</li> <li>Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.</li> <li>Strong understanding of L4/L7 protocols and concepts including, TCP/UDP, DNS, HTTP/S, IAM, Load Balancing, Caching, CORS, SSL/TLS, Network with a particular focus on Anycast concepts.</li> <li>Have experience using online diagnostic and monitoring platforms — including DNS lookup tools, global ping and traceroute testers, SSL/TLS configuration analyzers, and synthetic transaction or real-user monitoring services — to troubleshoot DNS resolution, network latency, certificate issues, and global service availability problems.</li> <li>Have experience using investigative observability tools such as Kibana, Grafana, Zabbix, Sentry, and live log-tailing utilities to analyze logs, trace issues, and pinpoint root causes of performance or reliability problems.</li> <li>Confident with command line and tools, including curl, dig, traceroute, openssl, git.</li> <li>Experience in a web development and / or hosting environment such as installing and configuring web servers like Apache, Nginx, Caddy and IIS.</li> <li>You are competent at writing scripts in Bash, Python, JavaScript or other scripting language.</li> <li>You have worked with PostgreSQL, MySQL, MS SQL, and other database servers.</li> <li>Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related field (or equivalent experience).</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Bonus Points For</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience in a shift-based or global support environment.</li> <li>Familiarity with SLA/KPI metrics and real-time queue management.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. in.</p></div><h3><strong>チームについて</strong></h3> <p>私たちのBDR（Business Development Representative）組織のミッションは非常にシンプルです。 それは、「営業チームに高品質かつ大規模なパイプラインを供給し、Cloudflareの持続的な収益成長を牽引すること」です。</p> <p>そのために私たちは「人材・プロセス・ツール」のすべてにおいて最高水準を追求しています。とりわけ人材の育成とキャリア開発には強いこだわりを持っており、チームワークを尊重し、お互いの成功を称え合うカルチャーを大切にしています。強固なBDR組織の構築こそが、Cloudflareの市場における圧倒的な競合優位性を生み出す源泉であると信じています。</p> <h3><strong>ポジションの概要</strong></h3> <p>本ポジションでは、「ピープルマネジメント（育成・牽引）」「組織ビルディング」「戦略的思考」を兼ね備えたリーダーを募集しています。営業、インサイドセールス、またはBDR/SDR組織におけるチームマネジメントの豊富なご経験をお持ちの方を求めています。</p> <p>BDRチームの運営基盤（Sales Motion）の強化、四半期目標の安定達成、組織拡大に向けた戦略立案、そして協調的なチームカルチャーの醸成を主導していただきます。Cloudflare Japanは今後12ヶ月でさらなる変革と成長を予定しており、次代を担う優秀なリーダー・メンバーの育成と支援も非常に重要なミッションとなります。</p> <h3><strong>主な業務内容</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>BDRチームの運営基盤（オペレーション）の構築・強化</strong></li> <ul> <li>ターゲット顧客への効果的なアプローチ手法の確立、データ活用、営業支援ツール（Sales Tech）の実装、営業チームへのスムーズなリード引き継ぎプロセスの構築</li> </ul> <li><strong>他部門（営業・マーケティング・オペレーション）との強固なパートナーシップ構築</strong></li> <ul> <li><strong>営業部門：</strong> リード獲得基準（SQL定義）、案件の品質・数量に関する共通認識の形成、スムーズな商談引き継ぎの実現</li> <li><strong>マーケティング部門：</strong> MQLの質と量の最適化、各種キャンペーンの効果検証、メッセージング（訴求軸）の共同開発</li> <li><strong>オペレーション部門：</strong> レポート作成・分析、営業プロセスの継続的な改善</li> </ul> <li><strong>グローバルとの連携およびベストプラクティスの導入</strong></li> <ul> <li>他地域のBDR組織と連携し、グローバルで成功している最新のBD戦略やノウハウを積極的に日本市場へ導入・共有</li> </ul> <li><strong>メンバーのマネジメントと組織拡大</strong></li> <ul> <li>5名以上（今後さらに拡大予定）のBDRメンバーのピープルマネジメント</li> <li>BDRメンバーの積極的なリクルーティング、面接、採用活動の推進</li> </ul> </ul> <h3><strong>応募要件（Qualifications）</strong></h3> <h4><strong>【必須要件】</strong></h4> <ul> <li>BDR/SDRまたは営業（Account Executive）チームのマネジメント経験（10年以上）</li> <ul> <li>うち5年以上は、担当チームの組織拡大（スケーリング）をリードした経験</li> </ul> <li>急成長中のIT/テクノロジー企業における実務経験（5年以上）</li> <li>学士号（Bachelor's degree）または同等の実務経験</li> <li>自身およびチームにおける高い目標達成能力（個人/チームでのノルマ連続達成実績）</li> <li>インバウンド、アウトバウンド、マーケティング、既存拡大など、複数チャネルにおけるパイプライン管理・ファネル運用の経験</li> <li>Salesforceをはじめとする営業支援システム（LeanData、各種セールスイネーブルメントツールなど）の高度な活用知識</li> <li>メンバーの育成・キャリア開発プログラムの構築および運用経験</li> Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: London, United Kingdom </strong></p> <hr> <h2><strong>About the Department</strong></h2> <p><strong>Cloudforce One</strong> is Cloudflare's threat operations and research team, responsible for identifying and disrupting cyber threats ranging from sophisticated cyber criminal activity to nation-state sponsored advanced persistent threats (APTs). Cloudforce One works in close partnership with external organizations and internal Cloudflare teams, continuously developing operational tradecraft and expanding ever-growing sources of threat intelligence to enable expedited threat hunting and remediation.</p> <p>Members of Cloudforce One are at the helm of leveraging an incredibly vast and varied set of data points that only one of the world's largest global networks can provide. The team analyzes these unique data points at massive scale and efficiency, synthesizing findings into actionable threat intelligence to better protect our customers.</p> <h2><strong>About INTERDICT</strong></h2> <p><strong>I.N.T.E.R.D.I.C.T.</strong> (Identify, Neutralize, Triage, Engage, Respond, Disrupt, Integrate, Contain, Threat Hunting) is Cloudforce One's unified operational security organization responsible for identifying, analyzing, and responding to threats targeting Cloudflare and its customers. You will autonomously investigate complex threat telemetry, handle live incident response for sophisticated volumetric DDoS and application-layer attacks, and analyze traffic anomalies during high-pressure events.</p> <p>Customers contact the Managed Defense Center for assistance and intelligence across Cloudflare's security portfolio, focused on two core pillars: Web Application Security (WAF and Bot Management) and DDoS mitigation across network and application layers. <br><br>Managed Defense Response Engineers use customer-facing dashboards and internal tools to make detailed and informed suggestions for mitigation, and may implement mitigation strategies directly on behalf of the customer. always-on operational environment and bridges the gap between deep technical analysis and premium customer advisory.</p> <h3><strong><em>Role Responsibilities</em></strong></h3> <ul> <li>Implement robust mitigation strategies for complex attacks across OSI Layers 3, 4, and 7 using Cloudflare's suite (Magic Transit, Magic Firewall, Advanced TCP Protection, Advanced DNS Protection, WAF, Custom protocol exhaustion and application-layer exploitation, translating findings into custom, highly targeted mitigation rules</li> <li>Review alerts to determine relevancy and urgency, proactively escalate customer-impacting incidents, and adhere to Customer SLAs for alert response and customer communication</li> <li>Act as the primary technical contact for customers during active security incidents, driving high-touch, consultative communication (via phone, chat, email) with customers' technical engineering teams to neutralize threats while ensuring stable traffic delivery</li> <li>Continuously tune and optimize existing security monitoring rules and alerting thresholds to improve the operational signal-to-noise ratio and reduce false positives</li> <li>Lead managed customer onboarding sessions, maintain customer-specific runbooks, and deliver highly technical monthly security posture reviews and post-incident reports</li> <li>Partner directly with internal engineering, product, and threat intelligence teams to provide actionable feedback on attack trends, tooling gaps, and product enhancements</li> </ul> <p><strong><em>Role Requirements</em></strong></p> <ul> <li>4–7 years of direct, hands-on experience in Managed Detection and Response (MDR), advanced Security Operations, or high-level Technical Support/Incident Response for enterprise infrastructure</li> <li>Proven capability to handle both Application Security (including knowledge of OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities, L7 WAF, HTTP/S anomalies, Bot mitigation) and Network Security (L3/L4 volumetric DDoS, protocol abuse)</li> <li>Working knowledge of threat frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK to classify adversary behavior and inform detection and mitigation strategies</li> <li>Operational understanding of internet protocols including TCP, UDP, ICMP, GRE, BGP, DNS, with the ability to quickly diagnose attack fingerprints and infrastructure impact during volumetric DDoS attacks</li> <li>Hands-on experience with packet capture (e.g., tcpdump, Wireshark, tshark) or HTTP traffic inspection (e.g., HAR, Burp Suite) to analyze malicious traffic</li> <li>Extensive experience managing technical communications with enterprise customers during high-stress, active attacks, with the ability to remain calm under pressure and translate complex attack data into clear actionable advice</li> <li>Ability and willingness to work 24x7 rotating shifts to support global operations</li> <li>Knowledge of industry security technologies (e.g., enterprise CDNs, cloud-based DDoS scrubbing centers, Next-Gen WAFs, and edge network firewalls) (Preferred)</li> <li>Proficiency in Linux/Unix environments and strong scripting skills (Bash, Python preferred) for workflow automation (including experience leveraging agentic AI environments or LLMs to optimize operations) and experience interacting with REST APIs or GraphQL to pull and correlate operational data (Preferred)</li> <li>Experience building or querying dashboards in Prometheus and Grafana for performance and attack metrics (Preferred)</li> <li>Highly valued security and networking certifications such as GIAC (e.g., GCIA, GCIH, GCFA, GCFE), Cisco CCNA/CCNP, or equivalent hands-on incident response credentials (Preferred)</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> asynchronous organization.</p> <h2>What you’ll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Design and ship moderately sized frontend features and improvements with minimal guidance, making pragmatic architectural choices.</li> <li value="2">Turn ambiguous customer and product needs into clear technical plans and intuitive, accessible experiences.</li> <li value="3">Advocate for product quality, security, component design, testing, observability, maintainable code, and thoughtful use of artificial intelligence and agentic tools in production engineering work.</li> <li value="5">Mentor Associate and using observability and production signals, and participate in incident response or on-call responsibilities under your team's ownership model.</li> <li value="7">Design or review independently buildable frontend surfaces and explicit contracts for data, events, authorization, feature flags, error handling, testing, and performance expectations.</li> <li value="8">Collaborate with product, design, backend, quality, security, and other teams to deliver cohesive customer outcomes.</li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Experience applying frontend architecture, browser behavior, testing, accessibility, performance, and maintainability practices in a complex product or platform environment.</li> <li value="2">Experience designing or evolving modular frontend boundaries, independently buildable surfaces, component systems, or migration-safe architectures.</li> <li value="3">Experience making pragmatic trade-offs with product and design partners and turning complex requirements into clear user experiences.</li> <li value="4">The ability to lead through technical judgment, collaboration, and clear written communication rather than formal authority.</li> <li value="5">Experience mentoring engineers and improving team practices through code review, design review, documentation, or hands-on collaboration.</li> <li value="6">The ability to work effectively in a remote, asynchronous organization by managing priorities, creating clarity, and communicating decisions in writing.</li> <li value="7">Practical experience integrating artificial intelligence into a feature, workflow, or engineering process, or evaluating its reliability, security, privacy, and appropriate human oversight.</li> <li value="8">Helpful, but not required: experience with Vue, React, Angular, TypeScript, or JavaScript; PostgreSQL, Redis, or object storage; representational state transfer or GraphQL; Kubernetes, Google Kubernetes Engine, Docker, or Google Cloud Platform; Prometheus or Sentry; and Git, GitLab Runner, or GitLab continuous integration and continuous delivery.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>We own core repository capabilities, from Git command-line operations to web-based code exploration. Our roadmap includes feature and platform development, improvements to existing capabilities, maintainability, accessibility, performance, and workflows for teams using AI-assisted development tools.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. title: Principal Partner Account Manager - Service Provider, APAC (Based in Singapore)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Working across executive leadership, Product, Engineering, Sales, and partner delivery organizations, you will shape what we build together, how it is commercialized, and how it reaches customers across the region.</p> <p>Based in Singapore and reporting to the Senior Director, Global Service Provider Sales, you will lead Cloudflare’s most consequential Service Provider relationships in APAC. Your scope will include joint business models, co-developed managed services, technical and commercial integration, executive governance, and multi-year growth plans.</p> <p>The opportunity is suited to someone who has moved beyond managing established partner programs and wants to create a market-making ecosystem strategy. You will operate with significant autonomy, influence Cloudflare’s regional and global priorities, and help leading Service Providers evolve from resale relationships into deeply integrated platform partners.</p> <p><strong>What Makes This Role Distinctive</strong></p> <ul> <li>A regional category-building mandate: Define how Cloudflare partners with the largest Service Providers and MSSPs across priorities within Cloudflare’s global Service Provider strategy and help shape models that can be replicated in other regions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Role Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Strategic Vision & Ownership: </strong>Architect and execute master multi-year partner account strategies for Tier-1 Service Providers, aligning deep technical integration with macro APAC business expansion and automated growth models.<br><strong>Ecosystem & Joint Venture Innovation:</strong> Conceptualize, structure, and launch high-impact joint ventures, co-investment frameworks, and repeatable solution stacks that combine Cloudflare’s edge platform with partner core offerings to capture dominating market share.</li> <li><strong>Architecture & Offer Development:</strong> Lead the co-creation of next-generation, cloud-native services and managed solution offerings, setting the regional standard for how SP/MSSP partners build, package, and monetize on Cloudflare’s architecture.</li> <li><strong>C-Suite & Executive Alignment: </strong>Forge, nurture, and leverage C-level relationships (CEO, CTO, Chief Revenue Officer) across the SP landscape to position Cloudflare as an indispensable strategic partner and secure long-term board-level commitments.</li> <li><strong>Operational Scale & Framework Design: </strong>Champion the regional rollout of scalable, automated enablement frameworks, standardized reference architectures, and self-sustaining partner delivery models in collaboration with global product and engineering leads.</li> <li><strong>Strategic Governance & Data Intelligence:</strong> Direct regional business reviews and quarterly planning, utilizing advanced data layers to evaluate ecosystem health, map revenue attribution, and optimize market penetration strategy.</li> <li><strong>Ecosystem Forecasting & Pipeline Leadership: </strong>Oversee high-accuracy, long-range forecasting pipelines across the APAC SP portfolio, driving proactive pipeline generation strategies that consistently outperform regional growth targets.</li> <li><strong>Shape Cloudflare’s priorities:</strong> Bring partner and market insight into internal product, packaging, enablement, and go-to-market decisions. Serve as the senior voice of the APAC Service Provider ecosystem inside Cloudflare.</li> <li><strong>Lead through influence:</strong> Mobilize virtual teams across Sales, Solutions Engineering, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Legal, Finance, and partner organizations without relying on direct reporting authority.</li> <li><strong>Represent Cloudflare in the market:</strong> Act as a senior spokesperson with Service Provider executives, industry forums, and ecosystem leaders, helping shape the conversation around the future of cloud connectivity, cybersecurity, and managed services.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Role Requirements</strong></p> <ul> <li>15+ years of extensive senior-level experience building and scaling significant Service Provider, telecommunications, MSSP, cloud, or technology-platform partnerships across multiple APAC markets. Evidence of impact is valued more than a fixed number of years.</li> <li>Recognized industry expertise in the Cybersecurity, Edge Computing, and Networking sectors, with a profound understanding of modern cloud platform economics.</li> <li>Exceptional track record of negotiating complex, high-stakes corporate agreements and driving consensus within highly matrixed, global enterprise environments.</li> <li>Demonstrated capability to design long-term business development strategies independently while orchestrating cross-functional teams across Sales, Engineering, Product, and Marketing.</li> <li>High fluency in leveraging enterprise data architectures, AI-driven workflows, and automated pipeline tooling to inform strategic decisions and scale operational reach.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to build trusted C-suite and senior executive relationships across the APAC Service Provider ecosystem; an established regional network is highly valued.</li> <li>Executive communication, negotiation, and storytelling skills, with the ability to simplify complex market and technology shifts into clear decisions and mobilize senior stakeholders.</li> <li>Ability to travel 30–40% across the APAC region.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with.
